    """Deterministic offline descriptive comparisons. No targets or model inputs."""
    
    from dataclasses import dataclass
    from pathlib import Path
    from typing import Any
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import episodes, exact_share, time_grid
    from airalerts.io import load_alerts_in_ua, load_official, load_volunteer, official_variant, trim_tail, valid_end
    
    EXCLUDED = {"Luhanska oblast", "Crimea", "Sevastopol"}
    PLOT_OBLASTS = ["Lvivska oblast", "Volynska oblast", "Kharkivska oblast", "Odeska oblast", "Kyiv City"]
    # User-supplied external reference, not fetched by this offline program:
    # https://www.slovoidilo.ua/2026/03/24/infografika/suspilstvo/yakyx-oblastyax-prolunalo-najbilshe-najmenshe-povitryanyx-tryvoh-pochatku-roku
    REFERENCE_HOURS = {"Dnipropetrovska oblast": 1780, "Kyiv City": 122, "Kyivska oblast": 375,
                       "Poltavska oblast": 532, "Kirovohradska oblast": 302}
    FACT3 = {
        "2026": {"Dnipropetrovska oblast": (.999, .905, .952), "Donetska oblast": (.962, .913, .744),
                 "Kharkivska oblast": (.882, .881, .862), "Zaporizka oblast": (.833, .832, .782),
                 "Odeska oblast": (.208, .208, .208), "Kyiv City": (.066, .066, .066),
                 "Lvivska oblast": (.011, .011, .011)},
        "2024": {"Dnipropetrovska oblast": (.911, .220, .856), "Donetska oblast": (.612, .452, .608),
                 "Kharkivska oblast": (.748, .451, .431)},
    }
    
    
    def utc(value: str | pd.Timestamp) -> pd.Timestamp:
        value = pd.Timestamp(value)
        return value.tz_localize("UTC") if value.tzinfo is None else value.tz_convert("UTC")
    
    
    def closed(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        mask = df.finished_at.notna() & df.finished_at.gt(df.started_at)
        if "is_open" in df:
            mask &= ~df.is_open
        return df.loc[mask].copy()
    
    
    def window_rows(df: pd.DataFrame, start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        rows = closed(df)
        return rows.loc[rows.started_at.lt(end) & rows.finished_at.gt(start)].copy()
    
    
    def without_exclusions(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return df.loc[~df.oblast.isin(EXCLUDED)].copy()
    
    
    @dataclass
    class Source:
        name: str
        full: pd.DataFrame
        end: pd.Timestamp
        rows: pd.DataFrame
    
        @classmethod
        def prepare(cls, name: str, full: pd.DataFrame) -> "Source":
            return cls(name, full, valid_end(full), closed(without_exclusions(trim_tail(full))))
    
    
    def daily_presence(df: pd.DataFrame, start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp,
                       oblasts: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Touch of Europe/Kyiv calendar days, including partial boundary days.
    
        Midnight boundaries follow Kyiv DST (23/25-hour days), never fixed UTC days.
        """
        first = start.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv").floor("D")
        last = end.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv").ceil("D")
        index = pd.date_range(first, last, freq="D", inclusive="left")
        result = pd.DataFrame(False, index=index, columns=oblasts)
        for oblast, rows in window_rows(df, start, end).groupby("oblast"):
            if oblast not in result:
                continue
            left = index.searchsorted(rows.started_at.clip(lower=start), side="right") - 1
            right = index.searchsorted(rows.finished_at.clip(upper=end), side="left")
            changes = np.zeros(len(index) + 1, dtype=int)
            np.add.at(changes, left, 1)
            np.add.at(changes, right, -1)
            result[oblast] = np.cumsum(changes[:-1]) > 0
        return result
    
    
    def source_metrics(df: pd.DataFrame, start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp,
                       oblasts: list[str]) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
        grid60 = time_grid(df, start, end).reindex(columns=oblasts, fill_value=False)
        grid30 = time_grid(df, start, end, "30min").reindex(columns=oblasts, fill_value=False)
        daily = daily_presence(df, start, end, oblasts)
        shares = exact_share(df, start, end).reindex(oblasts, fill_value=0)
        output = []
        for oblast in oblasts:
            merged = episodes(df, oblast, start, end)
            minutes = (merged.finished_at - merged.started_at).dt.total_seconds() / 60
            output.append({"oblast": oblast, "exact_share": shares[oblast],
                           "touch60_share": grid60[oblast].mean(), "touch30_share": grid30[oblast].mean(),
                           "kyiv_days_present": int(daily[oblast].sum()), "kyiv_days": len(daily),
                           "kyiv_daily_presence_share": daily[oblast].mean(), "episodes": len(merged),
                           "median_episode_minutes": minutes.median(), "total_hours": minutes.sum() / 60})
        return pd.DataFrame(output).set_index("oblast"), grid60
    
    
    def pair_table(a: pd.DataFrame, b: pd.DataFrame, name_a: str, name_b: str,
                   start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp, period: str,
                   oblasts: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Exact unions first; conditional touch probabilities are descriptive."""
        if end <= start or not oblasts:
            return pd.DataFrame()
        ma, ga = source_metrics(a, start, end, oblasts)
        mb, gb = source_metrics(b, start, end, oblasts)
        together = (ga & gb).sum()
        result = ma.add_prefix("a_").join(mb.add_prefix("b_"))
        result["p_a_given_b_60min"] = together / gb.sum().replace(0, np.nan)
        result["p_b_given_a_60min"] = together / ga.sum().replace(0, np.nan)
        result["source_a"], result["source_b"] = name_a, name_b
        result["period"], result["start_utc"], result["end_utc"] = period, start.isoformat(), end.isoformat()
        return result.reset_index()
    
    
    def official_periods(end: pd.Timestamp, start: pd.Timestamp) -> list[tuple[str, pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]]:
        bounds = [("full", start, end), ("2023", utc("2023-01-01"), utc("2024-01-01")),
                  ("2024", utc("2024-01-01"), utc("2025-01-01")),
                  ("2025-01..06", utc("2025-01-01"), utc("2025-07-01")),
                  ("2025-12..2026-01", utc("2025-12-01"), utc("2026-02-01")),
                  ("2026-02..valid_end", utc("2026-02-01"), end)]
        return [(label, max(a, start), min(b, end)) for label, a, b in bounds if min(b, end) > max(a, start)]
    
    
    def month_windows(start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp) -> list[tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]]:
        first = start.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        boundaries = pd.date_range(first, end, freq="MS")
        return [(max(a, start), min(a + pd.offsets.MonthBegin(), end)) for a in boundaries
                if min(a + pd.offsets.MonthBegin(), end) > max(a, start)]
    
    
    def monthly_shares(sources: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], start: pd.Timestamp,
                       end: pd.Timestamp, oblasts: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        output = []
        for a, b in month_windows(start, end):
            shares = {name: exact_share(df, a, b).reindex(oblasts, fill_value=0) for name, df in sources.items()}
            for oblast in oblasts:
                row = {"oblast": oblast, "month": a.strftime("%Y-%m"), "start_utc": a.isoformat(), "end_utc": b.isoformat()}
                row.update({name: values[oblast] for name, values in shares.items()})
                row["B_minus_volunteer"] = row["official_B"] - row["volunteer"]
                output.append(row)
        return pd.DataFrame(output)
    
    
    def variant_table(official: pd.DataFrame, end: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        rows = []
        for label, start, stop in [("2024", utc("2024-01-01"), utc("2025-01-01")),
                                   ("2026-02..valid_end", utc("2026-02-01"), end)]:
            stop = min(stop, end)
            if stop <= start:
                continue
            values = {v: exact_share(official_variant(official, v), start, stop) for v in "ABCD"}
            for oblast in sorted(official.oblast.unique()):
                rows.append({"period": label, "oblast": oblast, "start_utc": start.isoformat(), "end_utc": stop.isoformat(),
                             **{v: shares.get(oblast, 0.0) for v, shares in values.items()}})
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
    
    
    def fact3_regression(official: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Explicit untrimmed windows reproduce the supplied regression definition."""
        rows = []
        for period, start, end in [("2024", utc("2024-01-01"), utc("2025-01-01")),
                                   ("2026", utc("2026-02-01"), utc("2026-09-07"))]:
            values = {v: exact_share(official_variant(official, v), start, end) for v in "ABCD"}
            for oblast, expected in FACT3[period].items():
                actual = {v: values[v].get(oblast, 0.0) for v in "ABCD"}
                rows.append({"period": period, "oblast": oblast, "start_utc": start.isoformat(), "end_utc": end.isoformat(),
                             **actual, **{f"expected_{v}": n for v, n in zip("ABC", expected)},
                             "discrepancy_gt002": any(abs(actual[v] - n) > .002 for v, n in zip("ABC", expected))})
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
    
    
    def hromada_drivers(official: pd.DataFrame, end: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        rows = official.loc[official.level.eq("hromada")].copy()
        keys = ["oblast", "raion", "hromada"]
        first = rows.groupby(keys, dropna=False).started_at.min()
        output = []
        for label, start, stop in [("2023-06..2024-01", utc("2023-06-01"), utc("2024-02-01")),
                                   ("2024-02..2024-12", utc("2024-02-01"), utc("2025-01-01")),
                                   ("2026-02..valid_end", utc("2026-02-01"), end)]:
            records = []
            for key, group in window_rows(rows, start, min(stop, end)).groupby(keys, dropna=False):
                merged = episodes(group, key[0], start, min(stop, end))
                hours = (merged.finished_at - merged.started_at).dt.total_seconds().sum() / 3600
                records.append(dict(zip(keys, key), row_count=len(group), union_hours=hours, first_appearance=str(first.loc[key])))
            frame = pd.DataFrame(records)
            if frame.empty:
                continue
            for ranking, metric in [("row_count", "row_count"), ("union_hours", "union_hours")]:
                top = frame.sort_values([metric, *keys], ascending=[False, True, True, True]).head(10)
                output.extend(top.assign(period=label, ranking=ranking, rank=range(1, len(top) + 1),
                                         start_utc=start.isoformat(), end_utc=min(stop, end).isoformat()).to_dict(orient="records"))
        return pd.DataFrame(output)
    
    
    def long_tables(official: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
        rows = official.assign(duration_days=(official.finished_at - official.started_at).dt.total_seconds() / 86400)
        rows = rows.loc[rows.duration_days.gt(1)]
        counts = rows.groupby(["oblast", "level"]).size().rename("count").reset_index()
        locations = rows.fillna({"raion": "", "hromada": ""}).groupby(["oblast", "level", "raion", "hromada"])
        top = locations.agg(count=("duration_days", "size"), summed_interval_days=("duration_days", "sum")).reset_index()
        top = top.sort_values(["count", "oblast", "raion", "hromada"], ascending=[False, True, True, True]).head(20)
        return {"long_counts": counts, "long_top_locations": top,
                "longest_20": rows.sort_values(["duration_days", "started_at"], ascending=[False, True]).head(20)}
    
    
    def template_group(template: str) -> str:
        text = template.casefold()
        if "повітряна тривога" in text or "відбій тривоги" in text:
            return "siren"
        if "артобстр" in text:
            return "artillery"
        if "бпла" in text or "дрон" in text:
            return "UAV"
        if "каб" in text:
            return "KAB"
        if "ракет" in text or "баліст" in text or "балист" in text:
            return "ballistic-missile"
        return "other"
    
    
    def census_tables(paths: list[Path]) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
        data = []
        for path in sorted(paths):
            frame = pd.read_csv(path)
            frame["file"] = path.name
            frame["template_group"] = frame.template.map(template_group)
            data.append(frame)
        if not data:
            return (pd.DataFrame(columns=["file", "upstream_class", "level", "template_group", "count"]),
                    pd.DataFrame(columns=["file", "level", "activations", "siren_activations", "siren_share"]))
        combined = pd.concat(data, ignore_index=True)
        groups = combined.groupby(["file", "upstream_class", "level", "template_group"], as_index=False)["count"].sum()
        activated = combined.loc[combined.upstream_class.eq("activated")].copy()
        activated["siren_activations"] = activated["count"].where(activated.template_group.eq("siren"), 0)
        shares = activated.groupby(["file", "level"]).agg(activations=("count", "sum"), siren_activations=("siren_activations", "sum"))
        shares["siren_share"] = shares.siren_activations / shares.activations
        return groups, shares.reset_index()
    
    
    def external_reference(sources: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        start = pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01", tz="Europe/Kyiv").tz_convert("UTC")
        output = []
        for day in ("2026-03-24", "2026-03-25"):
            end = pd.Timestamp(day, tz="Europe/Kyiv").tz_convert("UTC")
            for source, df in sources.items():
                for oblast, reference in REFERENCE_HOURS.items():
                    hours = exact_share(df, oblast, start, end) * (end - start).total_seconds() / 3600
                    output.append({"source": source, "oblast": oblast, "start_utc": start.isoformat(), "end_utc": end.isoformat(),
                                   "end_kyiv": end.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv").isoformat(), "union_hours": hours,
                                   "reference_hours": reference, "ratio_to_reference": hours / reference})
        return pd.DataFrame(output)
    
    
    def intersection_hours(a: pd.DataFrame, b: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str,
                           start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp) -> float:
        aa, bb = episodes(a, oblast, start, end), episodes(b, oblast, start, end)
        left, right, seconds = 0, 0, 0.0
        while left < len(aa) and right < len(bb):
            a0, a1 = aa.iloc[left]
            b0, b1 = bb.iloc[right]
            seconds += max(0, (min(a1, b1) - max(a0, b0)).total_seconds())
            if a1 <= b1:
                left += 1
            else:
                right += 1
        return seconds / 3600
    
    
    def overlap_flags(queries: pd.DataFrame, reference: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str,
                      start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp) -> np.ndarray:
        merged = episodes(reference, oblast, start, end)
        if merged.empty:
            return np.zeros(len(queries), dtype=bool)
        positions = pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.finished_at).searchsorted(queries.started_at.clip(lower=start), side="right")
        valid = positions < len(merged)
        positions = np.minimum(positions, len(merged) - 1)
        return valid & (pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.started_at).take(positions) < pd.DatetimeIndex(queries.finished_at.clip(upper=end)))
    
    
    def api_overlap_tables(api: pd.DataFrame, volunteer: pd.DataFrame, start: pd.Timestamp,
                           end: pd.Timestamp, oblasts: list[str]) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
        counts, red_time = [], []
        for oblast in oblasts:
            volunteers = window_rows(volunteer.loc[volunteer.oblast.eq(oblast)], start, end)
            region = window_rows(api.loc[api.oblast.eq(oblast)], start, end)
            if oblast in {"Lvivska oblast", "Volynska oblast"}:
                for (level, threats), group in region.groupby(["alert_level", "threat_types"], dropna=False):
                    number = int(overlap_flags(volunteers, group, oblast, start, end).sum())
                    counts.append({"oblast": oblast, "api_alert_level": level or "none", "api_threat_types": threats or "none",
                                   "volunteer_intervals": len(volunteers), "overlapping_volunteer_intervals": number,
                                   "share": number / len(volunteers) if len(volunteers) else np.nan,
                                   "start_utc": start.isoformat(), "end_utc": end.isoformat()})
            red = region.loc[region.alert_level.eq("red")]
            hours = exact_share(red, oblast, start, end) * (end - start).total_seconds() / 3600
            overlap = intersection_hours(red, volunteers, oblast, start, end)
            red_time.append({"oblast": oblast, "api_red_hours": hours, "red_hours_covered_by_volunteer": overlap,
                             "share_api_red_time_covered": overlap / hours if hours else np.nan,
                             "start_utc": start.isoformat(), "end_utc": end.isoformat()})
        return pd.DataFrame(counts), pd.DataFrame(red_time)
    
    
    def api_counts(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        rows = []
        for field in ("alert_type", "alert_level", "location_type", "oblast", "oblast_resolution"):
            for value, count in frame[field].fillna("none").replace("", "none").value_counts().sort_index().items():
                rows.append({"field": field, "value": value, "count": count})
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
    
    
    def write_tables(tables: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], out: Path) -> None:
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name, table in tables.items():
            table.to_csv(out / f"{name}.csv", index=False, float_format="%.12g")
    
    
    def markdown_table(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
        """Render without an extra tabulate dependency."""
        if frame.empty:
            return "No rows."
        lines = ["| " + " | ".join(map(str, frame.columns)) + " |", "| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(frame.columns)) + " |"]
        for row in frame.itertuples(index=False, name=None):
            cells = [f"{value:.6f}" if isinstance(value, float) else str(value) for value in row]
            lines.append("| " + " | ".join(cell.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ") for cell in cells) + " |")
        return "\n".join(lines)
    
    
    def write_summary(tables: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], notes: list[str], out: Path) -> None:
        paragraphs = ["# Source comparison — descriptive only", *notes,
                      "All windows are half-open [start, end), in UTC unless marked Europe/Kyiv. "
                      "Exact shares use union time with second/subsecond precision. Sources are never merged or averaged. "
                      "All counts, conditional grid probabilities, differences, episode lengths and reference ratios are descriptive; "
                      "no targets, splits, features, models or forecast evaluation are created.",
                      "Tail rule: max(started_at) − 48 h per original source, bounded by max(fetched_at) for API. "
                      "Compute before definition/region/naive filters; clip intervals at each pair's earlier valid end. "
                      "Open API alerts are counted separately and excluded from every interval metric. "
                      "Touch shares weight bins equally, including a partial final bin. Daily presence uses Kyiv calendar boundaries "
                      "with DST and includes partial boundary days. Episodes merge strict overlaps; abutting intervals remain separate. "
                      "An empty conditional denominator is blank/NaN, not zero.",
                      "Pair A/B labels in conditional columns refer to source_a/source_b, not official definition variants. "
                      "The API pairs use A=API-ALL or API-RED and B=volunteer. "
                      "API-level/threat overlap categories are non-exclusive: one volunteer interval can appear in several categories."]
        pairs = pd.concat([tables.get("official_volunteer", pd.DataFrame()), tables.get("api_volunteer", pd.DataFrame())], ignore_index=True)
        if not pairs.empty:
            columns = ["source_a", "source_b", "period", "start_utc", "end_utc"]
            paragraphs += ["## Explicit pairs and windows", markdown_table(pairs[columns].drop_duplicates())]
        paragraphs += ["## Excluded regions", markdown_table(tables["excluded_regions"]),
                       "## Input inventory and cheaply checked facts", markdown_table(tables["inventory"]),
                       "## Fact 3 regression (explicit untrimmed reference windows)", markdown_table(tables["fact3_regression"]),
                       "## External reference (user-supplied; not retrieved offline)",
                       "[Reference](https://www.slovoidilo.ua/2026/03/24/infografika/suspilstvo/yakyx-oblastyax-prolunalo-najbilshe-najmenshe-povitryanyx-tryvoh-pochatku-roku)",
                       markdown_table(tables["external_reference"]),
                       "## INDIRECT bridge — windows do not overlap", markdown_table(tables.get("indirect_bridge", pd.DataFrame())),
                       "## CSV tables", "\n".join(f"- [{name}.csv]({name}.csv): {len(frame)} rows" for name, frame in tables.items())]
        (out / "source_comparison.md").write_text("\n\n".join(paragraphs) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    
    
    def plot_reports(out: Path) -> None:
        """Render already-produced tables; no inputs or network are fetched."""
        import matplotlib
        matplotlib.use("Agg")
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    
        monthly = pd.read_csv(out / "monthly_exact_shares.csv")
        heat = monthly.pivot(index="oblast", columns="month", values="B_minus_volunteer").sort_index()
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(12, len(heat.columns) * .28), 8))
        bound = max(.01, float(np.nanmax(np.abs(heat.to_numpy()))))
        image = ax.imshow(heat, aspect="auto", cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-bound, vmax=bound)
        ax.set_yticks(range(len(heat)), heat.index)
        ticks = list(range(0, len(heat.columns), 3))
        ax.set_xticks(ticks, heat.columns[ticks], rotation=60, ha="right")
        ax.set_title("Official B − volunteer: monthly exact coverage share (descriptive)")
        fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label="Share difference")
        fig.tight_layout()
        fig.savefig(out / "monthly_exact_difference.png", dpi=160)
        plt.close(fig)
        for oblast in PLOT_OBLASTS:
            frame = monthly.loc[monthly.oblast.eq(oblast)]
            if frame.empty:
                continue
            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 4))
            for column in ("official_A", "official_B", "volunteer", "volunteer_no_naive"):
                ax.plot(pd.to_datetime(frame.month), frame[column], label=column)
            ax.set(title=f"{oblast}: monthly exact coverage (descriptive)", ylabel="Exact share", ylim=(0, 1))
            ax.legend(ncol=2)
            fig.autofmt_xdate()
            fig.tight_layout()
            fig.savefig(out / (oblast.replace(" ", "_") + ".png"), dpi=160)
            plt.close(fig)
    
    
    def run_comparison(raw_dir: Path, api_path: Path, census_dir: Path, out: Path,
                       start: pd.Timestamp, end_cap: pd.Timestamp | None = None, plots: bool = True) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
        official = Source.prepare("official", load_official(raw_dir / "official_data_en.csv"))
        volunteer = Source.prepare("volunteer", load_volunteer(raw_dir / "volunteer_data_en.csv"))
        end = min(official.end, volunteer.end, end_cap or official.end)
        oblasts = sorted(set(official.rows.oblast) & set(volunteer.rows.oblast))
        definitions = {"official_" + v: official_variant(official.rows, v) for v in "AB"}
        volunteers = {"volunteer": volunteer.rows, "volunteer_no_naive": volunteer.rows.loc[~volunteer.rows.naive]}
        notes = ["Existing components retained: official/volunteer loaders, UTC interval grid and exact unions, "
                 "read-only audit, Telegram topup/census, API collector and their tests. "
                 "The API collector is not run by this program.",
                 "Official primary definition is B (oblast+raion); A and D are sensitivities. "
                 "The official CSV has no alert-type field; variant B is a level-based definition, not a row-level siren label.",
                 "Volunteer channel provenance is user-supplied UkraineAlarmSignal; the CSV has no channel field, so provenance "
                 "cannot be independently verified from that file. Earlier documentation naming eTryvoga is superseded by this supplied fact."]
        excluded = []
        inventory = []
        for source in (official, volunteer):
            inventory.append({"source": source.name, "rows": len(source.full), "min_started_at": str(source.full.started_at.min()),
                              "max_started_at": str(source.full.started_at.max()), "max_finished_at": str(source.full.finished_at.max()),
                              "valid_end": str(source.end), "oblasts": source.full.oblast.nunique(), "open_rows": 0})
            excluded.extend({"source": source.name, "oblast": name, "rows": count}
                            for name, count in source.full.loc[source.full.oblast.isin(EXCLUDED)].oblast.value_counts().items())
        if len(official.full) != 185430:
            notes.append(f"FACT discrepancy: official deduplicated row count is {len(official.full)}, expected 185430.")
        if official.full.finished_at.max().date().isoformat() != "2026-09-07":
            notes.append("FACT discrepancy: official does not end on 2026-09-07.")
        if volunteer.full.finished_at.max().date().isoformat() != "2026-10-10":
            notes.append("FACT discrepancy: volunteer does not end on 2026-10-10.")
        pair_frames = [pair_table(a, b, na, nb, low, high, label, oblasts)
                       for label, low, high in official_periods(end, start)
                       for na, a in definitions.items() for nb, b in volunteers.items()]
        tables = {"official_volunteer": pd.concat(pair_frames, ignore_index=True),
                  "monthly_exact_shares": monthly_shares({**definitions, **volunteers}, start, end, oblasts),
                  "variants": variant_table(official.rows, min(official.end, end_cap or official.end)),
                  "fact3_regression": fact3_regression(without_exclusions(official.full)),
                  "hromada_drivers": hromada_drivers(official.rows, min(official.end, end_cap or official.end)),
                  "external_reference": external_reference({**definitions, "volunteer": volunteer.rows}),
                  **long_tables(official.rows)}
        if tables["fact3_regression"].discrepancy_gt002.any():
            notes.append("FACT discrepancy: Fact 3 differs by >.002 in rows flagged in fact3_regression.csv.")
        for source, lower, upper in [("official_B", 1762, 1784), ("official_A", 1968, 1992)]:
            values = tables["external_reference"].loc[(tables["external_reference"].source.eq(source)) &
                                                      tables["external_reference"].oblast.eq("Dnipropetrovska oblast"), "union_hours"]
            if ((values < lower - 1) | (values > upper + 1)).any():
                notes.append(f"FACT discrepancy: {source} Dnipropetrovska external-reference hours outside supplied range (±1 h rounding).")
        dated = sorted(census_dir.glob("census_message_templates_*.csv"))
        tables["census_groups"], tables["census_siren_shares"] = census_tables(dated)
        if not dated:
            notes.append("SKIPPED dated template aggregations: census_message_templates_*.csv is missing.")
        legacy = census_dir / "census_message_templates.csv"
        if legacy.exists():
            groups, shares = census_tables([legacy])
            messages = int(groups["count"].sum())
            notes.append(f"Existing undated census contains {messages} messages; it is inventoried separately, not relabelled or combined with dated censuses.")
            tables["legacy_census_groups"], tables["legacy_census_siren_shares"] = groups, shares
        notes.append("2026 census totals and the June 2026 break cannot be checked unless their date-ranged census files are present. "
                     "Telegram silence is supplied context; offline CSV endpoints cannot verify live channel silence.")
        if api_path.exists():
            api_full = load_alerts_in_ua(api_path, air_raid_only=False)
            api = Source.prepare("alerts.in.ua", api_full)
            covered = sorted(set(without_exclusions(api_full).oblast))
            api_all = api.rows.loc[api.rows.alert_type.eq("air_raid")]
            api_red = api_all.loc[api_all.alert_level.eq("red")]
            names = sorted(set(covered) & set(volunteer.rows.oblast))
            low = max(api_full.started_at.min(), volunteer.full.started_at.min())
            high = min(api.end, volunteer.end, end_cap or api.end)
            notes.append(f"API file covers {len(covered)} non-excluded oblasts: {', '.join(covered)}. "
                         "Partial coverage is retained; absent oblasts are not treated as zero alerts. "
                         "The API pair window starts at the earliest observed API start; earlier coverage is not inferred.")
            fallback = int(api_full.oblast_resolution.ne("location_oblast_uid").sum())
            if fallback:
                notes.append(f"FACT discrepancy in API UID schema: {fallback}/{len(api_full)} rows require an oblast name/query fallback; "
                             "location_oblast_uid does not identify their oblast. Resolution methods are in api_counts.csv.")
            if not api_full.location_type.eq("raion").all():
                notes.append("FACT discrepancy: the current API CSV also contains non-raion rows; API ALL/RED OR all its air_raid levels. See api_counts.csv.")
            inventory.append({"source": "alerts.in.ua", "rows": len(api_full), "min_started_at": str(api_full.started_at.min()),
                              "max_started_at": str(api_full.started_at.max()), "max_finished_at": str(api_full.finished_at.max()),
                              "valid_end": str(api.end), "oblasts": api_full.oblast.nunique(), "open_rows": int(api_full.is_open.sum())})
            excluded.extend({"source": "alerts.in.ua", "oblast": name, "rows": count}
                            for name, count in api_full.loc[api_full.oblast.isin(EXCLUDED)].oblast.value_counts().items())
            tables["api_counts"] = api_counts(api_full)
            threats = api_full.assign(nonempty_threats=api_full.threat_types.ne(""))
            tables["api_threat_shares"] = threats.groupby("alert_level", dropna=False).agg(
                rows=("id", "size"), nonempty_threat_rows=("nonempty_threats", "sum"),
                nonempty_threat_share=("nonempty_threats", "mean")).reset_index()
            tables["api_open_counts"] = api_full.groupby("oblast", as_index=False).agg(rows=("is_open", "size"), open_rows=("is_open", "sum"))
            if high > low and names:
                tables["api_volunteer"] = pd.concat([pair_table(a, b, na, nb, low, high, "API overlap", names)
                                                     for na, a in {"API-ALL": api_all, "API-RED": api_red}.items()
                                                     for nb, b in volunteers.items()], ignore_index=True)
                tables["api_alert_overlap"], tables["api_red_time_coverage"] = api_overlap_tables(api_all, volunteer.rows, low, high, names)
                bridge = []
                earlier = utc("2026-08-01")
                earlier_end = min(official.end, volunteer.end)
                for oblast in names:
                    bridge.append({"label": "INDIRECT", "oblast": oblast, "official_start_utc": earlier.isoformat(),
                                   "official_end_utc": earlier_end.isoformat(), "api_start_utc": low.isoformat(), "api_end_utc": high.isoformat(),
                                   "windows_do_not_overlap": earlier_end <= low,
                                   "official_B": exact_share(definitions["official_B"], oblast, earlier, earlier_end),
                                   "volunteer_official_window": exact_share(volunteer.rows, oblast, earlier, earlier_end),
                                   "API_ALL": exact_share(api_all, oblast, low, high), "API_RED": exact_share(api_red, oblast, low, high),
                                   "volunteer_API_window": exact_share(volunteer.rows, oblast, low, high)})
                tables["indirect_bridge"] = pd.DataFrame(bridge)
                if not tables["indirect_bridge"].windows_do_not_overlap.all():
                    notes.append("FACT discrepancy: some bridge windows overlap; INDIRECT label is a comparison of different windows, see boolean column.")
            else:
                notes.append("SKIPPED API comparison: no usable trimmed overlap or common covered oblasts.")
        else:
            notes.append(f"SKIPPED alerts.in.ua comparison: {api_path} is missing.")
        tables["inventory"] = pd.DataFrame(inventory)
        tables["excluded_regions"] = pd.DataFrame(excluded, columns=["source", "oblast", "rows"])
        notes.append("Configured exclusions: Luhanska oblast, Crimea and Sevastopol. Only actually present excluded regions appear below.")
        write_tables(tables, out)
        write_summary(tables, notes, out)
        if plots:
            plot_reports(out)
        for note in notes:
            print(note)
        print("Fact 3 regression:\n" + tables["fact3_regression"].to_string(index=False))
        print("External-reference union hours:\n" + tables["external_reference"].to_string(index=False))
        return tables

    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import pytest
    
    from airalerts.compare import daily_presence, intersection_hours, overlap_flags, pair_table, template_group, utc
    from airalerts.grid import episodes, exact_share, time_grid
    from airalerts.io import official_variant, valid_end
    
    
    def frame(rows: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        result = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["oblast", "level", "started_at", "finished_at"])
        for col in ("started_at", "finished_at"):
            result[col] = pd.to_datetime(result[col], utc=True, format="ISO8601")
        return result
    
    
    def test_definition_variants_do_not_mix_oblasts() -> None:
        df = frame([("A", "oblast", "2026-01-01", "2026-01-01 01:00"),
                    ("A", "raion", "2026-01-01", "2026-01-02 06:00"),
                    ("A", "hromada", "2026-01-01", "2026-01-01 02:00"),
                    ("B", "hromada", "2026-01-01", "2026-01-02 06:00")])
        assert official_variant(df, "A").index.tolist() == [0, 1, 2, 3]
        assert official_variant(df, "B").index.tolist() == [0, 1]
        assert official_variant(df, "C").index.tolist() == [0, 2]
        assert official_variant(df, "D").index.tolist() == [0]
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            official_variant(df, "E")
    
    
    def test_half_open_30min_union_and_episodes() -> None:
        df = frame([("A", "raion", "2026-01-01 14:40", "2026-01-01 15:10"),
                    ("A", "hromada", "2026-01-01 14:50", "2026-01-01 15:20"),
                    ("A", "oblast", "2026-01-01 15:30", "2026-01-01 16:00")])
        assert time_grid(df, "2026-01-01 14:00", "2026-01-01 16:00", "30min")["A"].tolist() == [False, True, True, True]
        assert len(episodes(df, "A", "2026-01-01 14:00", "2026-01-01 16:00")) == 2
        assert exact_share(df, "A", "2026-01-01 14:00", "2026-01-01 16:00") == pytest.approx(70 / 120)
    
    
    def test_tail_uses_starts_not_closures() -> None:
        df = frame([("A", "oblast", "2026-01-01", "2026-02-01"),
                    ("A", "oblast", "2026-01-05", "2026-01-05 01:00")])
        assert valid_end(df) == utc("2026-01-03")
    
    
    def test_conditional_probabilities_and_intersection() -> None:
        a = frame([("A", "raion", "2026-01-01 00:00", "2026-01-01 02:00")])
        b = frame([("A", "oblast", "2026-01-01 01:00", "2026-01-01 03:00")])
        start, end = utc("2026-01-01"), utc("2026-01-01 04:00")
        row = pair_table(a, b, "a", "b", start, end, "test", ["A"]).iloc[0]
        assert row.p_a_given_b_60min == .5
        assert row.p_b_given_a_60min == .5
        assert row.a_total_hours == 2
        assert intersection_hours(a, b, "A", start, end) == 1
        assert overlap_flags(b, a, "A", start, end).tolist() == [True]
        later = b.copy()
        later["started_at"] = utc("2026-01-01 02:00")
        assert overlap_flags(later, a, "A", start, end).tolist() == [False]
        zero = pair_table(a, b.iloc[:0], "a", "b", start, end, "test", ["A"]).iloc[0]
        assert np.isnan(zero.p_a_given_b_60min)
    
    
    def test_kyiv_daily_presence_dst() -> None:
        start = pd.Timestamp("2026-03-28", tz="Europe/Kyiv").tz_convert("UTC")
        end = pd.Timestamp("2026-03-31", tz="Europe/Kyiv").tz_convert("UTC")
        df = frame([("A", "raion", "2026-03-28 23:30", "2026-03-29 00:30")])
        daily = daily_presence(df, start, end, ["A"])
        assert daily["A"].tolist() == [False, True, False]
        assert (daily.index[2] - daily.index[1]).total_seconds() == 23 * 3600
    
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("text,group", [("Повітряна тривога", "siren"), ("Відбій загрози застосування КАБ", "KAB"),
                                            ("Загроза артобстрілу", "artillery"), ("Загроза ударних БпЛА", "UAV"),
                                            ("Загроза балістичного удару", "ballistic-missile")])
    def test_template_groups(text: str, group: str) -> None:
        assert template_group(text) == group

    """Render offline CSV reports with matplotlib; no data collection imports."""
    
    import csv
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    
    
    def plot_reports(out: Path) -> None:
        import matplotlib
        matplotlib.use("Agg")
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    
        with (out / "monthly_exact_shares.csv").open(encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
        if not rows:
            raise ValueError("No monthly comparison rows to plot")
        oblasts = sorted({row["oblast"] for row in rows})
        months = sorted({row["month"] for row in rows})
        heat = np.full((len(oblasts), len(months)), np.nan)
        for row in rows:
            heat[oblasts.index(row["oblast"]), months.index(row["month"])] = float(row["B_minus_volunteer"])
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(12, len(months) * .28), 8))
        bound = max(.01, float(np.nanmax(np.abs(heat))))
        image = ax.imshow(heat, aspect="auto", cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-bound, vmax=bound)
        ax.set_yticks(range(len(oblasts)), oblasts)
        ticks = list(range(0, len(months), 3))
        ax.set_xticks(ticks, [months[index] for index in ticks], rotation=60, ha="right")
        ax.set_title("Official B − volunteer: monthly exact coverage share (descriptive)")
        fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label="Share difference")
        fig.tight_layout()
        fig.savefig(out / "monthly_exact_difference.png", dpi=160)
        plt.close(fig)
        for oblast in ["Lvivska oblast", "Volynska oblast", "Kharkivska oblast", "Odeska oblast", "Kyiv City"]:
            selected = sorted((row for row in rows if row["oblast"] == oblast), key=lambda row: row["month"])
            if not selected:
                continue
            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 4))
            for column in ("official_A", "official_B", "volunteer", "volunteer_no_naive"):
                ax.plot([datetime.fromisoformat(row["month"] + "-01") for row in selected],
                        [float(row[column]) for row in selected], label=column)
            ax.set(title=f"{oblast}: monthly exact coverage (descriptive)", ylabel="Exact share", ylim=(0, 1))
            ax.legend(ncol=2)
            fig.autofmt_xdate()
            fig.tight_layout()
            fig.savefig(out / (oblast.replace(" ", "_") + ".png"), dpi=160)
            plt.close(fig)

    # Project: per-oblast air-raid alert forecasting (Ukraine)
    
    Goal: for each oblast, forecast P(alert touches hour h) at forecast time T, evaluated on the latest period. No data leakage.
    
    ## Forecast setup
    - PRIMARY: each lead 1..6 h ahead as a separate target. Lead 0 is reported separately, never pooled.
    - SECONDARY (contrast): leads 12 and 24 h.
    - EXTRA metric, only if time allows: event window "any alert in [T, T+W)".
    - Do not choose a horizon by test score. Do NOT implement train/val/test splits yet; only prepare data.
    
    ## Data decisions (changes go to docs/DECISIONS.md)
    - `official` (Telegram air_alert_ua, structured, levels oblast/raion/hromada) is PRIMARY. `volunteer` (eTryvoga, keyword-parsed, oblast level) is a robustness check. Never average or merge them.
    - official_data_en.csv has an exact duplicated block: `drop_duplicates()` right after reading (expected 299,275 -> 185,430 rows).
    - All timestamps are UTC (= Telegram publication time, not siren time). Convert to Europe/Kyiv only for daily reporting.
    - Target: alert(oblast, hour) = 1 iff ANY interval of ANY level in the oblast touches [h, h+1h).
    - Exclude Luhanska oblast and Crimea.
    - Intervals are written only when closed, so each file is right-censored: trim the last 48 h of every source.
    - volunteer `naive` = imputed end (+30 min). official: duration == 3600 s is a heuristic imputation flag (~0.1% of rows).
    - Hourly "touch" inflates up to ~3.3x observed; ~1x for saturated oblasts. Compare SOURCES by exact minutes; use the hourly grid only for modelling.
    - Do not model alert counts or durations (parser artifacts).
    
    ## Leakage rules
    - A feature for forecast time T may use only events with started_at <= T. finished_at counts as known only if <= T; otherwise the alert is "ongoing".
    - Time-based splits only. Fit anything (scalers, encoders) on the training window only.
    
    ## Code rules
    - Task 1 needs no network or secrets. Later collect tasks may use the network, but never read, print or write tokens; credentials come from env vars only.
    - Never modify data/raw. Inspect files before assuming column names.
    - Type hints, small pure functions, pytest tests, no absolute paths.
    - Keep the repo minimal: create a file only when the current task needs it.

        import json,re,subprocess
        from pathlib import Path
        
        def git(*args):
            return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args])
        keyword=re.compile(r'TG_SESSION|TG_API_HASH|API_HASH|API_SESSION_STRING|ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN|Bearer ')
        long_value=re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_+/=-])[A-Za-z0-9_+/-]{80,}={0,2}(?![A-Za-z0-9_+/=-])')
        assignment=re.compile(r'''(?:TG_SESSION|TG_API_HASH|API_HASH|API_SESSION_STRING|ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN)\s*[=:]\s*["']([^"'\n]+)["']''')
        hits=[]
        
        def scan(path, data, scope, commit):
            if path.endswith('.session') or Path(path).name == '.env' or Path(path).name.startswith('.env.'):
                hits.append({'scope':scope,'file':path,'commit':commit,'kind':'sensitive filename','value_prefix':'not printed'})
            if b'\0' in data:
                return
            try: text=data.decode('utf-8')
            except UnicodeError: return
            references={}
            for number,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
                for match in keyword.finditer(line):
                    key=match.group()
                    references.setdefault(key,[]).append(number)
                for match in assignment.finditer(line):
                    value=match.group(1)
                    hits.append({'scope':scope,'file':path,'commit':commit,'line':number,'kind':'literal credential candidate','value_prefix':value[:4]})
                for match in long_value.finditer(line):
                    hits.append({'scope':scope,'file':path,'commit':commit,'line':number,'kind':'long base64-like candidate','value_prefix':match.group()[:4]})
            for key,lines in sorted(references.items()):
                hits.append({'scope':scope,'file':path,'commit':commit,'kind':'keyword/reference','name':key.strip(),'lines':lines})
        
        tracked=git('ls-files','-z').decode().split('\0')
        for path in filter(None,tracked):
            if Path(path).is_file(): scan(path,Path(path).read_bytes(),'tracked working tree','index')
        commits=git('rev-list','--all').decode().splitlines()
        for commit in commits:
            entries=git('ls-tree','-rz','--full-tree',commit).split(b'\0')
            for entry in filter(None,entries):
                meta,path=entry.split(b'\t',1)
                mode,kind,oid=meta.split()
                if kind==b'blob': scan(path.decode(),git('cat-file','blob',oid.decode()),'history',commit)
        for path in sorted(Path('.').rglob('*')):
            if not path.is_file() or any(part in ('.git','.venv','__pycache__') for part in path.parts): continue
            rel=path.as_posix()
            if rel not in tracked: scan(rel,path.read_bytes(),'untracked/ignored working tree','not committed')
        print('REACHABLE_COMMITS_SCANNED',len(commits))
        print('TRACKED_AND_HISTORY_HITS',sum(h['scope'] in ('history','tracked working tree') for h in hits))
        for hit in hits: print(json.dumps(hit,ensure_ascii=False))
        print('CANDIDATE_VALUE_HITS',sum(h['kind']!='keyword/reference' for h in hits))
        PY

        import ast
        from pathlib import Path
        sources=list(Path('src').rglob('*.py'))+list(Path('tests').glob('*.py'))+list(Path('scripts').glob('*.py'))
        for source in sorted(sources):
            tree=ast.parse(source.read_text())
            imports=[]
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                if isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom):
                    imports.append((node.module or '')+':'+','.join(a.name for a in node.names))
                if isinstance(node,ast.Import): imports.extend(a.name for a in node.names)
            print(str(source), 'IMPORTS', '; '.join(i for i in imports if 'airalerts' in i), 'CLI=',any(isinstance(n,ast.If) and isinstance(n.test,ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.test.left,ast.Name) and n.test.left.id=='__name__' for n in tree.body))

        import re,subprocess
        from pathlib import Path
        credential=re.compile(r'''(?:TG_SESSION|TG_API_HASH|API_HASH|API_SESSION_STRING|ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN)["']?\s*[=:]\s*["']?([A-Za-z0-9_+/=-]{16,})''',re.IGNORECASE)
        bearer=re.compile(r'Bearer\s+([A-Za-z0-9_+/=-]{12,})')
        hexhash=re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])[0-9a-fA-F]{32}(?![A-Za-z0-9])')
        found=0
        for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
            if not path.is_file() or any(part in ('.git','.venv','__pycache__') for part in path.parts):continue
            try:text=path.read_text()
            except (UnicodeError,OSError):continue
            for n,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
                for kind,pat in [('credential literal',credential),('Bearer literal',bearer),('32-hex candidate',hexhash)]:
                    for match in pat.finditer(line):
                        found+=1
                        val=match.group(1) if kind!='32-hex candidate' else match.group()
                        print('CANDIDATE',str(path),'line',n,'commit=not committed','kind='+kind,'prefix='+val[:4])
        print('ADDITIONAL_LITERAL_CANDIDATES',found)
        entries=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage','-z']).split(b'\0')
        index_hits=0
        for entry in filter(None,entries):
            meta,name=entry.split(b'\t',1); mode,oid,stage=meta.split()
            data=subprocess.check_output(['git','cat-file','blob',oid.decode()])
            if any(p.search(data.decode(errors='replace')) for p in (credential,bearer,hexhash)) or re.search(rb'TG_SESSION|TG_API_HASH|API_HASH|ALERTS_IN_UA_TOKEN',data):
                index_hits+=1
                print('INDEX_HIT',name.decode(),'blob='+oid.decode(),'details suppressed')
        print('STAGED_INDEX_HITS',index_hits)
        PY

    # Project: per-oblast air-raid alert forecasting (Ukraine)
    
    Goal: for each oblast, forecast P(alert touches hour h) at forecast time T, evaluated on the latest period. No data leakage.
    
    ## Forecast setup
    - PRIMARY: each lead 1..6 h ahead as a separate target. Lead 0 is reported separately, never pooled.
    - SECONDARY (contrast): leads 12 and 24 h.
    - EXTRA metric, only if time allows: event window "any alert in [T, T+W)".
    - Do not choose a horizon by test score. Do NOT implement train/val/test splits yet; only prepare data.
    
    ## Data decisions (changes go to docs/DECISIONS.md)
    - `official` (Telegram air_alert_ua, structured, levels oblast/raion/hromada) is PRIMARY. `volunteer` (eTryvoga, keyword-parsed, oblast level) is a robustness check. Never average or merge them.
    - official_data_en.csv has an exact duplicated block: `drop_duplicates()` right after reading (expected 299,275 -> 185,430 rows).
    - All timestamps are UTC (= Telegram publication time, not siren time). Convert to Europe/Kyiv only for daily reporting.
    - Target: alert(oblast, hour) = 1 iff ANY interval of ANY level in the oblast touches [h, h+1h).
    - Exclude Luhanska oblast and Crimea.
    - Intervals are written only when closed, so each file is right-censored: trim the last 48 h of every source.
    - volunteer `naive` = imputed end (+30 min). official: duration == 3600 s is a heuristic imputation flag (~0.1% of rows).
    - Hourly "touch" inflates up to ~3.3x observed; ~1x for saturated oblasts. Compare SOURCES by exact minutes; use the hourly grid only for modelling.
    - Do not model alert counts or durations (parser artifacts).
    
    ## Leakage rules
    - A feature for forecast time T may use only events with started_at <= T. finished_at counts as known only if <= T; otherwise the alert is "ongoing".
    - Time-based splits only. Fit anything (scalers, encoders) on the training window only.
    
    ## Code rules
    - Task 1 needs no network or secrets. Later collect tasks may use the network, but never read, print or write tokens; credentials come from env vars only.
    - Never modify data/raw. Inspect files before assuming column names.
    - Type hints, small pure functions, pytest tests, no absolute paths.
    - Keep the repo minimal: create a file only when the current task needs it.
    - Final report after each task: files changed, commands run, test output, what you assumed or could not verify. Do not claim results you did not run.

    """Read-only audit: python -m airalerts.audit [--raw-dir data/raw]."""
    
    import argparse
    from pathlib import Path
    import subprocess
    
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import exact_share, hourly_grid
    from airalerts.io import load_official, load_volunteer, trim_tail, valid_end
    
    
    def _table(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
        return "```text\n" + frame.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.12f}") + "\n```"
    
    
    def report(raw_dir: Path) -> str:
        """Measure full-source metadata and window coverage without changing CSVs."""
        sources = {
            "official": load_official(raw_dir / "official_data_en.csv"),
            "volunteer": load_volunteer(raw_dir / "volunteer_data_en.csv"),
        }
        start = pd.Timestamp("2026-02-01", tz="UTC")
        end = min(valid_end(df) for df in sources.values())
        floored = end.floor("h")
        output = ["## Task 1b audit", "VERIFIED: All timestamps below are UTC.",
                  f"VERIFIED: Interval audit window is [{start}, {end}).",
                  f"VERIFIED: Regression window is [{start}, {floored}).",
                  "VERIFIED: Source ends use max(started_at) before exclusions; each source is trimmed independently.",
                  "VERIFIED: Long-interval counts and rankings include intervals touching the audit window; durations are full, unclipped durations. Missing count-table rows mean zero. Luhanska statistics use the full loaded sources."]
        metadata = []
        for name, df in sources.items():
            path = raw_dir / f"{name}_data_en.csv"
            raw = pd.read_csv(path)
            tracked = bool(subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--", str(path)], text=True).strip())
            metadata.append({"source": name, "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                             "raw_rows": len(raw), "exact_unique_rows": len(raw.drop_duplicates()),
                             "loaded_rows": len(df), "git_tracked": tracked})
        output += ["### VERIFIED: Local raw files", _table(pd.DataFrame(metadata))]
        official = trim_tail(sources["official"])
        window = official.loc[official.started_at.lt(end) & official.finished_at.gt(start)]
        long = window.loc[window.duration_s.gt(86400)]
        counts = long.groupby(["oblast", "level"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
        counts = counts.reindex(columns=["oblast", "raion", "hromada"], fill_value=0)
        counts.index.name = "oblast_name"
        output += [f"### VERIFIED: Official >24 h by oblast × level ({len(long)} total)",
                   _table(counts.reset_index())]
        longest = window.assign(duration_days=window.duration_s / 86400).nlargest(10, "duration_days")
        output += ["### VERIFIED: Ten longest official intervals touching the window",
                   _table(longest[["oblast", "raion", "hromada", "level", "started_at", "finished_at", "duration_days"]])]
        official = official.loc[official.oblast.ne("Luhanska oblast")]
        shares = pd.DataFrame({"all_intervals": exact_share(official, start, end),
                               "intervals_le24h": exact_share(official.loc[official.duration_s.le(86400)], start, end)}).fillna(0)
        output += ["### VERIFIED: Official exact shares, original window (fractions; Luhanska excluded)",
                   _table(shares.reset_index()),
                   "VERIFIED: The ≤24 h column is a sensitivity comparison only; source intervals are not removed or rewritten."]
        luhanska = []
        for name, df in sources.items():
            rows = df.loc[df.oblast.eq("Luhanska oblast")]
            durations = (rows.finished_at - rows.started_at).dt.total_seconds()
            luhanska.append({"source": name, "rows": len(rows), "min_started_at": rows.started_at.min(),
                             "max_started_at": rows.started_at.max(), "max_duration_s": durations.max(),
                             "max_duration_days": durations.max() / 86400, "gt24h": int(durations.gt(86400).sum())})
        output += ["### VERIFIED: Luhanska, full source", _table(pd.DataFrame(luhanska))]
        regression = []
        extremes = []
        for name, df in sources.items():
            rows = trim_tail(df)
            rows = rows.loc[rows.oblast.ne("Luhanska oblast")]
            old_hourly, new_hourly = hourly_grid(rows, start, end).mean(), hourly_grid(rows, start, floored).mean()
            old_exact, new_exact = exact_share(rows, start, end), exact_share(rows, start, floored)
            for oblast in ["Lvivska oblast", "Dnipropetrovska oblast", "Kyiv City"]:
                regression.append({"source": name, "oblast": oblast,
                                   "hourly_before": old_hourly[oblast], "hourly_floored": new_hourly[oblast],
                                   "exact_before": old_exact[oblast], "exact_floored": new_exact[oblast],
                                   "hourly_changed": bool(old_hourly[oblast] != new_hourly[oblast]),
                                   "exact_changed": bool(old_exact[oblast] != new_exact[oblast])})
            for threshold, selection in [(">95%", new_exact.gt(.95)), ("<3%", new_exact.lt(.03))]:
                selected = new_exact.loc[selection]
                extremes.append(f"VERIFIED: {name} {threshold}: " +
                                (", ".join(f"{oblast}={share:.12%}" for oblast, share in selected.items()) or "none"))
        output += ["### VERIFIED: Regression comparison (fractions)", _table(pd.DataFrame(regression)),
                   "### VERIFIED: Descriptive extremes, floored window (Luhanska excluded)", *extremes,
                   "VERIFIED: No coverage-threshold exclusions were applied."]
        official_names = set(sources["official"].oblast.dropna())
        volunteer_names = set(sources["volunteer"].oblast.dropna())
        output += [f"VERIFIED: Official-only oblast names: {sorted(official_names - volunteer_names)}.",
                   f"VERIFIED: Volunteer-only oblast names: {sorted(volunteer_names - official_names)}.",
                   f"VERIFIED: Luhanska oblast present in both sources: {'Luhanska oblast' in official_names & volunteer_names}. Full name sets contain no Crimea entry."]
        return "\n\n".join(output) + "\n"
    
    
    def main() -> None:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("--raw-dir", type=Path, default=Path("data/raw"))
        args = parser.parse_args()
        print(report(args.raw_dir), end="")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

Decisions to record in docs/DECISIONS.md (all are parameters, not constants):
- Official definition = variant B. Note that the official channel has been silent since 2026-09-07 and no top-up is possible.
- Forecast time T = whole UTC hour boundary. Information at T = events with started_at <= T; finished_at counts as known only if <= T (otherwise the alert is "ongoing").
- y_k(oblast, T) = 1 iff the oblast has a variant-B interval touching hour [T+k, T+k+1). PRIMARY k = 1..6, separately; k = 0 reported separately, never pooled with 1..6; SECONDARY k = 12 and 24.
- TRAIN_START default 2025-12-01. Walk-forward validation on 2026-06-01..2026-08-01 with 4 folds: [06-01, 06-16), [06-16, 07-01), [07-01, 07-16), [07-16, 08-01). For each fold the training rows are T in [TRAIN_START, fold_start) with an EMBARGO: drop any training row whose target hour ends after fold_start. TEST = 2026-08-01..trimmed end: do NOT use it. Planned final protocol: choose everything on the folds, refit on all data before 2026-08-01 with the chosen hyperparameters, evaluate on TEST once.
- Limitation to record: ~0.1% of official rows are closed artificially after 3 h (duration == 3600 s); at time T such an alert would still look ongoing. Not corrected.
- Disclosure to record: earlier exploratory runs (horizon choice, profiles) used a window that overlaps TEST; design decisions are therefore re-checked on the walk-forward folds.

1. src/airalerts/panel.py: build_panel(...) -> long DataFrame (oblast, T, as-of features, y_k for k in 0..6,12,24). Features, all computed only from information at T: state at T (ongoing), touch bits of the previous 1..6 h, share of the last 6 h / 24 h / 7 d / 28 d under alert, hours since last alert ended (cap 72), number of oblasts under alert nationwide at T, hour of day and day of week in Europe/Kyiv (sin/cos). No alert counts or durations. Save to data/processed/panel.parquet (use parquet if pyarrow installs, else csv.gz; add dependency to requirements.txt).
2. src/airalerts/splits.py: walk_forward_folds(params) yielding (fold_id, train_mask, eval_mask) with the embargo above; a guard that raises if any eval window ends after 2026-08-01 unless final_test=True is passed explicitly. Do not call it with final_test.
3. src/airalerts/models.py (fit on the TRAIN rows of each fold only; each model exposes fit(train) / predict_proba(rows, lead)):
   a. climatology (per-oblast train mean);
   b. persistence_hard (0/1 = state at T) and persistence_prob (train-estimated P(y_k=1 | state at T), per oblast);
   c. seasonal_profile: P = share of alerts at the same hour of day over the last N days; variant with same hour of week over the last M weeks; N and M chosen on TRAIN only;
   d. ses: simple exponential smoothing (ETS without trend/season) of the hourly 0/1 series, alpha fit per lead on TRAIN to minimise Brier, forecast = level at T clipped to [0,1].
4. src/airalerts/evaluate.py: brier, BSS = 1 - BS(model)/BS(reference) with references climatology and persistence_prob, ECE (10 bins), reliability table, day-block bootstrap 95% interval for pooled BSS. Flag oblasts whose TRAIN positive rate is < 3% or > 95% (decided from each fold's TRAIN rows) and report pooled metrics with and without them. ONE function log_result(...) appending to reports/model/results.csv with columns: run_id, git_commit, created_at, model, params_json, seed, train_start, fold_id, eval_start, eval_end, lead, scope (ALL | ALL_excl_flagged | <oblast>), n, base_rate, brier, bss_vs_clim, bss_vs_persistence, bss_ci_low, bss_ci_high, ece, notes. Predictions go to data/processed/predictions/<model>_<fold>.parquet (ignored by git).
5. scripts/run_reference_models.py: runs models a-d on all folds for all leads, writes results.csv and a short reports/model/reference_validation.md (pooled BSS per lead per model, fold spread). Deterministic, fixed seeds, CLI args for TRAIN_START and fold boundaries.

    # Project: per-oblast air-raid alert forecasting (Ukraine)
    
    Goal: for each oblast, forecast P(alert touches hour h) at forecast time T, evaluated on the latest period. No data leakage.
    
    ## Forecast setup
    - PRIMARY: each lead 1..6 h ahead as a separate target. Lead 0 is reported separately, never pooled.
    - SECONDARY (contrast): leads 12 and 24 h.
    - EXTRA metric, only if time allows: event window "any alert in [T, T+W)".
    - Do not choose a horizon by test score. Do NOT implement train/val/test splits yet; only prepare data.
    
    ## Data decisions (changes go to docs/DECISIONS.md)
    - `official` (Telegram air_alert_ua, structured, levels oblast/raion/hromada) is PRIMARY. `volunteer` (eTryvoga, keyword-parsed, oblast level) is a robustness check. Never average or merge them.
    - official_data_en.csv has an exact duplicated block: `drop_duplicates()` right after reading (expected 299,275 -> 185,430 rows).
    - All timestamps are UTC (= Telegram publication time, not siren time). Convert to Europe/Kyiv only for daily reporting.
    - Target: alert(oblast, hour) = 1 iff ANY interval of ANY level in the oblast touches [h, h+1h).
    - Exclude Luhanska oblast and Crimea.
    - Intervals are written only when closed, so each file is right-censored: trim the last 48 h of every source.
    - volunteer `naive` = imputed end (+30 min). official: duration == 3600 s is a heuristic imputation flag (~0.1% of rows).
    - Hourly "touch" inflates up to ~3.3x observed; ~1x for saturated oblasts. Compare SOURCES by exact minutes; use the hourly grid only for modelling.
    - Do not model alert counts or durations (parser artifacts).
    
    ## Leakage rules
    - A feature for forecast time T may use only events with started_at <= T. finished_at counts as known only if <= T; otherwise the alert is "ongoing".
    - Time-based splits only. Fit anything (scalers, encoders) on the training window only.
    
    ## Code rules
    - Task 1 needs no network or secrets. Later collect tasks may use the network, but never read, print or write tokens; credentials come from env vars only.
    - Never modify data/raw. Inspect files before assuming column names.
    - Type hints, small pure functions, pytest tests, no absolute paths.
    - Keep the repo minimal: create a file only when the current task needs it.

    """UTC interval coverage; callers select sources and exclude unwanted oblasts."""
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    
    def _window(start: str | pd.Timestamp, end: str | pd.Timestamp
                ) -> tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
        start, end = pd.Timestamp(start), pd.Timestamp(end)
        start = start.tz_localize("UTC") if start.tzinfo is None else start.tz_convert("UTC")
        end = end.tz_localize("UTC") if end.tzinfo is None else end.tz_convert("UTC")
        if pd.isna(start) or pd.isna(end) or end <= start:
            raise ValueError("Window must have valid timestamps with end > start")
        return start, end
    
    
    def _clipped(df: pd.DataFrame, start: pd.Timestamp,
                 end: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        rows = df.loc[df["started_at"].lt(end) & df["finished_at"].gt(start),
                      ["oblast", "started_at", "finished_at"]].copy()
        if "is_open" in df:
            rows = rows.loc[~df.loc[rows.index, "is_open"].fillna(False)]
        rows["started_at"] = rows["started_at"].clip(lower=start)
        rows["finished_at"] = rows["finished_at"].clip(upper=end)
        return rows.loc[rows["finished_at"].gt(rows["started_at"])]
    
    
    def hourly_grid(df: pd.DataFrame, start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                    end: str | pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Compatibility wrapper for hour-aligned time_grid(..., freq='60min')."""
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        if start != start.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Hourly grid start must be hour-aligned")
        return time_grid(df, start, end)
    
    
    def time_grid(df: pd.DataFrame, start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                  end: str | pd.Timestamp, freq: str = "60min") -> pd.DataFrame:
        """OR positive closed intervals touching bins in [start, end), in UTC.
    
        Bins are anchored at start. Partial final bins are clipped to end. Open and
        empty intervals cover no time. All input oblasts remain as columns.
        """
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        step = pd.Timedelta(freq)
        if step <= pd.Timedelta(0):
            raise ValueError("freq must be a positive fixed duration")
        index = pd.date_range(start, end, freq=step, inclusive="left", name="hour")
        columns = pd.Index(sorted(df["oblast"].dropna().unique()), name="oblast")
        result = pd.DataFrame(False, index=index, columns=columns)
        for oblast, rows in _clipped(df, start, end).groupby("oblast"):
            left = index.searchsorted(rows["started_at"], side="right") - 1
            right = index.searchsorted(rows["finished_at"], side="left")
            changes = np.zeros(len(index) + 1, dtype=np.int64)
            np.add.at(changes, left, 1)
            np.add.at(changes, right, -1)
            result[oblast] = np.cumsum(changes[:-1]) > 0
        return result
    
    
    def episodes(df: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str, start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                 end: str | pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Merge strictly overlapping closed intervals, clipping to the window.
    
        Abutting half-open intervals remain separate episodes (no overlap).
        """
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        rows = _clipped(df.loc[df["oblast"].eq(oblast)], start, end).sort_values("started_at")
        merged: list[tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]] = []
        for a, b in rows[["started_at", "finished_at"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None):
            if merged and a < merged[-1][1]:
                merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], max(merged[-1][1], b))
            else:
                merged.append((a, b))
        result = pd.DataFrame(merged, columns=["started_at", "finished_at"])
        for column in result:
            result[column] = pd.to_datetime(result[column], utc=True)
        return result
    
    
    def exact_share(df: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str | pd.Timestamp | None = None,
                    start: str | pd.Timestamp | None = None,
                    end: str | pd.Timestamp | None = None) -> pd.Series | float:
        """Fraction of window covered by each oblast's interval union.
    
        Use exact elapsed time, including sub-minute precision, without rounding
        or double-counting overlaps. Preserve oblasts with zero coverage.
    
        Also supports the existing exact_share(df, start, end) Series interface.
        """
        if end is None:
            oblast, start, end = None, oblast, start
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        if oblast is not None:
            merged = episodes(df, str(oblast), start, end)
            return float((merged["finished_at"] - merged["started_at"]).sum() / (end - start))
        result = pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(sorted(df["oblast"].dropna().unique()),
                                            name="oblast"), name="exact_share")
        for oblast, rows in _clipped(df, start, end).groupby("oblast"):
            covered = pd.Timedelta(0)
            union_start, union_end = None, None
            for a, b in rows.sort_values("started_at")[["started_at", "finished_at"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                if union_end is None or a > union_end:
                    if union_end is not None:
                        covered += union_end - union_start
                    union_start, union_end = a, b
                else:
                    union_end = max(union_end, b)
            if union_end is not None:
                covered += union_end - union_start
            result.loc[oblast] = covered / (end - start)
        return result
    """Read source intervals without merging sources or filtering oblasts."""
    
    from pathlib import Path
    import warnings
    
    import pandas as pd
    
    
    def _parse_times(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        for column in ("started_at", "finished_at"):
            df[column] = pd.to_datetime(df[column], utc=True, format="ISO8601", errors="coerce")
        validate(df)
        return df
    
    
    def load_official(path: str | Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Drop exact raw duplicates, then derive duration from UTC timestamps."""
        df = pd.read_csv(path).drop_duplicates()
        df = _parse_times(df)
        df["duration_s"] = (df["finished_at"] - df["started_at"]).dt.total_seconds()
        df["naive_guess"] = df["duration_s"].eq(3600)
        return df[["oblast", "raion", "hromada", "level", "started_at",
                   "finished_at", "duration_s", "naive_guess"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    
    def load_volunteer(path: str | Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Read volunteer intervals, preserving its supplied imputation flag."""
        df = pd.read_csv(path).rename(columns={"region": "oblast"})
        df = _parse_times(df)
        return df[["oblast", "started_at", "finished_at", "naive"]]
    
    
    def validate(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
        """Reject missing/invalid times; warn about, but retain, spans over 24 h."""
        if df[["started_at", "finished_at"]].isna().any().any():
            raise ValueError("Intervals contain NaT timestamps")
        durations = df["finished_at"] - df["started_at"]
        if durations.lt(pd.Timedelta(0)).any():
            raise ValueError("Intervals have finished_at < started_at")
        count = int(durations.gt(pd.Timedelta(hours=24)).sum())
        if count:
            warnings.warn(f"{count} intervals longer than 24 h (retained)",
                          UserWarning, stacklevel=2)
    
    
    def valid_end(df: pd.DataFrame, hours: float = 48) -> pd.Timestamp:
        """max(started_at) - hours, bounded by API max(fetched_at) when supplied.
    
        Compute on the full source, before region/definition/imputation exclusions.
        Comparisons clip retained intervals at this endpoint; no end is imputed.
        """
        if hours < 0:
            raise ValueError("hours must be nonnegative")
        source_end = df["started_at"].max()
        if "fetched_at" in df and df["fetched_at"].notna().any():
            source_end = min(source_end, df["fetched_at"].max())
        return source_end - pd.Timedelta(hours=hours)
    
    
    def trim_tail(df: pd.DataFrame, hours: float = 48) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Keep starts strictly before valid_end, defined from max(started_at)."""
        cutoff = valid_end(df, hours)
        return df.loc[df["started_at"].lt(cutoff)].copy()
    
    
    def official_variant(df: pd.DataFrame, variant: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """A all; B oblast+raion; C duration <=24 h; D both B and C."""
        if variant not in {"A", "B", "C", "D"}:
            raise ValueError("official variant must be A, B, C or D")
        keep = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
        if variant in {"B", "D"}:
            keep &= df["level"].isin(["oblast", "raion"])
        if variant in {"C", "D"}:
            keep &= (df["finished_at"] - df["started_at"]).le(pd.Timedelta(hours=24))
        return df.loc[keep].copy()
    
    
    def load_alerts_in_ua(path: str | Path, air_raid_only: bool = True,
                          variant: str = "all") -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Load API rows, retaining opens and metadata for separate reporting.
    
        English names share the collector's resolver. Malformed closed timestamps
        raise; genuinely null ends remain NaT and are ignored by interval maths.
        The raw UID is preserved alongside oblast_resolution for auditing fallbacks.
        """
        from airalerts.collect.alerts_in_ua import resolve_oblast
    
        if variant not in {"all", "red"}:
            raise ValueError("API variant must be all or red")
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
        for column in ("started_at", "finished_at", "fetched_at"):
            if column in df:
                df[column] = pd.to_datetime(df[column], utc=True, format="ISO8601", errors="raise")
        if df["started_at"].isna().any():
            raise ValueError("API intervals contain NaT started_at")
        df["is_open"] = df["finished_at"].isna()
        validate(df.loc[~df["is_open"]])
        resolved = [resolve_oblast(row.get("location_oblast_uid"), row.get("queried_uid"), row.get("oblast"))
                    for row in df.to_dict(orient="records")]
        df["oblast"] = [name for name, _ in resolved]
        df["oblast_resolution"] = [method for _, method in resolved]
        df["level"] = df["location_type"]
        for column in ("alert_level", "threat_types"):
            if column not in df:
                df[column] = ""
            df[column] = df[column].fillna("")
        if air_raid_only:
            df = df.loc[df["alert_type"].eq("air_raid")]
        if variant == "red":
            df = df.loc[df["alert_level"].eq("red")]
        return df.reset_index(drop=True)

    """Probability metrics, paired UTC-day bootstrap, and one append-only logger."""
    
    import csv
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    RESULT_COLUMNS = ["run_id", "git_commit", "created_at", "model", "params_json", "seed", "train_start", "fold_id",
                      "eval_start", "eval_end", "lead", "scope", "n", "base_rate", "brier", "bss_vs_clim",
                      "bss_vs_persistence", "bss_ci_low", "bss_ci_high", "ece", "notes"]
    
    
    def brier(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(np.mean((y - p) ** 2)) if len(y) else np.nan
    
    
    def bss(score: float, reference: float) -> float:
        return 1 - score / reference if reference > 0 else np.nan
    
    
    def reliability(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, bins: int = 10) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not np.isfinite(p).all() or ((p < 0) | (p > 1)).any():
            raise ValueError("Probabilities must be finite and in [0,1]")
        bucket = np.minimum((p * bins).astype(int), bins - 1)
        rows = []
        for i in range(bins):
            mask = bucket == i
            rows.append({"bin": i, "lower": i / bins, "upper": (i + 1) / bins, "n": int(mask.sum()),
                         "mean_probability": float(p[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else np.nan,
                         "observed_rate": float(y[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else np.nan})
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
    
    
    def ece(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, bins: int = 10) -> float:
        table = reliability(y, p, bins)
        return float((table.n * (table.mean_probability - table.observed_rate).abs()).sum() / len(y)) if len(y) else np.nan
    
    
    def bootstrap_bss(rows: pd.DataFrame, reference: str = "clim", seed: int = 42,
                      samples: int = 300) -> tuple[float, float]:
        if rows.empty:
            return np.nan, np.nan
        errors = pd.DataFrame({"day": rows["T"].dt.floor("D"),
                               "model": (rows.y - rows.p) ** 2,
                               "reference": (rows.y - rows[reference]) ** 2}).groupby("day").sum()
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        selected = rng.integers(0, len(errors), size=(samples, len(errors)))
        numerator = errors.model.to_numpy()[selected].sum(axis=1)
        denominator = errors.reference.to_numpy()[selected].sum(axis=1)
        values = 1 - np.divide(numerator, denominator, out=np.full(samples, np.nan), where=denominator > 0)
        finite = values[np.isfinite(values)]
        return tuple(np.quantile(finite, [.025, .975])) if len(finite) else (np.nan, np.nan)
    
    
    def metric_row(rows: pd.DataFrame, bins: int = 10) -> dict:
        y, p = rows.y.to_numpy(dtype=float), rows.p.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        score = brier(y, p)
        return {"n": len(rows), "base_rate": float(y.mean()) if len(y) else np.nan, "brier": score,
                "bss_vs_clim": bss(score, brier(y, rows.clim.to_numpy())),
                "bss_vs_persistence": bss(score, brier(y, rows.persistence.to_numpy())), "ece": ece(y, p, bins)}
    
    
    def log_result(path: Path, result: dict) -> None:
        """The only results.csv writer; refuse schema drift before appending."""
        if set(result) != set(RESULT_COLUMNS):
            raise ValueError("Result does not match the results.csv schema")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        exists = path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > 0
        if exists:
            with path.open(newline="") as handle:
                if next(csv.reader(handle)) != RESULT_COLUMNS:
                    raise ValueError("Existing results.csv schema differs")
        with path.open("a", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=RESULT_COLUMNS)
            if not exists:
                writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerow(result)
