    """Simple references; every fitted rate/candidate uses the supplied TRAIN only."""
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    
    class ReferenceModel:
        def __init__(self, name: str, leads: tuple[int, ...], day_windows: tuple[int, ...],
                     week_windows: tuple[int, ...], alphas: tuple[float, ...]):
            self.name, self.leads = name, leads
            self.day_windows, self.week_windows, self.alphas = day_windows, week_windows, alphas
            self.params: dict[int, dict] = {}
            self.rates: dict[int, pd.Series] = {}
            self.global_rates: dict[int, float] = {}
    
        def fit(self, train: pd.DataFrame) -> "ReferenceModel":
            if train.empty:
                raise ValueError("Cannot fit an empty TRAIN window")
            for k in self.leads:
                y = train[f"y_{k}"].astype(float)
                self.global_rates[k] = float(y.mean())
                if self.name == "persistence_prob":
                    self.rates[k] = train.groupby(["oblast", "state"])[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                else:
                    self.rates[k] = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                if self.name in {"seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses"}:
                    prefix = {"seasonal_day": "day", "seasonal_week": "week", "ses": "ses"}[self.name]
                    candidates = {"day": self.day_windows, "week": self.week_windows, "ses": self.alphas}[prefix]
                    columns = [f"ses_{value:g}" if prefix == "ses" else f"{prefix}_{value}_k{k}" for value in candidates]
                    loss = [float(np.mean((train[column].to_numpy() - y.to_numpy()) ** 2)) for column in columns]
                    position = int(np.argmin(loss))
                    self.params[k] = {"column": columns[position], "chosen": candidates[position], "train_brier": loss[position]}
            return self
    
        def predict_proba(self, rows: pd.DataFrame, lead: int) -> np.ndarray:
            if self.name == "persistence_hard":
                return rows.state.to_numpy(dtype=float)
            if self.name in {"seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses"}:
                return np.clip(rows[self.params[lead]["column"]].to_numpy(dtype=float), 0, 1)
            if self.name == "persistence_prob":
                keys = pd.MultiIndex.from_frame(rows[["oblast", "state"]])
                values = self.rates[lead].reindex(keys).to_numpy(dtype=float)
                fallback = rows.oblast.map(self.rates[lead].groupby(level=0).mean()).fillna(self.global_rates[lead]).to_numpy(dtype=float)
                return np.where(np.isnan(values), fallback, values)
            return rows.oblast.map(self.rates[lead]).fillna(self.global_rates[lead]).to_numpy(dtype=float)

    """Variant-B hourly panel: causal observations, bounded labels, local clocks."""
    
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import episodes, time_grid, _window
    from airalerts.io import official_variant
    
    DEFAULT_LEADS = (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 12, 24)
    
    
    def save_frame(frame: pd.DataFrame, path: Path) -> Path:
        """Prefer parquet; offline installations without pyarrow use csv.gz."""
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            import pyarrow  # noqa: F401
        except ImportError:
            path = path.with_suffix(".csv.gz")
            frame.to_csv(path, index=False, compression={"method": "gzip", "mtime": 0})
        else:
            frame.to_parquet(path, index=False)
        return path
    
    
    def _prefix_coverage(merged: pd.DataFrame, boundaries: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> np.ndarray:
        """Elapsed union seconds before each boundary, using existing episodes()."""
        if merged.empty:
            return np.zeros(len(boundaries))
        a = pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.started_at).as_unit("ns").asi8
        b = pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.finished_at).as_unit("ns").asi8
        t = boundaries.as_unit("ns").asi8
        pos = np.searchsorted(b, t, side="right")
        cumulative = np.r_[0., np.cumsum((b - a) / 1e9)]
        next_pos = np.minimum(pos, len(a) - 1)
        partial = np.clip((t - a[next_pos]) / 1e9, 0, (b[next_pos] - a[next_pos]) / 1e9)
        return cumulative[pos] + np.where(pos < len(a), partial, 0)
    
    
    def _profile(signal: np.ndarray, index: pd.DatetimeIndex, hours: int,
                 lead: int, weekly: bool) -> np.ndarray:
        local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
        keys = local.hour.to_numpy() + (24 * local.dayofweek.to_numpy() if weekly else 0)
        target = (index + pd.Timedelta(hours=lead)).tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
        wanted = target.hour.to_numpy() + (24 * target.dayofweek.to_numpy() if weekly else 0)
        result = np.zeros(len(index))
        upper = np.arange(len(index))  # exclude the current, incompletely observed hour
        lower = np.maximum(upper - hours, 0)
        for key in np.unique(wanted):
            matches = keys == key
            count = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(matches)]
            positives = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(signal * matches)]
            selected = wanted == key
            numerator = positives[upper[selected]] - positives[lower[selected]]
            denominator = count[upper[selected]] - count[lower[selected]]
            result[selected] = np.divide(numerator, denominator, out=np.zeros(len(numerator)), where=denominator > 0)
        return result
    
    
    def build_panel(df: pd.DataFrame, start: str | pd.Timestamp, end: str | pd.Timestamp,
                    leads: tuple[int, ...] = DEFAULT_LEADS, variant: str = "B",
                    day_windows: tuple[int, ...] = (7, 14, 28), week_windows: tuple[int, ...] = (4, 8),
                    alphas: tuple[float, ...] = (.01, .05, .1, .3, .6),
                    history_days: int = 28, end_cap_hours: int = 72,
                    excluded: tuple[str, ...] = ("Luhanska oblast", "Crimea", "Sevastopol"),
                    oblasts: list[str] | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Build [start,end) without any target hour extending beyond end.
    
        End is the available label boundary, not a retrospectively fitted parameter.
        Warmup covers all requested trailing windows. Missing ends extend only the
        as-of observation history, never supply future labels. Profiles/SES columns
        are fixed-candidate causal observations; models select candidates on TRAIN.
        """
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        if start != start.floor("h") or end != end.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Panel boundaries must be whole UTC hours")
        if any(k < 0 for k in leads) or any(n <= 0 for n in (*day_windows, *week_windows)):
            raise ValueError("Leads/windows must be nonnegative/positive")
        if any(not 0 < alpha <= 1 for alpha in alphas):
            raise ValueError("SES alpha must lie in (0,1]")
        selected = official_variant(df, variant)
        selected = selected.loc[~selected.oblast.isin(excluded)].copy()
        oblasts = sorted(oblasts if oblasts is not None else selected.oblast.unique())
        selected = selected.loc[selected.started_at.lt(end)].copy()
        warmup = max(history_days, max(day_windows, default=0), 7 * max(week_windows, default=0))
        context = start - pd.Timedelta(days=warmup)
        index = pd.date_range(context, end, freq="h", inclusive="left")
        observed = selected.copy()
        observed["finished_at"] = observed.finished_at.fillna(end).clip(upper=end)
        observed = observed.drop(columns="is_open", errors="ignore")
        touch = time_grid(observed, context, end).reindex(columns=oblasts, fill_value=False)
        truth = time_grid(selected.loc[selected.finished_at.notna()], context, end).reindex(columns=oblasts, fill_value=False)
        frames = []
        for oblast in oblasts:
            rows = observed.loc[observed.oblast.eq(oblast)]
            changes = np.zeros(len(index) + 1, dtype=int)
            good = rows.finished_at.gt(rows.started_at)
            left = index.searchsorted(rows.loc[good, "started_at"], side="left")
            right = index.searchsorted(rows.loc[good, "finished_at"], side="left")
            np.add.at(changes, left, 1)
            np.add.at(changes, right, -1)
            state = np.cumsum(changes[:-1]) > 0
            frame = pd.DataFrame({"oblast": oblast, "T": index, "state": state})
            signal = touch[oblast].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            for lag in range(1, 7):
                frame[f"touch_prev_{lag}"] = np.r_[np.zeros(lag), signal[:-lag]].astype(bool)
            cumulative = _prefix_coverage(episodes(observed, oblast, context, end), index)
            for hours in (6, 24, 168, history_days * 24):
                low = np.maximum(np.arange(len(index)) - hours, 0)
                frame[f"share_{hours}h"] = (cumulative - cumulative[low]) / (hours * 3600)
            finishes = pd.DatetimeIndex(selected.loc[selected.oblast.eq(oblast), "finished_at"].dropna().sort_values())
            positions = finishes.searchsorted(index, side="right") - 1
            elapsed = np.full(len(index), float(end_cap_hours))
            good_pos = positions >= 0
            elapsed[good_pos] = (index[good_pos] - finishes.take(positions[good_pos])).total_seconds() / 3600
            frame["hours_since_end"] = np.where(state, 0, np.clip(elapsed, 0, end_cap_hours))
            local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
            for name, values, period in [("hour", local.hour, 24), ("weekday", local.dayofweek, 7)]:
                frame[name + "_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * values / period)
                frame[name + "_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * values / period)
            for alpha in alphas:
                frame[f"ses_{alpha:g}"] = pd.Series(signal).ewm(alpha=alpha, adjust=False).mean().shift(1).fillna(0).to_numpy()
            for k in leads:
                y = truth[oblast].shift(-k).astype("boolean")
                frame[f"y_{k}"] = y.to_numpy()
                for n in day_windows:
                    frame[f"day_{n}_k{k}"] = _profile(signal, index, n * 24, k, False)
                for m in week_windows:
                    frame[f"week_{m}_k{k}"] = _profile(signal, index, m * 168, k, True)
            frames.append(frame.loc[frame.T.ge(start)] if False else frame.loc[frame["T"].ge(start)])
        panel = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True).sort_values(["T", "oblast"]).reset_index(drop=True)
        panel["nationwide_state"] = panel.groupby("T").state.transform("sum").astype(int)
        for k in leads:
            panel[f"y_{k}"] = panel[f"y_{k}"].astype("boolean")
        return panel

    """Expanding training windows with lead-specific target-end embargo."""
    
    from dataclasses import dataclass
    from typing import Iterator
    
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import _window
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class FoldParams:
        train_start: str = "2025-12-01"
        boundaries: tuple[str, ...] = ("2026-06-01", "2026-06-16", "2026-07-01", "2026-07-16", "2026-08-01")
        test_start: str = "2026-08-01"
    
    
    def walk_forward_folds(rows: pd.DataFrame, params: FoldParams, lead: int,
                           final_test: bool = False) -> Iterator[tuple[str, pd.Series, pd.Series]]:
        limit = pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC")
        boundaries = [pd.Timestamp(b, tz="UTC") for b in params.boundaries]
        if not final_test and any(b > limit for b in boundaries):
            raise ValueError("Evaluation extends into TEST; final_test=True is required")
        train_start = pd.Timestamp(params.train_start, tz="UTC")
        if any(b != b.floor("h") for b in boundaries) or train_start != train_start.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Split boundaries must be whole UTC hours")
        target_end = rows["T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=lead + 1)
        available = rows[f"y_{lead}"].notna()
        for i, (start, end) in enumerate(zip(boundaries[:-1], boundaries[1:]), 1):
            _window(start, end)
            train = rows["T"].ge(train_start) & rows["T"].lt(start) & target_end.le(start) & available
            evaluate = rows["T"].ge(start) & rows["T"].lt(end) & available
            if not final_test:
                evaluate &= target_end.le(limit)
            yield str(i), train, evaluate

    """Offline reference validation only; no final-test invocation exists here."""
    
    import argparse
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    import hashlib
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import subprocess
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.evaluate import bootstrap_bss, log_result, metric_row, reliability
    from airalerts.io import load_official, valid_end
    from airalerts.models import ReferenceModel
    from airalerts.panel import DEFAULT_LEADS, build_panel, save_frame
    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams, walk_forward_folds
    
    
    def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> pd.DataFrame:
        params = FoldParams(args.train_start, tuple(args.fold_boundaries), args.test_start)
        end = pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[-1], tz="UTC")
        if end > pd.Timestamp("2026-08-01", tz="UTC") or end > pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC"):
            raise ValueError("Task 5A evaluation/panel must end no later than 2026-08-01")
        # Guard all boundaries before reading the input or constructing a panel.
        empty = pd.DataFrame({"T": pd.Series([], dtype="datetime64[ns, UTC]"), "y_0": pd.Series([], dtype="boolean")})
        list(walk_forward_folds(empty, params, 0))
        official = load_official(args.official)
        if end > valid_end(official):
            raise ValueError("Validation exceeds the independently trimmed source end")
        # Discard every start in TEST and hide finishes beyond validation. No TEST
        # labels or test rows enter any panel, fitted rate, tuning or metric.
        official = official.loc[official.started_at.lt(end)].copy()
        panel = build_panel(official, params.train_start, end, variant=args.variant,
                            day_windows=tuple(args.day_windows), week_windows=tuple(args.week_windows),
                            alphas=tuple(args.alphas))
        panel_path = save_frame(panel, Path("data/processed/panel.parquet"))
        print(f"Panel saved: {panel_path}; {len(panel)} rows; T in [{panel['T'].min()}, {end})")
        commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        dirty = bool(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], text=True).strip())
        config = vars(args).copy()
        config["official"] = str(args.official)
        input_hash = hashlib.sha256(args.official.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        config["input_sha256"] = input_hash
        config["dirty_worktree"] = dirty
        config["validation_label_boundary"] = end.isoformat()
        serialized = json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True)
        run_id = hashlib.sha256((commit + serialized).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        created = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        out = Path("reports/model")
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        results, pooled, calibration, intervals, selected = [], [], [], [], []
        names = ("climatology", "persistence_hard", "persistence_prob", "seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses")
        for fold_id in map(str, range(1, len(params.boundaries))):
            predictions = {name: [] for name in names}
            for k in DEFAULT_LEADS:
                _, train_mask, eval_mask = next(fold for fold in walk_forward_folds(panel, params, k) if fold[0] == fold_id)
                train, evaluation = panel.loc[train_mask], panel.loc[eval_mask]
                models = {name: ReferenceModel(name, (k,), tuple(args.day_windows), tuple(args.week_windows), tuple(args.alphas)).fit(train) for name in names}
                clim = models["climatology"].predict_proba(evaluation, k)
                persistence = models["persistence_prob"].predict_proba(evaluation, k)
                rate = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                flagged = rate.index[(rate < args.flag_low) | (rate > args.flag_high)].tolist()
                fold_start, fold_end = params.boundaries[int(fold_id) - 1:int(fold_id) + 1]
                for name, model in models.items():
                    pred = evaluation[["oblast", "T"]].copy()
                    pred["y"] = evaluation[f"y_{k}"].astype(float)
                    pred["p"], pred["clim"], pred["persistence"] = model.predict_proba(evaluation, k), clim, persistence
                    pred["lead"], pred["fold_id"], pred["run_id"] = k, fold_id, run_id
                    pred["flagged"] = pred.oblast.isin(flagged)
                    predictions[name].append(pred)
                    pooled.append(pred.assign(model=name))
                    fitted = {**config, "fitted": model.params.get(k, {}), "flagged_oblasts": flagged,
                              "ci_reference": "climatology"}
                    selected.append({"fold_id": fold_id, "lead": k, "model": name,
                                     "fitted_json": json.dumps(model.params.get(k, {}), sort_keys=True),
                                     "flagged_oblasts": ";".join(flagged)})
                    scopes = {"ALL": pred, "ALL_excl_flagged": pred.loc[~pred.flagged]}
                    scopes.update({oblast: group for oblast, group in pred.groupby("oblast")})
                    for scope, group in scopes.items():
                        ci = bootstrap_bss(group, seed=args.seed, samples=args.bootstrap_samples) if scope.startswith("ALL") else (np.nan, np.nan)
                        result = {"run_id": run_id, "git_commit": commit, "created_at": created, "model": name,
                                  "params_json": json.dumps(fitted, sort_keys=True), "seed": args.seed,
                                  "train_start": params.train_start, "fold_id": fold_id, "eval_start": fold_start,
                                  "eval_end": fold_end, "lead": k, "scope": scope, **metric_row(group, args.ece_bins),
                                  "bss_ci_low": ci[0], "bss_ci_high": ci[1],
                                  "notes": "validation only; CI vs climatology; as-of observations; dirty_worktree=" + str(dirty)}
                        log_result(out / "results.csv", result)
                        results.append(result)
                        if scope.startswith("ALL"):
                            table = reliability(group.y.to_numpy(), group.p.to_numpy(), args.ece_bins)
                            calibration.append(table.assign(model=name, fold_id=fold_id, lead=k, scope=scope, run_id=run_id))
            for name, frames in predictions.items():
                save_frame(pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True), Path("data/processed/predictions") / f"{name}_{fold_id}.parquet")
            print(f"Fold {fold_id} completed; no TEST rows evaluated")
        pd.DataFrame(selected).to_csv(out / "chosen_params.csv", index=False)
        pd.concat(calibration, ignore_index=True).to_csv(out / "reliability.csv", index=False)
        all_predictions = pd.concat(pooled, ignore_index=True)
        summary = []
        result_frame = pd.DataFrame(results)
        for (name, k), group in all_predictions.groupby(["model", "lead"], sort=True):
            for scope in ("ALL", "ALL_excl_flagged"):
                subset = group if scope == "ALL" else group.loc[~group.flagged]
                row = {"model": name, "lead": k, "scope": scope, **metric_row(subset, args.ece_bins)}
                folds = result_frame.loc[(result_frame.model == name) & (result_frame.lead == k) & (result_frame.scope == scope)]
                row["fold_bss_min"], row["fold_bss_max"] = folds.bss_vs_clim.min(), folds.bss_vs_clim.max()
                for reference in ("clim", "persistence"):
                    low, high = bootstrap_bss(subset, reference, args.seed, args.bootstrap_samples)
                    intervals.append({"run_id": run_id, "model": name, "lead": k, "scope": scope,
                                      "reference": reference, "low": low, "high": high})
                    if reference == "clim":
                        row["bss_ci_low"], row["bss_ci_high"] = low, high
                summary.append(row)
        summary = pd.DataFrame(summary)
        summary.to_csv(out / "reference_validation.csv", index=False)
        pd.DataFrame(intervals).to_csv(out / "bootstrap.csv", index=False)
        columns = ["model", "lead", "scope", "n", "bss_vs_clim", "bss_vs_persistence", "fold_bss_min", "fold_bss_max", "bss_ci_low", "bss_ci_high"]
        text = "# Reference validation only\n\nRun: " + run_id + "; git: " + commit + "; dirty worktree: " + str(dirty)
        text += "\n\nParameters: `" + serialized + "`\n\n"
        text += "No TEST rows or target hours were used. Labels beyond the validation boundary are missing; "
        text += "the last fold therefore has fewer eligible rows at longer leads. Leads are evaluated separately, including 0. "
        text += "Pooled BSS is computed from pooled squared errors, not averaged fold scores. Fold spread is min/max BSS vs climatology. "
        text += "Intervals resample paired UTC days across all oblasts; both references are in bootstrap.csv. "
        text += "Flagging is lead/fold-specific and based only on TRAIN. Results.csv is append-only; other summaries describe this run.\n\n"
        text += "```text\n" + summary[columns].to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.5f}") + "\n```\n"
        (out / "reference_validation.md").write_text(text)
        print(summary.loc[summary.scope.eq("ALL"), columns].to_string(index=False))
        return summary
    
    
    def main() -> None:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("--official", type=Path, default=Path("data/raw/official_data_en.csv"))
        parser.add_argument("--train-start", default="2025-12-01")
        parser.add_argument("--fold-boundaries", nargs="+", default=["2026-06-01", "2026-06-16", "2026-07-01", "2026-07-16", "2026-08-01"])
        parser.add_argument("--test-start", default="2026-08-01")
        parser.add_argument("--variant", choices=["B"], default="B")
        parser.add_argument("--day-windows", nargs="+", type=int, default=[7, 14, 28])
        parser.add_argument("--week-windows", nargs="+", type=int, default=[4, 8])
        parser.add_argument("--alphas", nargs="+", type=float, default=[.01, .05, .1, .3, .6])
        parser.add_argument("--flag-low", type=float, default=.03)
        parser.add_argument("--flag-high", type=float, default=.95)
        parser.add_argument("--ece-bins", type=int, default=10)
        parser.add_argument("--bootstrap-samples", type=int, default=300)
        parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
        run(parser.parse_args())
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    import json
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import pytest
    
    from airalerts.evaluate import RESULT_COLUMNS, bootstrap_bss, ece, log_result, reliability
    from airalerts.models import ReferenceModel
    from airalerts.panel import build_panel
    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams, walk_forward_folds
    
    
    def events() -> pd.DataFrame:
        frame = pd.DataFrame([
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-01 14:40", "2026-01-01 15:10"),
            ("A", "oblast", "2026-01-01 15:00", "2026-01-01 18:00"),
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-02 06:00", "2026-01-02 07:00"),
            ("B", "hromada", "2026-01-01 01:00", "2026-01-03 23:00"),
            ("B", "raion", "2026-01-02 05:00", "2026-01-02 08:00"),
        ], columns=["oblast", "level", "started_at", "finished_at"])
        for column in ("started_at", "finished_at"):
            frame[column] = pd.to_datetime(frame[column], utc=True)
        return frame
    
    
    def panel(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return build_panel(frame, "2026-01-01", "2026-01-04", leads=(0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 24),
                           day_windows=(1,), week_windows=(1,), alphas=(.1,), oblasts=["A", "B"])
    
    
    def test_future_perturbation() -> None:
        original = events()
        reference = panel(original)
        features = [column for column in reference if not column.startswith("y_")]
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        times = rng.choice(reference["T"].unique(), size=8, replace=False)
        for T in times:
            changed = original.loc[original.started_at.le(T)].copy()
            changed.loc[changed.finished_at.gt(T), "finished_at"] = pd.NaT
            actual = panel(changed)
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(reference.loc[reference["T"].eq(T), features].reset_index(drop=True),
                                          actual.loc[actual["T"].eq(T), features].reset_index(drop=True))
    
    
    def test_lead_definition_variant_and_asof_exact_share() -> None:
        frame = events().iloc[[0, 3]]
        result = panel(frame)
        row = result.loc[result.oblast.eq("A") & result["T"].eq(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01 12:00", tz="UTC"))].iloc[0]
        assert not row.y_1 and row.y_2 and row.y_3
        assert not result.loc[result.oblast.eq("B"), "state"].any()
        row = result.loc[result.oblast.eq("A") & result["T"].eq(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01 15:00", tz="UTC"))].iloc[0]
        assert row.state
        assert row.share_6h == pytest.approx(20 / 360)
        assert row.touch_prev_1
        assert result.loc[result["T"].eq(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-03 23:00", tz="UTC")), "y_24"].isna().all()
    
    
    def test_fold_embargo_and_test_guard() -> None:
        index = pd.date_range("2025-12-01", "2026-08-01", freq="h", inclusive="left", tz="UTC")
        rows = pd.DataFrame({"T": index})
        params = FoldParams()
        for k in (0, 1, 6, 12, 24):
            rows[f"y_{k}"] = False
            for fold, train, evaluate in walk_forward_folds(rows, params, k):
                boundary = pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[int(fold) - 1], tz="UTC")
                assert (rows.loc[train, "T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=k + 1)).max() <= boundary
                assert (rows.loc[evaluate, "T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=k + 1)).max() <= pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="TEST"):
            list(walk_forward_folds(rows, FoldParams(boundaries=("2026-07-16", "2026-08-02")), 0))
    
    
    def test_results_schema_and_append(tmp_path) -> None:
        path = tmp_path / "results.csv"
        row = {column: "" for column in RESULT_COLUMNS}
        row.update(model="climatology", params_json=json.dumps({}), n=2, lead=1, scope="ALL")
        log_result(path, row)
        log_result(path, row)
        assert pd.read_csv(path).columns.tolist() == RESULT_COLUMNS
        assert len(pd.read_csv(path)) == 2
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="schema"):
            log_result(path, {"model": "climatology"})
    
    
    def test_fit_only_train_and_calibration_bootstrap() -> None:
        train = pd.DataFrame({"oblast": ["A"] * 4, "state": [False, False, True, True],
                              "y_1": [0, 0, 1, 1], "ses_0.1": [.1, .1, .9, .9], "ses_0.6": [.5] * 4})
        clf = ReferenceModel("persistence_prob", (1,), (7,), (4,), (.1, .6)).fit(train)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(clf.predict_proba(train, 1), [0, 0, 1, 1])
        ses = ReferenceModel("ses", (1,), (7,), (4,), (.1, .6)).fit(train)
        assert ses.params[1]["chosen"] == .1
        assert ece(np.array([0., 1.]), np.array([0., 1.])) == 0
        assert reliability(np.array([0., 1.]), np.array([0., 1.])).n.sum() == 2
        rows = pd.DataFrame({"T": pd.date_range("2026-06-01", periods=48, freq="h", tz="UTC"),
                             "y": [0., 1.] * 24, "p": [0., 1.] * 24, "clim": .5})
        assert bootstrap_bss(rows, samples=20) == (1., 1.)

        p=Path('docs/DECISIONS.md')
        entry='''
        ## Task 5A — parameterised reference validation protocol
        
        - Current task authorises panels, targets and validation folds, superseding the earlier preparation-only restriction. Defaults are configurable parameters, not conclusions selected by test scores. Official definition defaults to B (oblast+raion). Supplied project context: air_alert_ua has been silent since 2026-09-07; no top-up is possible. No channel/network check is performed here.
        - Forecast T is a whole UTC hour. Only events started_at <= T contribute observations; finishes count as known only when <= T. Otherwise the alert is ongoing. The last completed observation hour is [T−1h,T). As-of past shares use exact interval-union time, not inflated hourly touch rates. No event counts or event durations are features; nationwide state counts oblasts, not events.
        - y_k is variant-B interval touch of [T+k,T+k+1h). Default leads: PRIMARY 1..6 separately; 0 separately, never pooled with PRIMARY; SECONDARY 12 and 24. Panel labels whose target hour ends after the available validation boundary are missing, not fetched from TEST. Input rows with genuinely unknown ends conservatively have unsettled labels withheld.
        - TRAIN_START defaults to 2025-12-01. Default walk-forward T windows: [2026-06-01,06-16), [06-16,07-01), [07-01,07-16), [07-16,08-01). For lead k, TRAIN T is [TRAIN_START,fold_start), additionally requiring T+k+1h <= fold_start. Evaluation T can target the next internal validation fold, but never beyond the final validation boundary. Guard rejects evaluation after the configured test_start (default 2026-08-01) unless final_test=True; this runner provides no such flag and independently caps the panel/evaluation at 2026-08-01.
        - Planned TEST = [2026-08-01, independently trimmed source end). It is not used in Task 5A. Planned final protocol: choose everything on validation folds, refit before 2026-08-01 using the selected hyperparameters and embargo, then evaluate TEST once. No final refit or test evaluation is run here.
        - Limitation: approximately 0.1% of official rows have heuristic artificial ends with duration == 3600 s, created when a restart occurs more than 3 h later. Such an alert could still look ongoing at T in the live stream. The history does not expose when the synthetic closure was inferred; this is not corrected.
        - Disclosure: earlier exploratory horizon/profile runs used a window overlapping planned TEST. Those design decisions are therefore re-checked on walk-forward folds; the later TEST cannot be described as wholly untouched by prior exploration.
        - Feature defaults: prior-hour touch lags 1..6; exact shares over 6h/24h/7d/28d; hours since end capped at 72 (zero while ongoing); national oblast state count; Europe/Kyiv hour/weekday sin/cos. Fixed historical context warms up the largest rolling candidate (default 56 days). Climatology/persistence rates, seasonal candidate and SES alpha fit TRAIN only, separately by lead. Seasonal candidates default to 7/14/28 elapsed days and 4/8 elapsed weeks, matching Kyiv hour/day-of-week; SES candidates .01/.05/.1/.3/.6 use the last completed hourly bit and no trend/season. Initial SES level is its first warmup observation. N/M/alpha are selected by TRAIN Brier, not validation outcomes.
        - Reporting defaults: 10 ECE bins, seed 42, 300 paired UTC-day bootstrap samples; flags TRAIN positive rates <3% or >95%, by lead/fold. Pooled BSS uses pooled squared errors. results.csv CI columns refer to climatology; bootstrap.csv also records persistence-reference CIs. Undefined reference Brier or empty scopes produce missing values. Logs append via one writer; summary/calibration/parameter files describe the latest run. Source/input fingerprints and dirty-worktree status supplement git_commit provenance.
        - Offline pyarrow installation was attempted with --no-index and unavailable. Parquet dependency is listed; this environment saves panel and predictions as deterministic csv.gz in gitignored data/processed instead. No raw files are modified and no secrets/network are used.
        '''

HARD RULES
1. NEVER read, print or write secrets (TG_API_ID, TG_API_HASH, TG_SESSION, alerts.in.ua
   token). No network access in this task.
2. NO DATA LEAKAGE. Features at T use only rows with started_at <= T; finished_at is known
   only if finished_at <= T (otherwise the alert is ongoing). Anything fitted (base_rate,
   scalers, models, ensemble weights) is fitted on TRAIN of the current fold only.

    # Project: per-oblast air-raid alert forecasting (Ukraine)
    
    Goal: for each oblast, forecast P(alert touches hour h) at forecast time T, evaluated on the latest period. No data leakage.
    
    ## Forecast setup
    - PRIMARY: each lead 1..6 h ahead as a separate target. Lead 0 is reported separately, never pooled.
    - SECONDARY (contrast): leads 12 and 24 h.
    - EXTRA metric, only if time allows: event window "any alert in [T, T+W)".
    - Do not choose a horizon by test score. Do NOT implement train/val/test splits yet; only prepare data.
    
    ## Data decisions (changes go to docs/DECISIONS.md)
    - `official` (Telegram air_alert_ua, structured, levels oblast/raion/hromada) is PRIMARY. `volunteer` (eTryvoga, keyword-parsed, oblast level) is a robustness check. Never average or merge them.
    - official_data_en.csv has an exact duplicated block: `drop_duplicates()` right after reading (expected 299,275 -> 185,430 rows).
    - All timestamps are UTC (= Telegram publication time, not siren time). Convert to Europe/Kyiv only for daily reporting.
    - Target: alert(oblast, hour) = 1 iff ANY interval of ANY level in the oblast touches [h, h+1h).
    - Exclude Luhanska oblast and Crimea.
    - Intervals are written only when closed, so each file is right-censored: trim the last 48 h of every source.
    - volunteer `naive` = imputed end (+30 min). official: duration == 3600 s is a heuristic imputation flag (~0.1% of rows).
    - Hourly "touch" inflates up to ~3.3x observed; ~1x for saturated oblasts. Compare SOURCES by exact minutes; use the hourly grid only for modelling.
    - Do not model alert counts or durations (parser artifacts).
    
    ## Leakage rules
    - A feature for forecast time T may use only events with started_at <= T. finished_at counts as known only if <= T; otherwise the alert is "ongoing".
    - Time-based splits only. Fit anything (scalers, encoders) on the training window only.
    
    ## Code rules
    - Task 1 needs no network or secrets. Later collect tasks may use the network, but never read, print or write tokens; credentials come from env vars only.
    - Never modify data/raw. Inspect files before assuming column names.
    - Type hints, small pure functions, pytest tests, no absolute paths.
    - Keep the repo minimal: create a file only when the current task needs it.
    - Final report after each task: files changed, commands run, test output, what you assumed or could not verify. Do not claim results you did not run.

    """Expanding training windows with lead-specific target-end embargo."""
    
    from dataclasses import dataclass
    from typing import Iterator
    
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import _window
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class FoldParams:
        train_start: str = "2025-12-01"
        boundaries: tuple[str, ...] = ("2026-06-01", "2026-06-16", "2026-07-01", "2026-07-16", "2026-08-01")
        test_start: str = "2026-08-01"
    
    
    def walk_forward_folds(rows: pd.DataFrame, params: FoldParams, lead: int,
                           final_test: bool = False) -> Iterator[tuple[str, pd.Series, pd.Series]]:
        # Moving a configured TEST date later must not silently waive this stage's
        # reserved August boundary. A final-test invocation is the only waiver.
        limit = min(pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC"), pd.Timestamp(FoldParams().test_start, tz="UTC"))
        boundaries = [pd.Timestamp(b, tz="UTC") for b in params.boundaries]
        if not final_test and any(b > limit for b in boundaries):
            raise ValueError("Evaluation extends into TEST; final_test=True is required")
        train_start = pd.Timestamp(params.train_start, tz="UTC")
        if lead < 0 or len(boundaries) < 2 or train_start >= boundaries[0]:
            raise ValueError("Require nonnegative lead, at least two boundaries, and TRAIN_START before validation")
        if any(b != b.floor("h") for b in boundaries) or train_start != train_start.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Split boundaries must be whole UTC hours")
        target_end = rows["T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=lead + 1)
        available = rows[f"y_{lead}"].notna()
        for i, (start, end) in enumerate(zip(boundaries[:-1], boundaries[1:]), 1):
            _window(start, end)
            train = rows["T"].ge(train_start) & rows["T"].lt(start) & target_end.le(start) & available
            evaluate = rows["T"].ge(start) & rows["T"].lt(end) & available
            if not final_test:
                evaluate &= target_end.le(limit)
            yield str(i), train, evaluate
    """Probability metrics, paired UTC-day bootstrap, and one append-only logger."""
    
    import csv
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    RESULT_COLUMNS = ["run_id", "git_commit", "created_at", "model", "params_json", "seed", "train_start", "fold_id",
                      "eval_start", "eval_end", "lead", "scope", "n", "base_rate", "brier", "bss_vs_clim",
                      "bss_vs_persistence", "bss_ci_low", "bss_ci_high", "ece", "notes"]
    
    
    def brier(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(np.mean((y - p) ** 2)) if len(y) else np.nan
    
    
    def bss(score: float, reference: float) -> float:
        return 1 - score / reference if reference > 0 else np.nan
    
    
    def reliability(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, bins: int = 10) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not np.isfinite(p).all() or ((p < 0) | (p > 1)).any():
            raise ValueError("Probabilities must be finite and in [0,1]")
        bucket = np.minimum((p * bins).astype(int), bins - 1)
        rows = []
        for i in range(bins):
            mask = bucket == i
            rows.append({"bin": i, "lower": i / bins, "upper": (i + 1) / bins, "n": int(mask.sum()),
                         "mean_probability": float(p[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else np.nan,
                         "observed_rate": float(y[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else np.nan})
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
    
    
    def ece(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, bins: int = 10) -> float:
        table = reliability(y, p, bins)
        return float((table.n * (table.mean_probability - table.observed_rate).abs()).sum() / len(y)) if len(y) else np.nan
    
    
    def bootstrap_bss(rows: pd.DataFrame, reference: str = "clim", seed: int = 42,
                      samples: int = 300) -> tuple[float, float]:
        if rows.empty:
            return np.nan, np.nan
        errors = pd.DataFrame({"day": rows["T"].dt.floor("D"),
                               "model": (rows.y - rows.p) ** 2,
                               "reference": (rows.y - rows[reference]) ** 2}).groupby("day").sum()
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        selected = rng.integers(0, len(errors), size=(samples, len(errors)))
        numerator = errors.model.to_numpy()[selected].sum(axis=1)
        denominator = errors.reference.to_numpy()[selected].sum(axis=1)
        values = 1 - np.divide(numerator, denominator, out=np.full(samples, np.nan), where=denominator > 0)
        finite = values[np.isfinite(values)]
        return tuple(np.quantile(finite, [.025, .975])) if len(finite) else (np.nan, np.nan)
    
    
    def metric_row(rows: pd.DataFrame, bins: int = 10) -> dict:
        y, p = rows.y.to_numpy(dtype=float), rows.p.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        score = brier(y, p)
        return {"n": len(rows), "base_rate": float(y.mean()) if len(y) else np.nan, "brier": score,
                "bss_vs_clim": bss(score, brier(y, rows.clim.to_numpy())),
                "bss_vs_persistence": bss(score, brier(y, rows.persistence.to_numpy())), "ece": ece(y, p, bins)}
    
    
    def log_result(path: Path, result: dict) -> None:
        """The only results.csv writer; refuse schema drift before appending."""
        if set(result) != set(RESULT_COLUMNS):
            raise ValueError("Result does not match the results.csv schema")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        exists = path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > 0
        if exists:
            with path.open(newline="") as handle:
                if next(csv.reader(handle)) != RESULT_COLUMNS:
                    raise ValueError("Existing results.csv schema differs")
        with path.open("a", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=RESULT_COLUMNS)
            if not exists:
                writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerow(result)
    """Simple references; every fitted rate/candidate uses the supplied TRAIN only."""
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    
    class ReferenceModel:
        def __init__(self, name: str, leads: tuple[int, ...], day_windows: tuple[int, ...],
                     week_windows: tuple[int, ...], alphas: tuple[float, ...]):
            self.name, self.leads = name, leads
            self.day_windows, self.week_windows, self.alphas = day_windows, week_windows, alphas
            self.params: dict[int, dict] = {}
            self.rates: dict[int, pd.Series] = {}
            self.global_rates: dict[int, float] = {}
            self.base_rates: dict[int, pd.Series] = {}
    
        def fit(self, train: pd.DataFrame) -> "ReferenceModel":
            if train.empty:
                raise ValueError("Cannot fit an empty TRAIN window")
            for k in self.leads:
                y = train[f"y_{k}"].astype(float)
                self.global_rates[k] = float(y.mean())
                self.base_rates[k] = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                if self.name == "persistence_prob":
                    self.rates[k] = train.groupby(["oblast", "state"])[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                else:
                    self.rates[k] = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                if self.name in {"seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses"}:
                    prefix = {"seasonal_day": "day", "seasonal_week": "week", "ses": "ses"}[self.name]
                    candidates = {"day": self.day_windows, "week": self.week_windows, "ses": self.alphas}[prefix]
                    columns = [f"ses_{value:g}" if prefix == "ses" else f"{prefix}_{value}_k{k}" for value in candidates]
                    loss = [float(np.mean((train[column].to_numpy() - y.to_numpy()) ** 2)) for column in columns]
                    position = int(np.argmin(loss))
                    self.params[k] = {"column": columns[position], "chosen": candidates[position], "train_brier": loss[position]}
            return self
    
        def predict_proba(self, rows: pd.DataFrame, lead: int) -> np.ndarray:
            if self.name == "persistence_hard":
                return rows.state.to_numpy(dtype=float)
            if self.name in {"seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses"}:
                return np.clip(rows[self.params[lead]["column"]].to_numpy(dtype=float), 0, 1)
            if self.name == "persistence_prob":
                keys = pd.MultiIndex.from_frame(rows[["oblast", "state"]])
                values = self.rates[lead].reindex(keys).to_numpy(dtype=float)
                fallback = rows.oblast.map(self.base_rates[lead]).fillna(self.global_rates[lead]).to_numpy(dtype=float)
                return np.where(np.isnan(values), fallback, values)
            return rows.oblast.map(self.rates[lead]).fillna(self.global_rates[lead]).to_numpy(dtype=float)

    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams, walk_forward_folds
    
    
    def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> pd.DataFrame:
        params = FoldParams(args.train_start, tuple(args.fold_boundaries), args.test_start)
        end = pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[-1], tz="UTC")
        if end > pd.Timestamp("2026-08-01", tz="UTC") or end > pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC"):
            raise ValueError("Task 5A evaluation/panel must end no later than 2026-08-01")
        # Guard all boundaries before reading the input or constructing a panel.
        empty = pd.DataFrame({"T": pd.Series([], dtype="datetime64[ns, UTC]"), "y_0": pd.Series([], dtype="boolean")})
        list(walk_forward_folds(empty, params, 0))
        official = load_official(args.official)
        if end > valid_end(official):
            raise ValueError("Validation exceeds the independently trimmed source end")
        # Discard every start in TEST and hide finishes beyond validation. No TEST
        # labels or test rows enter any panel, fitted rate, tuning or metric.
        official = official.loc[official.started_at.lt(end)].copy()
        panel = build_panel(official, params.train_start, end, leads=tuple(args.leads), variant=args.variant,
                            day_windows=tuple(args.day_windows), week_windows=tuple(args.week_windows),
                            alphas=tuple(args.alphas))
        panel_path = save_frame(panel, Path("data/processed/panel.parquet"))
        print(f"Panel saved: {panel_path}; {len(panel)} rows; T in [{panel['T'].min()}, {end})")
        commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        dirty = bool(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], text=True).strip())
        config = vars(args).copy()
        config["official"] = str(args.official)
        input_hash = hashlib.sha256(args.official.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        config["input_sha256"] = input_hash
        source_files = [Path(__file__), *[Path("src/airalerts") / name for name in
                        ("panel.py", "splits.py", "models.py", "evaluate.py", "grid.py", "io.py")]]
        config["source_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(b"".join(path.read_bytes() for path in source_files)).hexdigest()
        config["dirty_worktree"] = dirty
        config["validation_label_boundary"] = end.isoformat()
        serialized = json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True)
        run_id = hashlib.sha256((commit + serialized).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        created = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        out = Path("reports/model")
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        results, pooled, calibration, intervals, selected = [], [], [], [], []
        names = ("climatology", "persistence_hard", "persistence_prob", "seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses")
        for fold_id in map(str, range(1, len(params.boundaries))):
            predictions = {name: [] for name in names}
            for k in args.leads:
                _, train_mask, eval_mask = next(fold for fold in walk_forward_folds(panel, params, k) if fold[0] == fold_id)
                train, evaluation = panel.loc[train_mask], panel.loc[eval_mask]
                models = {name: ReferenceModel(name, (k,), tuple(args.day_windows), tuple(args.week_windows), tuple(args.alphas)).fit(train) for name in names}
                clim = models["climatology"].predict_proba(evaluation, k)
                persistence = models["persistence_prob"].predict_proba(evaluation, k)
                rate = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                flagged = rate.index[(rate < args.flag_low) | (rate > args.flag_high)].tolist()
                fold_start, fold_end = params.boundaries[int(fold_id) - 1:int(fold_id) + 1]
                for name, model in models.items():
                    pred = evaluation[["oblast", "T"]].copy()
                    pred["y"] = evaluation[f"y_{k}"].astype(float)
                    pred["p"], pred["clim"], pred["persistence"] = model.predict_proba(evaluation, k), clim, persistence
                    pred["lead"], pred["fold_id"], pred["run_id"] = k, fold_id, run_id
                    pred["flagged"] = pred.oblast.isin(flagged)
                    predictions[name].append(pred)
                    pooled.append(pred.assign(model=name))
                    fitted = {**config, "fitted": model.params.get(k, {}), "flagged_oblasts": flagged,
                              "ci_reference": "climatology"}
                    selected.append({"fold_id": fold_id, "lead": k, "model": name,
                                     "fitted_json": json.dumps(model.params.get(k, {}), sort_keys=True),
                                     "flagged_oblasts": ";".join(flagged)})
                    scopes = {"ALL": pred, "ALL_excl_flagged": pred.loc[~pred.flagged]}
                    scopes.update({oblast: group for oblast, group in pred.groupby("oblast")})
                    for scope, group in scopes.items():
                        ci = bootstrap_bss(group, seed=args.seed, samples=args.bootstrap_samples) if scope.startswith("ALL") else (np.nan, np.nan)
                        result = {"run_id": run_id, "git_commit": commit, "created_at": created, "model": name,
                                  "params_json": json.dumps(fitted, sort_keys=True), "seed": args.seed,
                                  "train_start": params.train_start, "fold_id": fold_id, "eval_start": fold_start,
                                  "eval_end": fold_end, "lead": k, "scope": scope, **metric_row(group, args.ece_bins),
                                  "bss_ci_low": ci[0], "bss_ci_high": ci[1],
                                  "notes": "validation only; CI vs climatology; as-of observations; dirty_worktree=" + str(dirty)}
                        log_result(out / "results.csv", result)
                        results.append(result)
                        if scope.startswith("ALL"):
                            table = reliability(group.y.to_numpy(), group.p.to_numpy(), args.ece_bins)
                            calibration.append(table.assign(model=name, fold_id=fold_id, lead=k, scope=scope, run_id=run_id))
            for name, frames in predictions.items():
                save_frame(pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True), Path("data/processed/predictions") / f"{name}_{fold_id}.parquet")
            print(f"Fold {fold_id} completed; no TEST rows evaluated")
        pd.DataFrame(selected).to_csv(out / "chosen_params.csv", index=False)
        pd.concat(calibration, ignore_index=True).to_csv(out / "reliability.csv", index=False)
        all_predictions = pd.concat(pooled, ignore_index=True)
        summary = []
        result_frame = pd.DataFrame(results)
        for (name, k), group in all_predictions.groupby(["model", "lead"], sort=True):
            for scope in ("ALL", "ALL_excl_flagged"):
                subset = group if scope == "ALL" else group.loc[~group.flagged]
                row = {"model": name, "lead": k, "scope": scope, **metric_row(subset, args.ece_bins)}
                folds = result_frame.loc[(result_frame.model == name) & (result_frame.lead == k) & (result_frame.scope == scope)]
                row["fold_bss_min"], row["fold_bss_max"] = folds.bss_vs_clim.min(), folds.bss_vs_clim.max()
                for reference in ("clim", "persistence"):
                    low, high = bootstrap_bss(subset, reference, args.seed, args.bootstrap_samples)
                    intervals.append({"run_id": run_id, "model": name, "lead": k, "scope": scope,
                                      "reference": reference, "low": low, "high": high})
                    if reference == "clim":
                        row["bss_ci_low"], row["bss_ci_high"] = low, high
                summary.append(row)
        summary = pd.DataFrame(summary)
        summary.to_csv(out / "reference_validation.csv", index=False)
        pd.DataFrame(intervals).to_csv(out / "bootstrap.csv", index=False)
        columns = ["model", "lead", "scope", "n", "bss_vs_clim", "bss_vs_persistence", "fold_bss_min", "fold_bss_max", "bss_ci_low", "bss_ci_high"]
        text = "# Reference validation only\n\nRun: " + run_id + "; git: " + commit + "; dirty worktree: " + str(dirty)
        text += "\n\nParameters: `" + serialized + "`\n\n"
        text += "No TEST rows or target hours were used. Labels beyond the validation boundary are missing; "
        text += "the last fold therefore has fewer eligible rows at longer leads. Leads are evaluated separately, including 0. "
        text += "Pooled BSS is computed from pooled squared errors, not averaged fold scores. Fold spread is min/max BSS vs climatology. "
        text += "Intervals resample paired UTC days across all oblasts; both references are in bootstrap.csv. "
        text += "Flagging is lead/fold-specific and based only on TRAIN. Results.csv is append-only; other summaries describe this run.\n\n"
        text += "```text\n" + summary[columns].to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.5f}") + "\n```\n"
        (out / "reference_validation.md").write_text(text)
        print(summary.loc[summary.scope.eq("ALL"), columns].to_string(index=False))
        return summary
    
    
    def main() -> None:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("--official", type=Path, default=Path("data/raw/official_data_en.csv"))
        parser.add_argument("--train-start", default="2025-12-01")

    """Variant-B hourly panel: causal observations, bounded labels, local clocks."""
    
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import episodes, time_grid, _window
    from airalerts.io import official_variant
    
    DEFAULT_LEADS = (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 12, 24)
    
    
    def save_frame(frame: pd.DataFrame, path: Path) -> Path:
        """Prefer parquet; offline installations without pyarrow use csv.gz."""
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            import pyarrow  # noqa: F401
        except ImportError:
            path = path.with_suffix(".csv.gz")
            frame.to_csv(path, index=False, compression={"method": "gzip", "mtime": 0})
        else:
            frame.to_parquet(path, index=False)
        return path
    
    
    def _prefix_coverage(merged: pd.DataFrame, boundaries: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> np.ndarray:
        """Elapsed union seconds before each boundary, using existing episodes()."""
        if merged.empty:
            return np.zeros(len(boundaries))
        a = pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.started_at).as_unit("ns").asi8
        b = pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.finished_at).as_unit("ns").asi8
        t = boundaries.as_unit("ns").asi8
        pos = np.searchsorted(b, t, side="right")
        cumulative = np.r_[0., np.cumsum((b - a) / 1e9)]
        next_pos = np.minimum(pos, len(a) - 1)
        partial = np.clip((t - a[next_pos]) / 1e9, 0, (b[next_pos] - a[next_pos]) / 1e9)
        return cumulative[pos] + np.where(pos < len(a), partial, 0)
    
    
    def _profile(signal: np.ndarray, index: pd.DatetimeIndex, hours: int,
                 lead: int, weekly: bool) -> np.ndarray:
        local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
        keys = local.hour.to_numpy() + (24 * local.dayofweek.to_numpy() if weekly else 0)
        target = (index + pd.Timedelta(hours=lead)).tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
        wanted = target.hour.to_numpy() + (24 * target.dayofweek.to_numpy() if weekly else 0)
        result = np.zeros(len(index))
        upper = np.arange(len(index))  # exclude the current, incompletely observed hour
        lower = np.maximum(upper - hours, 0)
        for key in np.unique(wanted):
            matches = keys == key
            count = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(matches)]
            positives = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(signal * matches)]
            selected = wanted == key
            numerator = positives[upper[selected]] - positives[lower[selected]]
            denominator = count[upper[selected]] - count[lower[selected]]
            result[selected] = np.divide(numerator, denominator, out=np.zeros(len(numerator)), where=denominator > 0)
        return result
    
    
    def build_panel(df: pd.DataFrame, start: str | pd.Timestamp, end: str | pd.Timestamp,
                    leads: tuple[int, ...] = DEFAULT_LEADS, variant: str = "B",
                    day_windows: tuple[int, ...] = (7, 14, 28), week_windows: tuple[int, ...] = (4, 8),
                    alphas: tuple[float, ...] = (.01, .05, .1, .3, .6),
                    history_days: int = 28, end_cap_hours: int = 72,
                    excluded: tuple[str, ...] = ("Luhanska oblast", "Crimea", "Sevastopol"),
                    oblasts: list[str] | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Build [start,end) without any target hour extending beyond end.
    
        End is the available label boundary, not a retrospectively fitted parameter.
        Warmup covers all requested trailing windows. Missing ends extend only the
        as-of observation history, never supply future labels. Profiles/SES columns
        are fixed-candidate causal observations; models select candidates on TRAIN.
        """
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        if start != start.floor("h") or end != end.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Panel boundaries must be whole UTC hours")
        if any(k < 0 for k in leads) or any(n <= 0 for n in (*day_windows, *week_windows)):
            raise ValueError("Leads/windows must be nonnegative/positive")
        if any(not 0 < alpha <= 1 for alpha in alphas):
            raise ValueError("SES alpha must lie in (0,1]")
        selected = official_variant(df, variant)
        selected = selected.loc[~selected.oblast.isin(excluded)].copy()
        # Geography is independent of the chosen level definition: a region with
        # only excluded hromada rows still has a zero variant-B state.
        oblasts = sorted(b for b in (oblasts if oblasts is not None else df.oblast.unique()) if b not in excluded)
        selected = selected.loc[selected.started_at.lt(end)].copy()
        warmup = max(history_days, max(day_windows, default=0), 7 * max(week_windows, default=0))
        context = start - pd.Timedelta(days=warmup)
        index = pd.date_range(context, end, freq="h", inclusive="left")
        observed = selected.copy()
        observed["finished_at"] = observed.finished_at.fillna(end).clip(upper=end)
        observed = observed.drop(columns="is_open", errors="ignore")
        touch = time_grid(observed, context, end).reindex(columns=oblasts, fill_value=False)
        truth = time_grid(selected.loc[selected.finished_at.notna()], context, end).reindex(columns=oblasts, fill_value=False)
        frames = []
        for oblast in oblasts:
            rows = observed.loc[observed.oblast.eq(oblast)]
            changes = np.zeros(len(index) + 1, dtype=int)
            good = rows.finished_at.gt(rows.started_at)
            left = index.searchsorted(rows.loc[good, "started_at"], side="left")
            right = index.searchsorted(rows.loc[good, "finished_at"], side="left")
            np.add.at(changes, left, 1)
            np.add.at(changes, right, -1)
            state = np.cumsum(changes[:-1]) > 0
            frame = pd.DataFrame({"oblast": oblast, "T": index, "state": state})
            signal = touch[oblast].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            for lag in range(1, 7):
                frame[f"touch_prev_{lag}"] = np.r_[np.zeros(lag), signal[:-lag]].astype(bool)
            cumulative = _prefix_coverage(episodes(observed, oblast, context, end), index)
            for hours in (6, 24, 168, history_days * 24):
                low = np.maximum(np.arange(len(index)) - hours, 0)
                frame[f"share_{hours}h"] = (cumulative - cumulative[low]) / (hours * 3600)
            finishes = pd.DatetimeIndex(selected.loc[selected.oblast.eq(oblast), "finished_at"].dropna().sort_values())
            positions = finishes.searchsorted(index, side="right") - 1
            elapsed = np.full(len(index), float(end_cap_hours))
            good_pos = positions >= 0
            elapsed[good_pos] = (index[good_pos] - finishes.take(positions[good_pos])).total_seconds() / 3600
            frame["hours_since_end"] = np.clip(elapsed, 0, end_cap_hours)
            local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
            for name, values, period in [("hour", local.hour, 24), ("weekday", local.dayofweek, 7)]:
                frame[name + "_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * values / period)
                frame[name + "_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * values / period)
            for alpha in alphas:
                frame[f"ses_{alpha:g}"] = pd.Series(signal).ewm(alpha=alpha, adjust=False).mean().shift(1).fillna(0).to_numpy()
            for k in leads:
                y = truth[oblast].shift(-k).astype("boolean")
                unknown = selected.loc[selected.oblast.eq(oblast) & selected.finished_at.isna(), "started_at"]
                if not unknown.empty:
                    # Unclosed input has no settled target truth. Conservatively
                    # withhold labels from its first affected hour onwards.
                    y = y.mask(index + pd.Timedelta(hours=k) >= unknown.min().floor("h"))
                frame[f"y_{k}"] = y.to_numpy()
                for n in day_windows:
                    frame[f"day_{n}_k{k}"] = _profile(signal, index, n * 24, k, False)
                for m in week_windows:
                    frame[f"week_{m}_k{k}"] = _profile(signal, index, m * 168, k, True)
            frames.append(frame.loc[frame["T"].ge(start)])
        panel = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True).sort_values(["T", "oblast"]).reset_index(drop=True)
        panel["nationwide_state"] = panel.groupby("T").state.transform("sum").astype(int)
        for k in leads:
            panel[f"y_{k}"] = panel[f"y_{k}"].astype("boolean")
        return panel

            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-02 06:00", "2026-01-02 07:00"),

            ("B", "raion", "2026-01-02 05:00", "2026-01-02 08:00"),
        ], columns=["oblast", "level", "started_at", "finished_at"])
        for column in ("started_at", "finished_at"):
            frame[column] = pd.to_datetime(frame[column], utc=True)
        return frame
    
    
    def panel(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return build_panel(frame, "2026-01-01", "2026-01-04", leads=(0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 24),
                           day_windows=(1,), week_windows=(1,), alphas=(.1,), oblasts=["A", "B"])
    
    
    def test_future_perturbation() -> None:
        original = events()
        reference = panel(original)
        features = [column for column in reference if not column.startswith("y_")]
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        times = rng.choice(reference["T"].unique(), size=8, replace=False)
        for T in times:
            changed = original.loc[original.started_at.le(T)].copy()
            changed.loc[changed.finished_at.gt(T), "finished_at"] = pd.NaT
            actual = panel(changed)
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(reference.loc[reference["T"].eq(T), features].reset_index(drop=True),
                                          actual.loc[actual["T"].eq(T), features].reset_index(drop=True))
    
    
    def test_lead_definition_variant_and_asof_exact_share() -> None:
        frame = events().iloc[[0, 3]]
        result = panel(frame)
        row = result.loc[result.oblast.eq("A") & result["T"].eq(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01 12:00", tz="UTC"))].iloc[0]
        assert not row.y_1 and row.y_2 and row.y_3
        assert not result.loc[result.oblast.eq("B"), "state"].any()
        row = result.loc[result.oblast.eq("A") & result["T"].eq(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01 15:00", tz="UTC"))].iloc[0]
        assert row.state
        assert row.share_6h == pytest.approx(20 / 360)
        assert row.touch_prev_1
        assert result.loc[result["T"].eq(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-03 23:00", tz="UTC")), "y_24"].isna().all()
        overlapping = panel(events())
        row = overlapping.loc[overlapping.oblast.eq("A") & overlapping["T"].eq(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01 16:00", tz="UTC"))].iloc[0]
        assert row.state
        assert row.hours_since_end == pytest.approx(50 / 60)  # last known close, even while another row is ongoing
        only_hromada = build_panel(events().iloc[[3]], "2026-01-01", "2026-01-02", leads=(0,),
                                   day_windows=(1,), week_windows=(1,), alphas=(.1,))
        assert only_hromada.oblast.unique().tolist() == ["B"]
        assert not only_hromada.state.any() and not only_hromada.y_0.any()
    
    
    def test_fold_embargo_and_test_guard() -> None:
        index = pd.date_range("2025-12-01", "2026-08-01", freq="h", inclusive="left", tz="UTC")
        rows = pd.DataFrame({"T": index})
        params = FoldParams()
        for k in (0, 1, 6, 12, 24):
            rows[f"y_{k}"] = False
            for fold, train, evaluate in walk_forward_folds(rows, params, k):
                boundary = pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[int(fold) - 1], tz="UTC")
                assert (rows.loc[train, "T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=k + 1)).max() <= boundary
                assert (rows.loc[evaluate, "T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=k + 1)).max() <= pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="TEST"):
            list(walk_forward_folds(rows, FoldParams(boundaries=("2026-07-16", "2026-08-02")), 0))
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="TEST"):
            list(walk_forward_folds(rows, FoldParams(boundaries=("2026-07-16", "2026-08-02"), test_start="2026-08-10"), 0))
    
    
    def test_results_schema_and_append(tmp_path) -> None:
        path = tmp_path / "results.csv"
        row = {column: "" for column in RESULT_COLUMNS}
        row.update(model="climatology", params_json=json.dumps({}), n=2, lead=1, scope="ALL")
        log_result(path, row)
        log_result(path, row)
        assert pd.read_csv(path).columns.tolist() == RESULT_COLUMNS
        assert len(pd.read_csv(path)) == 2
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="schema"):
            log_result(path, {"model": "climatology"})
    
    
    def test_fit_only_train_and_calibration_bootstrap() -> None:
        train = pd.DataFrame({"oblast": ["A"] * 4, "state": [False, False, True, True],
                              "y_1": [0, 0, 1, 1], "ses_0.1": [.1, .1, .9, .9], "ses_0.6": [.5] * 4})
        clf = ReferenceModel("persistence_prob", (1,), (7,), (4,), (.1, .6)).fit(train)

        assert ece(np.array([0., 1.]), np.array([0., 1.])) == 0
        assert reliability(np.array([0., 1.]), np.array([0., 1.])).n.sum() == 2
        rows = pd.DataFrame({"T": pd.date_range("2026-06-01", periods=48, freq="h", tz="UTC"),

## Assistant

The old splits use a lead-specific gap: about 1 hour for lead 0 through 25 hours for lead 24, not a shared 25-hour embargo. I’ll replace that with `T < valid_start − 25h` for every lead and retain the target-end check.

SES already exists. I’ll reuse it, add SES-relative BSS and a latest-run reader, and switch CIs to 7-day blocks. I also found that `notebooks/00_eda.ipynb` is absent; only root `eda.ipynb` exists. I’ll create the requested notebook and leave the root notebook intact.

    +def latest_results(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    +    """Latest execution per model/fold/lead, retaining all its scope rows.
    +
    +    Append position breaks creation-time ties. Duplicate scope rows within an
    +    execution retain their last occurrence. Old SES fields remain missing.
    +    """
    +    frame = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"run_id": str, "fold_id": str})
    +    if "bss_vs_ses" not in frame:
    +        frame["bss_vs_ses"] = np.nan
    +    frame["_order"] = np.arange(len(frame))
    +    frame["_created"] = pd.to_datetime(frame.created_at, utc=True, format="ISO8601", errors="coerce")
    +    frame["_created"] = frame["_created"].fillna(pd.Timestamp("1970-01-01", tz="UTC"))
    +    keys = ["model", "fold_id", "lead"]
    +    ordered = frame.sort_values(["_created", "_order"])
    +    newest = ordered.drop_duplicates(keys, keep="last")[keys + ["run_id"]]
    +    selected = ordered.merge(newest, on=keys + ["run_id"], how="inner")
    +    return selected.drop_duplicates(keys + ["scope"], keep="last").drop(columns=["_order", "_created"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    +
    +
    +def _upgrade_schema(path: Path) -> None:
    +    """One-time additive header upgrade; preserve every old field verbatim.
    +
    +    This adds an empty SES cell to old records without changing metric values,
    +    order or record count. Subsequent writes append only. No records are dropped.
    +    """
    +    with path.open(newline="") as handle:
    +        old = next(csv.reader(handle))
    +    if old == RESULT_COLUMNS:
    +        return
    +    if old != RESULT_COLUMNS[:-1]:
    +        raise ValueError("Existing results.csv schema differs")
    +    temporary = None
    +    try:
    +        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", newline="", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as output:
    +            temporary = Path(output.name)
    +            writer = csv.writer(output)
    +            writer.writerow(RESULT_COLUMNS)
    +            with path.open(newline="") as source:
    +                reader = csv.reader(source)
    +                next(reader)
    +                for row in reader:
    +                    if len(row) != len(old):
    +                        raise ValueError("Malformed legacy log row")
    +                    writer.writerow(row + [""])
    +        os.replace(temporary, path)
    +    finally:
    +        if temporary is not None and temporary.exists():
    +            temporary.unlink()
    +
    +

    import csv
    
    import pandas as pd
    import pytest
    
    from airalerts.evaluate import RESULT_COLUMNS, latest_results, log_result
    from airalerts.panel import DEFAULT_LEADS
    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams, walk_forward_folds
    
    
    def test_shared_25h_embargo_for_every_label() -> None:
        times = pd.date_range("2025-12-01", "2026-08-01", freq="h", inclusive="left", tz="UTC")
        rows = pd.DataFrame({"T": times, **{f"y_{k}": False for k in DEFAULT_LEADS}})
        params = FoldParams()
        assert params.embargo_hours == 25
        for lead in DEFAULT_LEADS:
            for fold, train, valid in walk_forward_folds(rows, params, lead):
                start = pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[int(fold) - 1], tz="UTC")
                assert rows.loc[train, "T"].max() < start - pd.Timedelta(hours=25)
                for k in DEFAULT_LEADS:
                    end = rows.loc[train, "T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=k + 1)
                    assert end.le(start).all()
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="25"):
            list(walk_forward_folds(rows, FoldParams(embargo_hours=24), 0))
    
    
    def test_additive_schema_preserves_legacy_rows_and_latest_scopes(tmp_path) -> None:
        path = tmp_path / "results.csv"
        old = {column: "" for column in RESULT_COLUMNS[:-1]}
        old.update(run_id="old", model="ses", fold_id="1", lead="1", scope="ALL", created_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", brier="0.125")
        with path.open("w", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=RESULT_COLUMNS[:-1])
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerow(old)
        new = {**old, "run_id": "new", "created_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z", "bss_vs_ses": "0"}
        log_result(path, new)
        log_result(path, {**new, "scope": "A"})
        with path.open(newline="") as handle:
            data = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
        assert {key: data[0][key] for key in old} == old
        assert data[0]["bss_vs_ses"] == ""
        latest = latest_results(path)
        assert latest.run_id.unique().tolist() == ["new"]
        assert set(latest.scope) == {"ALL", "A"}

    """Offline TRAIN-only EDA, with separate compute/render modes."""
    
    import argparse
    from pathlib import Path
    
    
    def main() -> None:
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("--panel", type=Path, default=Path("data/processed/panel.csv.gz"))
        parser.add_argument("--official", type=Path, default=Path("data/raw/official_data_en.csv"))
        parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("reports/eda"))
        parser.add_argument("--compute-only", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument("--plots-only", action="store_true")
        args = parser.parse_args()
        if not args.plots_only:
            from airalerts.eda import prepare_eda, decompose
            daily, chosen = prepare_eda(args.panel, args.official, args.out)
            print("TRAIN-selected representatives:\n" + chosen.to_string(index=False))
            print(decompose(daily, chosen, args.out).to_string(index=False))
        if not args.compute_only:
            from airalerts.plot_eda import plot_eda
            plot_eda(args.out)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()
