    """TRAIN-only daily descriptive STL; never imported by feature/model code."""
    
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import exact_share
    from airalerts.io import load_official, official_variant
    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams, walk_forward_folds
    
    
    def strength(component: np.ndarray, remainder: np.ndarray) -> float:
        denominator = float(np.var(component + remainder))
        return max(0., 1 - float(np.var(remainder)) / denominator) if denominator > 1e-12 else np.nan
    
    
    def prepare_eda(panel_path: Path, official_path: Path, out: Path,
                    params: FoldParams = FoldParams()) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
        """Choose representatives on first-fold TRAIN, using hourly y_0 rates.
    
        NATIONAL is SUM of per-region exact alert-hours, not a national OR state.
        Only complete Europe/Kyiv calendar days contained in TRAIN enter STL/ACF.
        """
        panel = pd.read_csv(panel_path, usecols=["oblast", "T", "y_0"])
        panel["T"] = pd.to_datetime(panel["T"], utc=True, format="ISO8601")
        if panel["T"].ge(pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC")).any():
            raise ValueError("EDA panel contains TEST rows")
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        rates = []
        for fold_id, train, _ in walk_forward_folds(panel, params, 0):
            data = panel.loc[train].groupby("oblast").y_0.agg(["mean", "size"]).reset_index()
            data = data.rename(columns={"mean": "base_rate", "size": "n"})
            data["flagged"] = data.base_rate.lt(.03) | data.base_rate.gt(.95)
            data["fold_id"] = fold_id
            data["train_end_exclusive"] = (pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[int(fold_id) - 1], tz="UTC") - pd.Timedelta(hours=params.embargo_hours)).isoformat()
            rates.append(data)
        all_rates = pd.concat(rates, ignore_index=True)
        all_rates.to_csv(out / "train_base_rates.csv", index=False)
        overview = pd.DataFrame([{"rows": len(panel), "oblasts": panel.oblast.nunique(), "min_T": str(panel["T"].min()),
                                  "max_T": str(panel["T"].max()), "embargo_hours": params.embargo_hours}])
        overview.to_csv(out / "panel_overview.csv", index=False)
        first = all_rates.loc[all_rates.fold_id.eq("1")].set_index("oblast")
        groups = {
            "east": ["Dnipropetrovska oblast", "Donetska oblast", "Kharkivska oblast", "Zaporizka oblast", "Sumska oblast"],
            "center": ["Cherkaska oblast", "Kyivska oblast", "Kyiv City", "Kirovohradska oblast", "Poltavska oblast", "Vinnytska oblast", "Zhytomyrska oblast"],
            "west": ["Lvivska oblast", "Volynska oblast", "Zakarpatska oblast", "Rivnenska oblast", "Ternopilska oblast", "Chernivetska oblast", "Ivano-Frankivska oblast", "Khmelnytska oblast"],
        }
        choices = []
        median = float(first.base_rate.median())
        for group, candidates in groups.items():
            available = first.loc[first.index.intersection(candidates)].reset_index()
            if group == "east":
                available = available.sort_values(["base_rate", "oblast"], ascending=[False, True])
            elif group == "west":
                available = available.sort_values(["base_rate", "oblast"])
            else:
                available["distance"] = (available.base_rate - median).abs()
                available = available.sort_values(["distance", "oblast"])
            row = available.iloc[0]
            choices.append({"group": group, "oblast": row.oblast, "base_rate": row.base_rate, "flagged": row.flagged})
        chosen = pd.DataFrame(choices)
        chosen.to_csv(out / "representatives.csv", index=False)
        train_start = pd.Timestamp(params.train_start, tz="UTC")
        train_end = pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[0], tz="UTC") - pd.Timedelta(hours=params.embargo_hours)
        events = official_variant(load_official(official_path), "B")
        events = events.loc[events.oblast.isin(first.index) & events.started_at.lt(train_end)].copy()
        events["finished_at"] = events.finished_at.clip(upper=train_end)
        a = train_start.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv").ceil("D")
        b = train_end.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv").floor("D")
        boundaries = pd.date_range(a, b, freq="D")
        daily = []
        for low, high in zip(boundaries[:-1], boundaries[1:]):
            shares = exact_share(events, low, high).reindex(first.index, fill_value=0)
            hours = shares * (high - low).total_seconds() / 3600
            row = {"day": low.date().isoformat(), "day_hours": (high - low).total_seconds() / 3600,
                   "NATIONAL": hours.sum()}
            row.update({oblast: hours[oblast] for oblast in chosen.oblast})
            daily.append(row)
        daily = pd.DataFrame(daily)
        daily.to_csv(out / "train_daily_alert_hours.csv", index=False)
        return daily, chosen
    
    
    def decompose(daily: pd.DataFrame, chosen: pd.DataFrame, out: Path, period: int = 7,
                  seasonal: int = 13) -> pd.DataFrame:
        from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import STL
        from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import acf
    
        rows, components = [], []
        for name in ["NATIONAL", *chosen.oblast.tolist()]:
            observed = daily[name].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            result = STL(observed, period=period, seasonal=seasonal, robust=True).fit()
            rows.append({"series": name, "n_days": len(observed), "period_days": period,
                         "F_T": strength(result.trend, result.resid), "F_S": strength(result.seasonal, result.resid)})
            components.append(pd.DataFrame({"day": daily.day, "series": name, "observed": observed,
                                            "trend": result.trend, "seasonal": result.seasonal, "remainder": result.resid}))
        table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
        table.to_csv(out / "stl_strength.csv", index=False)
        pd.concat(components, ignore_index=True).to_csv(out / "stl_components.csv", index=False)
        correlations = acf(daily.NATIONAL.to_numpy(), nlags=28, fft=False)
        pd.DataFrame({"lag_days": np.arange(len(correlations)), "acf": correlations}).to_csv(out / "national_acf.csv", index=False)
        national = table.loc[table.series.eq("NATIONAL")].iloc[0]
        stronger = "trend" if national.F_T >= national.F_S else "weekly seasonal"
        sentences = [
            f"Descriptive, two-sided STL on {int(national.n_days)} complete TRAIN days gives NATIONAL F_T={national.F_T:.4f} and F_S={national.F_S:.4f}.",
            f"The {stronger} component has the larger NATIONAL variance-reduction strength under this decomposition; this is not forecast skill.",
            "The east/center/west representatives were chosen from first-fold TRAIN rates: highest east, center nearest the overall median, and lowest west; their individual strengths are in stl_strength.csv.",
            "STL uses observations on both sides of each date, so its components never enter model features; the supplied December 2025 definition break also limits causal interpretation.",
            "The ACF is for daily national exposure: its lag is in days and is not the hourly forecast lead k.",
        ]
        (out / "stl_description.md").write_text("\n\n".join(sentences) + "\n")
        return table

    """Offline rendering of computed EDA tables; standard-library CSV input."""
    
    import csv
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    
    
    def plot_eda(out: Path) -> None:
        import matplotlib
        matplotlib.use("Agg")
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    
        with (out / "stl_components.csv").open() as handle:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
        for name in sorted({row["series"] for row in rows}):
            selected = [row for row in rows if row["series"] == name]
            dates = [datetime.fromisoformat(row["day"]) for row in selected]
            fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 1, sharex=True, figsize=(11, 8))
            for ax, field in zip(axes, ("observed", "trend", "seasonal", "remainder")):
                ax.plot(dates, [float(row[field]) for row in selected], linewidth=1)
                ax.set_ylabel(field)
            axes[0].set_title(name + " — TRAIN only; descriptive, two-sided STL")
            fig.autofmt_xdate()
            fig.tight_layout()
            fig.savefig(out / ("stl_" + name.replace(" ", "_") + ".png"), dpi=150)
            plt.close(fig)
        with (out / "national_acf.csv").open() as handle:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
        lags = np.array([int(row["lag_days"]) for row in rows])
        values = np.array([float(row["acf"]) for row in rows])
        ax.vlines(lags, 0, values)
        ax.scatter(lags, values, s=15)
        ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=.7)
        ax.set(title="NATIONAL TRAIN daily alert-hours ACF — lag is not forecast lead k",
               xlabel="Lag (days)", ylabel="Autocorrelation")
        fig.tight_layout()
        fig.savefig(out / "national_acf.png", dpi=150)
        plt.close(fig)

    """UTC interval coverage; callers select sources and exclude unwanted oblasts."""
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    
    def _window(start: str | pd.Timestamp, end: str | pd.Timestamp
                ) -> tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
        start, end = pd.Timestamp(start), pd.Timestamp(end)
        start = start.tz_localize("UTC") if start.tzinfo is None else start.tz_convert("UTC")
        end = end.tz_localize("UTC") if end.tzinfo is None else end.tz_convert("UTC")
        if pd.isna(start) or pd.isna(end) or end <= start:
            raise ValueError("Window must have valid timestamps with end > start")
        return start, end
    
    
    def _clipped(df: pd.DataFrame, start: pd.Timestamp,
                 end: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        rows = df.loc[df["started_at"].lt(end) & df["finished_at"].gt(start),
                      ["oblast", "started_at", "finished_at"]].copy()
        if "is_open" in df:
            rows = rows.loc[~df.loc[rows.index, "is_open"].fillna(False)]
        rows["started_at"] = rows["started_at"].clip(lower=start)
        rows["finished_at"] = rows["finished_at"].clip(upper=end)
        return rows.loc[rows["finished_at"].gt(rows["started_at"])]
    
    
    def hourly_grid(df: pd.DataFrame, start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                    end: str | pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Compatibility wrapper for hour-aligned time_grid(..., freq='60min')."""
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        if start != start.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Hourly grid start must be hour-aligned")
        return time_grid(df, start, end)
    
    
    def time_grid(df: pd.DataFrame, start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                  end: str | pd.Timestamp, freq: str = "60min") -> pd.DataFrame:
        """OR positive closed intervals touching bins in [start, end), in UTC.
    
        Bins are anchored at start. Partial final bins are clipped to end. Open and
        empty intervals cover no time. All input oblasts remain as columns.
        """
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        step = pd.Timedelta(freq)
        if step <= pd.Timedelta(0):
            raise ValueError("freq must be a positive fixed duration")
        index = pd.date_range(start, end, freq=step, inclusive="left", name="hour")
        columns = pd.Index(sorted(df["oblast"].dropna().unique()), name="oblast")
        result = pd.DataFrame(False, index=index, columns=columns)
        for oblast, rows in _clipped(df, start, end).groupby("oblast"):
            left = index.searchsorted(rows["started_at"], side="right") - 1
            right = index.searchsorted(rows["finished_at"], side="left")
            changes = np.zeros(len(index) + 1, dtype=np.int64)
            np.add.at(changes, left, 1)
            np.add.at(changes, right, -1)
            result[oblast] = np.cumsum(changes[:-1]) > 0
        return result
    
    
    def episodes(df: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str, start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                 end: str | pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Merge strictly overlapping closed intervals, clipping to the window.
    
        Abutting half-open intervals remain separate episodes (no overlap).
        """
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        rows = _clipped(df.loc[df["oblast"].eq(oblast)], start, end).sort_values("started_at")
        merged: list[tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]] = []
        for a, b in rows[["started_at", "finished_at"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None):
            if merged and a < merged[-1][1]:
                merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0], max(merged[-1][1], b))
            else:
                merged.append((a, b))
        result = pd.DataFrame(merged, columns=["started_at", "finished_at"])
        for column in result:
            result[column] = pd.to_datetime(result[column], utc=True)
        return result
    
    
    def exact_share(df: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str | pd.Timestamp | None = None,
                    start: str | pd.Timestamp | None = None,
                    end: str | pd.Timestamp | None = None) -> pd.Series | float:
        """Fraction of window covered by each oblast's interval union.
    
        Use exact elapsed time, including sub-minute precision, without rounding
        or double-counting overlaps. Preserve oblasts with zero coverage.
    
        Also supports the existing exact_share(df, start, end) Series interface.
        """
        if end is None:
            oblast, start, end = None, oblast, start
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        if oblast is not None:
            merged = episodes(df, str(oblast), start, end)
            return float((merged["finished_at"] - merged["started_at"]).sum() / (end - start))
        result = pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(sorted(df["oblast"].dropna().unique()),
                                            name="oblast"), name="exact_share")
        for oblast, rows in _clipped(df, start, end).groupby("oblast"):
            covered = pd.Timedelta(0)
            union_start, union_end = None, None
            for a, b in rows.sort_values("started_at")[["started_at", "finished_at"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None):
                if union_end is None or a > union_end:
                    if union_end is not None:
                        covered += union_end - union_start
                    union_start, union_end = a, b
                else:
                    union_end = max(union_end, b)
            if union_end is not None:
                covered += union_end - union_start
            result.loc[oblast] = covered / (end - start)
        return result

    """Expanding training windows with lead-specific target-end embargo."""
    
    from dataclasses import dataclass
    from typing import Iterator
    
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import _window
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class FoldParams:
        train_start: str = "2025-12-01"
        boundaries: tuple[str, ...] = ("2026-06-01", "2026-06-16", "2026-07-01", "2026-07-16", "2026-08-01")
        test_start: str = "2026-08-01"
        embargo_hours: int = 25
    
    
    def walk_forward_folds(rows: pd.DataFrame, params: FoldParams, lead: int,
                           final_test: bool = False) -> Iterator[tuple[str, pd.Series, pd.Series]]:
        # Moving a configured TEST date later must not silently waive this stage's
        # reserved August boundary. A final-test invocation is the only waiver.
        limit = min(pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC"), pd.Timestamp(FoldParams().test_start, tz="UTC"))
        boundaries = [pd.Timestamp(b, tz="UTC") for b in params.boundaries]
        if not final_test and any(b > limit for b in boundaries):
            raise ValueError("Evaluation extends into TEST; final_test=True is required")
        train_start = pd.Timestamp(params.train_start, tz="UTC")
        if params.embargo_hours < 25 or params.embargo_hours < lead + 1:
            raise ValueError("Embargo must be >=25 hours and >=lead+1")
        if lead < 0 or len(boundaries) < 2 or train_start >= boundaries[0]:
            raise ValueError("Require nonnegative lead, at least two boundaries, and TRAIN_START before validation")
        if any(b != b.floor("h") for b in boundaries) or train_start != train_start.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Split boundaries must be whole UTC hours")
        target_end = rows["T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=lead + 1)
        available = rows[f"y_{lead}"].notna()
        for i, (start, end) in enumerate(zip(boundaries[:-1], boundaries[1:]), 1):
            _window(start, end)
            train_end = start - pd.Timedelta(hours=params.embargo_hours)
            train = rows["T"].ge(train_start) & rows["T"].lt(train_end) & target_end.le(start) & available
            evaluate = rows["T"].ge(start) & rows["T"].lt(end) & available
            if not final_test:
                evaluate &= target_end.le(limit)
            yield str(i), train, evaluate

    """Variant-B hourly panel: causal observations, bounded labels, local clocks."""
    
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import episodes, time_grid, _window
    from airalerts.io import official_variant
    
    DEFAULT_LEADS = (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 12, 24)
    
    
    def save_frame(frame: pd.DataFrame, path: Path) -> Path:
        """Prefer parquet; offline installations without pyarrow use csv.gz."""
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            import pyarrow  # noqa: F401
        except ImportError:
            path = path.with_suffix(".csv.gz")
            frame.to_csv(path, index=False, compression={"method": "gzip", "mtime": 0})
        else:
            frame.to_parquet(path, index=False)
        return path
    
    
    def _prefix_coverage(merged: pd.DataFrame, boundaries: pd.DatetimeIndex) -> np.ndarray:
        """Elapsed union seconds before each boundary, using existing episodes()."""
        if merged.empty:
            return np.zeros(len(boundaries))
        a = pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.started_at).as_unit("ns").asi8
        b = pd.DatetimeIndex(merged.finished_at).as_unit("ns").asi8
        t = boundaries.as_unit("ns").asi8
        pos = np.searchsorted(b, t, side="right")
        cumulative = np.r_[0., np.cumsum((b - a) / 1e9)]
        next_pos = np.minimum(pos, len(a) - 1)
        partial = np.clip((t - a[next_pos]) / 1e9, 0, (b[next_pos] - a[next_pos]) / 1e9)
        return cumulative[pos] + np.where(pos < len(a), partial, 0)
    
    
    def _profile(signal: np.ndarray, index: pd.DatetimeIndex, hours: int,
                 lead: int, weekly: bool) -> np.ndarray:
        local = index.tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
        keys = local.hour.to_numpy() + (24 * local.dayofweek.to_numpy() if weekly else 0)
        target = (index + pd.Timedelta(hours=lead)).tz_convert("Europe/Kyiv")
        wanted = target.hour.to_numpy() + (24 * target.dayofweek.to_numpy() if weekly else 0)
        result = np.zeros(len(index))
        upper = np.arange(len(index))  # exclude the current, incompletely observed hour
        lower = np.maximum(upper - hours, 0)
        for key in np.unique(wanted):
            matches = keys == key
            count = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(matches)]
            positives = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(signal * matches)]
            selected = wanted == key
            numerator = positives[upper[selected]] - positives[lower[selected]]
            denominator = count[upper[selected]] - count[lower[selected]]
            result[selected] = np.divide(numerator, denominator, out=np.zeros(len(numerator)), where=denominator > 0)
        return result
    
    
    def build_panel(df: pd.DataFrame, start: str | pd.Timestamp, end: str | pd.Timestamp,
                    leads: tuple[int, ...] = DEFAULT_LEADS, variant: str = "B",
                    day_windows: tuple[int, ...] = (7, 14, 28), week_windows: tuple[int, ...] = (4, 8),
                    alphas: tuple[float, ...] = (.01, .05, .1, .3, .6),
                    history_days: int = 28, end_cap_hours: int = 72,
                    excluded: tuple[str, ...] = ("Luhanska oblast", "Crimea", "Sevastopol"),
                    oblasts: list[str] | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Build [start,end) without any target hour extending beyond end.
    
        End is the available label boundary, not a retrospectively fitted parameter.
        Warmup covers all requested trailing windows. Missing ends extend only the
        as-of observation history, never supply future labels. Profiles/SES columns
        are fixed-candidate causal observations; models select candidates on TRAIN.
        """
        start, end = _window(start, end)
        if start != start.floor("h") or end != end.floor("h"):
            raise ValueError("Panel boundaries must be whole UTC hours")
        if any(k < 0 for k in leads) or any(n <= 0 for n in (*day_windows, *week_windows)):
            raise ValueError("Leads/windows must be nonnegative/positive")
        if any(not 0 < alpha <= 1 for alpha in alphas):

        observed = selected.copy()

    """Offline rendering of computed EDA tables; standard-library CSV input."""
    
    import csv
    from datetime import datetime
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import numpy as np
    
    
    def plot_eda(out: Path) -> None:
        import matplotlib
        matplotlib.use("Agg")
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    
        with (out / "stl_components.csv").open() as handle:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
        for name in sorted({row["series"] for row in rows}):
            selected = [row for row in rows if row["series"] == name]
            dates = [datetime.fromisoformat(row["day"]) for row in selected]
            fig, axes = plt.subplots(4, 1, sharex=True, figsize=(11, 8))
            for ax, field in zip(axes, ("observed", "trend", "seasonal", "remainder")):
                ax.plot(dates, [float(row[field]) for row in selected], linewidth=1)
                ax.set_ylabel(field)
            axes[0].set_title(name + " — TRAIN only; descriptive, two-sided STL")
            fig.autofmt_xdate()
            fig.tight_layout()
            fig.savefig(out / ("stl_" + name.replace(" ", "_") + ".png"), dpi=150)
            plt.close(fig)
        with (out / "national_acf.csv").open() as handle:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
        lags = np.array([int(row["lag_days"]) for row in rows])
        values = np.array([float(row["acf"]) for row in rows])
        ax.vlines(lags, 0, values)
        ax.scatter(lags, values, s=15)
        ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=.7)
        ax.set(title="NATIONAL TRAIN daily alert-hours ACF — lag is not forecast lead k",
               xlabel="Lag (days)", ylabel="Autocorrelation")
        fig.tight_layout()
        fig.savefig(out / "national_acf.png", dpi=150)
        plt.close(fig)

    """Group A/B observations at T; fitted rates use only the fold's TRAIN.
    
    No calendar fields, STL components or future labels enter transform().
    """
    
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import episodes, exact_share
    from airalerts.io import official_variant
    from airalerts.neighbors import NEIGHBORS, validate_neighbors
    
    GROUP_A = ("active_now", "hours_since_end", "never_alerted", "elapsed_in_alert",
               "share_1h", "share_6h", "share_24h", "share_168h", "starts_24h")
    GROUP_B = ("base_rate", "neighbor_share_now", "neighbor_share_6h", "national_active_count")
    
    
    def own_features(events: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str, T: str | pd.Timestamp,
                     cap_hours: int = 168) -> dict[str, float]:
        """Exact union exposure; starts count transitions into an oblast alert.
    
        Starts use (T-24h,T], rather than counting simultaneous raion starts.
        Unknown/future ends are replaced only internally by T+1 second. Abutting
        intervals are one continuous state, preserving elapsed time at T.
        """
        t = pd.Timestamp(T)
        t = t.tz_localize("UTC") if t.tzinfo is None else t.tz_convert("UTC")
        if pd.isna(t) or t != t.floor("h") or cap_hours <= 0:
            raise ValueError("T must be a whole UTC hour and cap_hours positive")
        rows = official_variant(events, "B")
        rows = rows.loc[rows.oblast.eq(oblast) & rows.started_at.le(t)].copy()
        unknown = rows.finished_at.isna() | rows.finished_at.gt(t)
        rows.loc[unknown, "finished_at"] = t + pd.Timedelta(seconds=1)
        rows = rows.drop(columns="is_open", errors="ignore")
        rows = rows.loc[rows.finished_at.gt(rows.started_at)]
        active = bool(rows.finished_at.gt(t).any())
        low = min(rows.started_at.min(), t - pd.Timedelta(hours=168)) if len(rows) else t - pd.Timedelta(hours=168)
        union = episodes(rows, oblast, low, t + pd.Timedelta(seconds=1), merge_adjacent=True)
        current = union.loc[union.finished_at.gt(t)]
        elapsed = (t - current.started_at.iloc[-1]).total_seconds() / 3600 if active else 0.
        closed = union.loc[union.finished_at.le(t)]
        since = 0. if active else min(cap_hours, (t - closed.finished_at.max()).total_seconds() / 3600) if len(closed) else float(cap_hours)
        result = {"active_now": float(active), "hours_since_end": float(since),
                  "never_alerted": float(rows.empty), "elapsed_in_alert": elapsed,
                  "starts_24h": float((union.started_at.gt(t - pd.Timedelta(hours=24)) & union.started_at.le(t)).sum())}
        for hours in (1, 6, 24, 168):
            result[f"share_{hours}h"] = exact_share(rows, oblast, t - pd.Timedelta(hours=hours), t)
        return result
    
    
    class AsOfFeatures:
        """Freeze TRAIN rates, then derive current context from causal panel rows.
    
        Panel state/share_6h must come from build_panel's as-of observations.
        Transform accesses panel rows at T only, and events started no later than T.
        """
    
        def __init__(self, neighbors: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] | None = None) -> None:
            self.neighbors = NEIGHBORS if neighbors is None else neighbors
            self.base_rates: pd.Series | None = None
    
        def fit(self, train: pd.DataFrame, valid_start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                embargo_hours: int = 25) -> "AsOfFeatures":
            boundary = pd.Timestamp(valid_start)
            boundary = boundary.tz_localize("UTC") if boundary.tzinfo is None else boundary.tz_convert("UTC")
            if embargo_hours < 25 or train.empty or train.T if False else False:
                pass
            if embargo_hours < 25 or train.empty:
                raise ValueError("Require nonempty TRAIN and >=25-hour embargo")
            if train["T"].ge(boundary - pd.Timedelta(hours=embargo_hours)).any():
                raise ValueError("Rate fitting includes rows outside embargoed TRAIN")
            if train.y_0.isna().any():
                raise ValueError("TRAIN base rates require known y_0")
            validate_neighbors(train.oblast.unique().tolist(), self.neighbors)
            self.base_rates = train.groupby("oblast").y_0.mean()
            return self
    
        def transform(self, events: pd.DataFrame, panel: pd.DataFrame,
                      rows: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
            if self.base_rates is None:
                raise ValueError("Fit on TRAIN before transforming")
            required = set(self.neighbors)
            output = []
            for t, requested in rows.groupby("T", sort=True):
                context = panel.loc[panel["T"].eq(t)].set_index("oblast")
                if context.index.has_duplicates or set(context.index) != required:
                    raise ValueError("Each T needs exactly one causal panel row per oblast")
                national = float(context.state.sum())
                for oblast in requested.oblast:
                    if oblast not in required:
                        raise ValueError("Requested oblast is outside fitted geography")
                    values = own_features(events, oblast, t)
                    adjacent = list(self.neighbors[oblast])
                    values.update(base_rate=float(self.base_rates.loc[oblast]),
                                  neighbor_share_now=float(context.loc[adjacent, "state"].mean()),
                                  neighbor_share_6h=float(context.loc[adjacent, "share_6h"].mean()),
                                  national_active_count=national)
                    output.append({"oblast": oblast, "T": t, **values})
            return pd.DataFrame(output, columns=["oblast", "T", *GROUP_A, *GROUP_B])

        The raw UID is preserved alongside oblast_resolution for auditing fallbacks.
        """

        if variant not in {"all", "red"}:
            raise ValueError("API variant must be all or red")
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
        for column in ("started_at", "finished_at", "fetched_at"):
            if column in df:
                df[column] = pd.to_datetime(df[column], utc=True, format="ISO8601", errors="raise")
        if df["started_at"].isna().any():
            raise ValueError("API intervals contain NaT started_at")
        df["is_open"] = df["finished_at"].isna()
        validate(df.loc[~df["is_open"]])
        resolved = [resolve_oblast(row.get("location_oblast_uid"), row.get("queried_uid"), row.get("oblast"))
                    for row in df.to_dict(orient="records")]

        df["oblast_resolution"] = [method for _, method in resolved]
        df["level"] = df["location_type"]
        for column in ("alert_level", "threat_types"):
            if column not in df:
                df[column] = ""
            df[column] = df[column].fillna("")
        if air_raid_only:
            df = df.loc[df["alert_type"].eq("air_raid")]
        if variant == "red":
            df = df.loc[df["alert_level"].eq("red")]
        return df.reset_index(drop=True)

    def official_variant(df: pd.DataFrame, variant: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """A all; B oblast+raion; C duration <=24 h; D both B and C."""
        if variant not in {"A", "B", "C", "D"}:
            raise ValueError("official variant must be A, B, C or D")
        keep = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
        if variant in {"B", "D"}:
            keep &= df["level"].isin(["oblast", "raion"])
        if variant in {"C", "D"}:
            keep &= (df["finished_at"] - df["started_at"]).le(pd.Timedelta(hours=24))
        return df.loc[keep].copy()
    
    
    def load_alerts_in_ua(path: str | Path, air_raid_only: bool = True,
                          variant: str = "all") -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Load API rows, retaining opens and metadata for separate reporting.
    
        English names share the collector's resolver. Malformed closed timestamps
        raise; genuinely null ends remain NaT and are ignored by interval maths.
        The raw UID is preserved alongside oblast_resolution for auditing fallbacks.
        """
        from airalerts.collect.alerts_in_ua import resolve_oblast

    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import pytest
    
    from airalerts.eda import strength
    from airalerts.features import AsOfFeatures, GROUP_A, GROUP_B, own_features
    from airalerts.neighbors import NEIGHBORS, validate_neighbors
    from airalerts.panel import build_panel
    
    
    def events(rows: list[tuple]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        frame = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["oblast", "level", "started_at", "finished_at"])
        for column in ("started_at", "finished_at"):
            frame[column] = pd.to_datetime(frame[column], utc=True, format="mixed")
        return frame
    
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("end", ["2026-01-03 14:00", None])
    def test_ongoing_end_is_unknown(end) -> None:
        frame = events([("A", "raion", "2026-01-03 10:00", end)])
        result = own_features(frame, "A", "2026-01-03 12:00")
        assert result["active_now"] == 1
        assert result["hours_since_end"] == 0
        assert result["elapsed_in_alert"] == 2
        assert result["never_alerted"] == 0
        assert result["share_1h"] == 1
        assert result["share_6h"] == pytest.approx(2 / 6)
        assert result["starts_24h"] == 1
    
    
    def test_closed_never_and_capped() -> None:
        frame = events([("A", "oblast", "2026-01-03 08:00", "2026-01-03 09:00")])
        result = own_features(frame, "A", "2026-01-03 12:00")
        assert result["hours_since_end"] == 3
        assert result["elapsed_in_alert"] == 0
        assert own_features(frame, "B", "2026-01-03 12:00")["never_alerted"] == 1
        old = own_features(frame, "A", "2026-01-20 12:00")
        assert old["hours_since_end"] == 168 and old["never_alerted"] == 0
        assert own_features(frame.iloc[:0], "A", "2026-01-03 12:00")["hours_since_end"] == 168
    
    
    def test_union_starts_adjacent_and_variant_b() -> None:
        frame = events([
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-03 08:00", "2026-01-03 10:00"),
            ("A", "oblast", "2026-01-03 09:00", "2026-01-03 10:00"),
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-03 10:00", "2026-01-03 14:00"),
            ("A", "hromada", "2026-01-01", "2026-01-05"),
        ])
        result = own_features(frame, "A", "2026-01-03 12:00")
        assert result["elapsed_in_alert"] == 4
        assert result["starts_24h"] == 1
        assert result["share_6h"] == pytest.approx(4 / 6)
        at_start = own_features(frame.iloc[[0]], "A", "2026-01-03 08:00")
        assert at_start["active_now"] == 1 and at_start["elapsed_in_alert"] == 0
        assert at_start["share_1h"] == 0 and at_start["starts_24h"] == 1
    
    
    def test_future_event_perturbation() -> None:
        frame = events([
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-03 08:00", "2026-01-03 14:00"),
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-03 16:00", "2026-01-03 20:00"),
        ])
        t = pd.Timestamp("2026-01-03 12:00", tz="UTC")
        changed = frame.loc[frame.started_at.le(t)].copy()
        changed.loc[changed.finished_at.gt(t), "finished_at"] = pd.NaT
        assert own_features(frame, "A", t) == own_features(changed, "A", t)
    
    
    def test_future_panel_flips_and_train_only_rates() -> None:
        frame = events([
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-01 08:00", "2026-01-03 14:00"),
            ("B", "raion", "2026-01-02 10:00", "2026-01-03 13:00"),
        ])
        panel = build_panel(frame, "2026-01-01", "2026-01-05", leads=(0,),
                            day_windows=(), week_windows=(), alphas=(), oblasts=["A", "B"])
        train = panel.loc[panel["T"].lt(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01 23:00", tz="UTC"))]
        builder = AsOfFeatures({"A": ("B",), "B": ("A",)}).fit(train, "2026-01-03")
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        for t in rng.choice(panel.loc[panel["T"].ge(pd.Timestamp("2026-01-03", tz="UTC")), "T"].unique(), 5, replace=False):
            requested = panel.loc[panel["T"].eq(t), ["oblast", "T"]]
            before = builder.transform(frame, panel, requested)
            changed = panel.copy()
            future = changed["T"].gt(t)
            for column in ("state", "share_6h", "y_0"):
                values = rng.integers(0, 2, future.sum())
                changed.loc[future, column] = values.astype(bool) if column in ("state", "y_0") else values.astype(float)
            after = builder.transform(frame, changed, requested)
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(before, after)
            assert list(before.columns) == ["oblast", "T", *GROUP_A, *GROUP_B]
            assert before.set_index("oblast").base_rate.to_dict() == train.groupby("oblast").y_0.mean().to_dict()
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="outside embargoed TRAIN"):
            builder.fit(panel, "2026-01-03")
    
    
    def test_neighbors() -> None:
        validate_neighbors(list(NEIGHBORS))
        assert len(NEIGHBORS) == 24
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            validate_neighbors(["A", "B"], {"A": ("B",), "B": ("B",)})
    
    
    def test_stl_strength() -> None:
        assert strength(np.arange(5.), np.zeros(5)) == 1
        assert strength(np.zeros(5), np.arange(5.)) == 0
        assert np.isnan(strength(np.zeros(5), np.zeros(5)))

    def latest_results(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Latest execution per model/fold/lead, retaining all its scope rows.
    
        Append position breaks creation-time ties. Duplicate scope rows within an
        execution retain their last occurrence. Old SES fields remain missing.
        """
        frame = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"run_id": str, "fold_id": str})
        if "bss_vs_ses" not in frame:
            frame["bss_vs_ses"] = np.nan
        frame["_order"] = np.arange(len(frame))
        frame["_created"] = pd.to_datetime(frame.created_at, utc=True, format="ISO8601", errors="coerce")
        frame["_created"] = frame["_created"].fillna(pd.Timestamp("1970-01-01", tz="UTC"))
        keys = ["model", "fold_id", "lead"]
        ordered = frame.sort_values(["_created", "_order"])
        newest = ordered.drop_duplicates(keys, keep="last")[keys + ["run_id"]]
        selected = ordered.merge(newest, on=keys + ["run_id"], how="inner")
        return selected.drop_duplicates(keys + ["scope"], keep="last").drop(columns=["_order", "_created"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    
    def _upgrade_schema(path: Path) -> None:
        """One-time additive header upgrade; preserve every old field verbatim.
    
        This adds an empty SES cell to old records without changing metric values,
        order or record count. Subsequent writes append only. No records are dropped.
        """
        with path.open(newline="") as handle:
            old = next(csv.reader(handle))
        if old == RESULT_COLUMNS:
            return
        if old != RESULT_COLUMNS[:-1]:
            raise ValueError("Existing results.csv schema differs")
        temporary = None
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", newline="", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as output:
                temporary = Path(output.name)
                writer = csv.writer(output)
                writer.writerow(RESULT_COLUMNS)
                with path.open(newline="") as source:
                    reader = csv.reader(source)
                    next(reader)
                    for row in reader:
                        if len(row) != len(old):
                            raise ValueError("Malformed legacy log row")
                        writer.writerow(row + [""])
            os.replace(temporary, path)
        finally:
            if temporary is not None and temporary.exists():
                temporary.unlink()
    
    
    def log_result(path: Path, result: dict) -> None:
        """The only results.csv writer; refuse schema drift before appending."""
        if set(result) != set(RESULT_COLUMNS):
            raise ValueError("Result does not match the results.csv schema")

    def validate_neighbors(oblasts: list[str], neighbors: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = NEIGHBORS) -> None:
        """Require exact geography, nonempty symmetric edges and no self-links."""
        if set(oblasts) != set(neighbors):
            raise ValueError("Neighbor keys must match panel oblast names exactly")
        for oblast, adjacent in neighbors.items():
            if not adjacent or oblast in adjacent or len(adjacent) != len(set(adjacent)):
                raise ValueError("Neighbors must be nonempty, unique, and exclude self")
            for other in adjacent:
                if other not in neighbors or oblast not in neighbors[other]:
                    raise ValueError("Neighbor edges must be symmetric and inside the panel")

    """Group A/B observations at T; fitted rates use only the fold's TRAIN.
    
    No calendar fields, STL components or future labels enter transform().
    """
    
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.grid import episodes, exact_share
    from airalerts.io import official_variant
    from airalerts.neighbors import NEIGHBORS, validate_neighbors
    
    GROUP_A = ("active_now", "hours_since_end", "never_alerted", "elapsed_in_alert",
               "share_1h", "share_6h", "share_24h", "share_168h", "starts_24h")
    GROUP_B = ("base_rate", "neighbor_share_now", "neighbor_share_6h", "national_active_count")
    
    
    def own_features(events: pd.DataFrame, oblast: str, T: str | pd.Timestamp,
                     cap_hours: int = 168) -> dict[str, float]:
        """Exact union exposure; starts count transitions into an oblast alert.
    
        Starts use (T-24h,T], rather than counting simultaneous raion starts.
        Unknown/future ends are replaced only internally by T+1 second. Abutting
        intervals are one continuous state, preserving elapsed time at T.
        """
        t = pd.Timestamp(T)
        t = t.tz_localize("UTC") if t.tzinfo is None else t.tz_convert("UTC")
        if pd.isna(t) or t != t.floor("h") or cap_hours <= 0:
            raise ValueError("T must be a whole UTC hour and cap_hours positive")
        rows = official_variant(events, "B")
        rows = rows.loc[rows.oblast.eq(oblast) & rows.started_at.le(t)].copy()
        unknown = rows.finished_at.isna() | rows.finished_at.gt(t)
        rows.loc[unknown, "finished_at"] = t + pd.Timedelta(seconds=1)
        rows = rows.drop(columns="is_open", errors="ignore")
        rows = rows.loc[rows.finished_at.gt(rows.started_at)]
        active = bool(rows.finished_at.gt(t).any())
        low = min(rows.started_at.min(), t - pd.Timedelta(hours=168)) if len(rows) else t - pd.Timedelta(hours=168)
        union = episodes(rows, oblast, low, t + pd.Timedelta(seconds=1), merge_adjacent=True)
        current = union.loc[union.finished_at.gt(t)]
        elapsed = (t - current.started_at.iloc[-1]).total_seconds() / 3600 if active else 0.
        closed = union.loc[union.finished_at.le(t)]
        since = 0. if active else min(cap_hours, (t - closed.finished_at.max()).total_seconds() / 3600) if len(closed) else float(cap_hours)
        result = {"active_now": float(active), "hours_since_end": float(since),
                  "never_alerted": float(rows.empty), "elapsed_in_alert": elapsed,
                  "starts_24h": float((union.started_at.gt(t - pd.Timedelta(hours=24)) & union.started_at.le(t)).sum())}
        for hours in (1, 6, 24, 168):
            result[f"share_{hours}h"] = exact_share(rows, oblast, t - pd.Timedelta(hours=hours), t)
        return result
    
    
    class AsOfFeatures:
        """Freeze TRAIN rates, then derive current context from causal panel rows.
    
        Panel state/share_6h must come from build_panel's as-of observations.
        Transform accesses panel rows at T only, and events started no later than T.
        """
    
        def __init__(self, neighbors: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] | None = None) -> None:
            self.neighbors = NEIGHBORS if neighbors is None else neighbors
            self.base_rates: pd.Series | None = None
    
        def fit(self, train: pd.DataFrame, valid_start: str | pd.Timestamp,
                embargo_hours: int = 25) -> "AsOfFeatures":
            boundary = pd.Timestamp(valid_start)
            boundary = boundary.tz_localize("UTC") if boundary.tzinfo is None else boundary.tz_convert("UTC")
            if embargo_hours < 25 or train.empty:
                raise ValueError("Require nonempty TRAIN and >=25-hour embargo")
            if train["T"].ge(boundary - pd.Timedelta(hours=embargo_hours)).any():
                raise ValueError("Rate fitting includes rows outside embargoed TRAIN")
            if train.y_0.isna().any():
                raise ValueError("TRAIN base rates require known y_0")
            validate_neighbors(train.oblast.unique().tolist(), self.neighbors)
            self.base_rates = train.groupby("oblast").y_0.mean()
            return self
    
        def transform(self, events: pd.DataFrame, panel: pd.DataFrame,
                      rows: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
            if self.base_rates is None:
                raise ValueError("Fit on TRAIN before transforming")
            required = set(self.neighbors)
            output = []
            for t, requested in rows.groupby("T", sort=True):
                context = panel.loc[panel["T"].eq(t)].set_index("oblast")
                if context.index.has_duplicates or set(context.index) != required:
                    raise ValueError("Each T needs exactly one causal panel row per oblast")
                national = float(context.state.sum())
                for oblast in requested.oblast:
                    if oblast not in required:
                        raise ValueError("Requested oblast is outside fitted geography")
                    values = own_features(events, oblast, t)
                    adjacent = list(self.neighbors[oblast])
                    values.update(base_rate=float(self.base_rates.loc[oblast]),
                                  neighbor_share_now=float(context.loc[adjacent, "state"].mean()),
                                  neighbor_share_6h=float(context.loc[adjacent, "share_6h"].mean()),
                                  national_active_count=national)
                    output.append({"oblast": oblast, "T": t, **values})
            return pd.DataFrame(output, columns=["oblast", "T", *GROUP_A, *GROUP_B])
    """Probability metrics, paired UTC-day bootstrap, and one append-only logger."""
    
    import csv
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import tempfile
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    RESULT_COLUMNS = ["run_id", "git_commit", "created_at", "model", "params_json", "seed", "train_start", "fold_id",
                      "eval_start", "eval_end", "lead", "scope", "n", "base_rate", "brier", "bss_vs_clim",
                      "bss_vs_persistence", "bss_ci_low", "bss_ci_high", "ece", "notes", "bss_vs_ses"]
    
    
    def brier(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(np.mean((y - p) ** 2)) if len(y) else np.nan
    
    
    def bss(score: float, reference: float) -> float:
        return 1 - score / reference if reference > 0 else np.nan
    
    
    def reliability(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, bins: int = 10) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if not np.isfinite(p).all() or ((p < 0) | (p > 1)).any():
            raise ValueError("Probabilities must be finite and in [0,1]")
        bucket = np.minimum((p * bins).astype(int), bins - 1)
        rows = []
        for i in range(bins):
            mask = bucket == i
            rows.append({"bin": i, "lower": i / bins, "upper": (i + 1) / bins, "n": int(mask.sum()),
                         "mean_probability": float(p[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else np.nan,
                         "observed_rate": float(y[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else np.nan})
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
    
    
    def ece(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, bins: int = 10) -> float:
        table = reliability(y, p, bins)
        return float((table.n * (table.mean_probability - table.observed_rate).abs()).sum() / len(y)) if len(y) else np.nan
    
    
    def bootstrap_bss(rows: pd.DataFrame, reference: str = "clim", seed: int = 42,
                      samples: int = 300, block_days: int = 7) -> tuple[float, float]:
        """Paired circular moving blocks of UTC days, shared across all regions."""
        if samples < 1 or block_days < 1:
            raise ValueError("Bootstrap samples/block_days must be positive")
        if rows.empty:
            return np.nan, np.nan
        errors = pd.DataFrame({"day": rows["T"].dt.floor("D"),
                               "model": (rows.y - rows.p) ** 2,
                               "reference": (rows.y - rows[reference]) ** 2}).groupby("day").sum()
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        starts = rng.integers(0, len(errors), size=(samples, int(np.ceil(len(errors) / block_days))))
        selected = ((starts[..., None] + np.arange(block_days)) % len(errors)).reshape(samples, -1)[:, :len(errors)]
        numerator = errors.model.to_numpy()[selected].sum(axis=1)
        denominator = errors.reference.to_numpy()[selected].sum(axis=1)
        values = 1 - np.divide(numerator, denominator, out=np.full(samples, np.nan), where=denominator > 0)
        finite = values[np.isfinite(values)]
        return tuple(np.quantile(finite, [.025, .975])) if len(finite) else (np.nan, np.nan)
    
    
    def metric_row(rows: pd.DataFrame, bins: int = 10) -> dict:
        y, p = rows.y.to_numpy(dtype=float), rows.p.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        score = brier(y, p)
        return {"n": len(rows), "base_rate": float(y.mean()) if len(y) else np.nan, "brier": score,
                "bss_vs_clim": bss(score, brier(y, rows.clim.to_numpy())),
                "bss_vs_persistence": bss(score, brier(y, rows.persistence.to_numpy())),
                "bss_vs_ses": bss(score, brier(y, rows.ses.to_numpy())) if "ses" in rows else np.nan,
                "ece": ece(y, p, bins)}
    
    
    def latest_results(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Latest execution per model/fold/lead, retaining all its scope rows.
    
        Append position breaks creation-time ties. Duplicate scope rows within an
        execution retain their last occurrence. Old SES fields remain missing.
        """
        frame = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"run_id": str, "fold_id": str})
        if "bss_vs_ses" not in frame:
            frame["bss_vs_ses"] = np.nan
        frame["_order"] = np.arange(len(frame))
        frame["_created"] = pd.to_datetime(frame.created_at, utc=True, format="ISO8601", errors="coerce")
        frame["_created"] = frame["_created"].fillna(pd.Timestamp("1970-01-01", tz="UTC"))
        keys = ["model", "fold_id", "lead"]
        ordered = frame.sort_values(["_created", "_order"])
        newest = ordered.drop_duplicates(keys, keep="last")[keys + ["run_id"]]
        selected = ordered.merge(newest, on=keys + ["run_id"], how="inner")
        return selected.drop_duplicates(keys + ["scope"], keep="last").drop(columns=["_order", "_created"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    
    def _upgrade_schema(path: Path) -> None:
        """One-time additive header upgrade; preserve every old field verbatim.
    
        This adds an empty SES cell to old records without changing metric values,
        order or record count. Subsequent writes append only. No records are dropped.
        """
        with path.open(newline="") as handle:
            old = next(csv.reader(handle))
        if old == RESULT_COLUMNS:
            return
        if old != RESULT_COLUMNS[:-1]:
            raise ValueError("Existing results.csv schema differs")
        temporary = None
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", newline="", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as output:
                temporary = Path(output.name)
                writer = csv.writer(output)
                writer.writerow(RESULT_COLUMNS)
                with path.open(newline="") as source:
                    reader = csv.reader(source)
                    next(reader)
                    for row in reader:
                        if len(row) != len(old):
                            raise ValueError("Malformed legacy log row")
                        writer.writerow(row + [""])
            os.replace(temporary, path)
        finally:
            if temporary is not None and temporary.exists():
                temporary.unlink()
    
    
    def log_result(path: Path, result: dict) -> None:
        """The only results.csv writer; refuse schema drift before appending."""
        if set(result) != set(RESULT_COLUMNS):
            raise ValueError("Result does not match the results.csv schema")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        exists = path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > 0
        if exists:
            _upgrade_schema(path)
        with path.open("a", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=RESULT_COLUMNS)
            if not exists:
                writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerow(result)
    """Offline reference validation only; no final-test invocation exists here."""
    
    import argparse
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    import hashlib
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    import subprocess
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.evaluate import bootstrap_bss, log_result, metric_row, reliability
    from airalerts.io import load_official, valid_end
    from airalerts.models import ReferenceModel
    from airalerts.panel import DEFAULT_LEADS, build_panel, save_frame
    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams, walk_forward_folds
    
    
    def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> pd.DataFrame:
        params = FoldParams(args.train_start, tuple(args.fold_boundaries), args.test_start, args.embargo_hours)
        end = pd.Timestamp(params.boundaries[-1], tz="UTC")
        if end > pd.Timestamp("2026-08-01", tz="UTC") or end > pd.Timestamp(params.test_start, tz="UTC"):
            raise ValueError("Task 5A evaluation/panel must end no later than 2026-08-01")
        # Guard all boundaries before reading the input or constructing a panel.
        empty = pd.DataFrame({"T": pd.Series([], dtype="datetime64[ns, UTC]"), "y_0": pd.Series([], dtype="boolean")})
        list(walk_forward_folds(empty, params, 0))
        official = load_official(args.official)
        if end > valid_end(official):
            raise ValueError("Validation exceeds the independently trimmed source end")
        # Discard every start in TEST and hide finishes beyond validation. No TEST
        # labels or test rows enter any panel, fitted rate, tuning or metric.
        official = official.loc[official.started_at.lt(end)].copy()
        panel = build_panel(official, params.train_start, end, leads=tuple(args.leads), variant=args.variant,
                            day_windows=tuple(args.day_windows), week_windows=tuple(args.week_windows),
                            alphas=tuple(args.alphas))
        panel_path = save_frame(panel, Path("data/processed/panel.parquet"))
        print(f"Panel saved: {panel_path}; {len(panel)} rows; T in [{panel['T'].min()}, {end})")
        commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        dirty = bool(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], text=True).strip())
        config = vars(args).copy()
        config["official"] = str(args.official)
        input_hash = hashlib.sha256(args.official.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        config["input_sha256"] = input_hash
        source_files = [Path(__file__), *[Path("src/airalerts") / name for name in
                        ("panel.py", "splits.py", "models.py", "evaluate.py", "grid.py", "io.py")]]
        config["source_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(b"".join(path.read_bytes() for path in source_files)).hexdigest()
        config["dirty_worktree"] = dirty
        config["validation_label_boundary"] = end.isoformat()
        serialized = json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True)
        created = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        run_id = hashlib.sha256((commit + serialized + created).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        out = Path("reports/model")
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        results, pooled, calibration, intervals, selected = [], [], [], [], []
        names = ("climatology", "persistence_hard", "persistence_prob", "seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses")
        for fold_id in map(str, range(1, len(params.boundaries))):
            predictions = {name: [] for name in names}
            for k in args.leads:
                _, train_mask, eval_mask = next(fold for fold in walk_forward_folds(panel, params, k) if fold[0] == fold_id)
                train, evaluation = panel.loc[train_mask], panel.loc[eval_mask]
                models = {name: ReferenceModel(name, (k,), tuple(args.day_windows), tuple(args.week_windows), tuple(args.alphas)).fit(train) for name in names}
                clim = models["climatology"].predict_proba(evaluation, k)
                persistence = models["persistence_prob"].predict_proba(evaluation, k)
                ses = models["ses"].predict_proba(evaluation, k)
                rate = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                flagged = rate.index[(rate < args.flag_low) | (rate > args.flag_high)].tolist()
                fold_start, fold_end = params.boundaries[int(fold_id) - 1:int(fold_id) + 1]
                for name, model in models.items():
                    pred = evaluation[["oblast", "T"]].copy()
                    pred["y"] = evaluation[f"y_{k}"].astype(float)
                    pred["p"], pred["clim"], pred["persistence"] = model.predict_proba(evaluation, k), clim, persistence
                    pred["ses"] = ses
                    pred["lead"], pred["fold_id"], pred["run_id"] = k, fold_id, run_id
                    pred["flagged"] = pred.oblast.isin(flagged)
                    predictions[name].append(pred)
                    pooled.append(pred.assign(model=name))
                    fitted = {**config, "fitted": model.params.get(k, {}), "flagged_oblasts": flagged,

    """Simple references; every fitted rate/candidate uses the supplied TRAIN only."""
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    
    class ReferenceModel:
        def __init__(self, name: str, leads: tuple[int, ...], day_windows: tuple[int, ...],
                     week_windows: tuple[int, ...], alphas: tuple[float, ...]):
            self.name, self.leads = name, leads
            self.day_windows, self.week_windows, self.alphas = day_windows, week_windows, alphas
            self.params: dict[int, dict] = {}
            self.rates: dict[int, pd.Series] = {}
            self.global_rates: dict[int, float] = {}
            self.base_rates: dict[int, pd.Series] = {}
    
        def fit(self, train: pd.DataFrame) -> "ReferenceModel":
            if train.empty:
                raise ValueError("Cannot fit an empty TRAIN window")
            for k in self.leads:
                y = train[f"y_{k}"].astype(float)
                self.global_rates[k] = float(y.mean())
                self.base_rates[k] = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                if self.name == "persistence_prob":
                    self.rates[k] = train.groupby(["oblast", "state"])[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                else:
                    self.rates[k] = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{k}"].mean()
                if self.name in {"seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses"}:
                    prefix = {"seasonal_day": "day", "seasonal_week": "week", "ses": "ses"}[self.name]
                    candidates = {"day": self.day_windows, "week": self.week_windows, "ses": self.alphas}[prefix]
                    columns = [f"ses_{value:g}" if prefix == "ses" else f"{prefix}_{value}_k{k}" for value in candidates]
                    loss = [float(np.mean((train[column].to_numpy() - y.to_numpy()) ** 2)) for column in columns]
                    position = int(np.argmin(loss))
                    self.params[k] = {"column": columns[position], "chosen": candidates[position], "train_brier": loss[position]}
            return self
    
        def predict_proba(self, rows: pd.DataFrame, lead: int) -> np.ndarray:
            if self.name == "persistence_hard":
                return rows.state.to_numpy(dtype=float)
            if self.name in {"seasonal_day", "seasonal_week", "ses"}:
                return np.clip(rows[self.params[lead]["column"]].to_numpy(dtype=float), 0, 1)
            if self.name == "persistence_prob":
                keys = pd.MultiIndex.from_frame(rows[["oblast", "state"]])
                values = self.rates[lead].reindex(keys).to_numpy(dtype=float)
                fallback = rows.oblast.map(self.base_rates[lead]).fillna(self.global_rates[lead]).to_numpy(dtype=float)
                return np.where(np.isnan(values), fallback, values)
            return rows.oblast.map(self.rates[lead]).fillna(self.global_rates[lead]).to_numpy(dtype=float)

            right = index.searchsorted(rows.loc[good, "finished_at"], side="left")

                frame[name + "_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * values / period)

    """One-lead pooled fold matrices; no identity or calendar predictors."""
    
    from dataclasses import dataclass
    
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    
    from airalerts.features import GROUP_A, GROUP_B
    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams, walk_forward_folds
    
    
    @dataclass
    class FoldData:
        fold_id: str
        lead: int
        train: pd.DataFrame
        valid: pd.DataFrame
        features: tuple[str, ...]
        flagged: tuple[str, ...]
    
    
    def fold_data(panel: pd.DataFrame, observed: pd.DataFrame, params: FoldParams,
                  lead: int, columns: tuple[str, ...]):
        """Fit base_rate on TRAIN y_0; flags on TRAIN y_k, independently per fold."""
        if not set(columns) <= set(GROUP_A + GROUP_B):
            raise ValueError("Only specified Group A/B predictors are permitted")
        if panel["T"].ge(pd.Timestamp("2026-08-01", tz="UTC")).any():
            raise ValueError("Reserved TEST rows are forbidden")
        if observed.duplicated(["oblast", "T"]).any():
            raise ValueError("Observed features must have unique oblast,T keys")
        aligned = panel[["oblast", "T"]].merge(observed, on=["oblast", "T"], how="left", validate="one_to_one")
        if aligned[list(GROUP_A)].isna().any().any():
            raise ValueError("Missing observed feature values")
        for fold_id, train_mask, valid_mask in walk_forward_folds(panel, params, lead):
            train = panel.loc[train_mask].copy()
            valid = panel.loc[valid_mask].copy()
            rates = train.groupby("oblast").y_0.mean()
            target_rates = train.groupby("oblast")[f"y_{lead}"].mean()
            flagged = tuple(target_rates.index[(target_rates < .03) | (target_rates > .95)])
            for target, mask in ((train, train_mask), (valid, valid_mask)):
                for name in GROUP_A + GROUP_B:
                    target[name] = target.oblast.map(rates) if name == "base_rate" else aligned.loc[mask, name].to_numpy()
                target["y"] = target[f"y_{lead}"].astype(float)
                if target[list(columns)].isna().any().any():
                    raise ValueError("Missing fold predictors")
            yield FoldData(fold_id, lead, train, valid, columns, flagged)
    
    
    def recency_weights(train: pd.DataFrame, train_end: pd.Timestamp,
                        half_life: float) -> np.ndarray:
        """Age from exclusive end of TRAIN; inf means ordinary unweighted fit."""
        if half_life <= 0 or train["T"].ge(train_end).any():
            raise ValueError("Weights require positive half-life and strictly past TRAIN")
        age = (train_end - train["T"]).dt.total_seconds().to_numpy() / 86400
        return np.ones(len(train)) if np.isinf(half_life) else .5 ** (age / half_life)
    
    
    class PooledLogistic:
        """L2 logistic probability with TRAIN-only (optionally weighted) scaling."""
    
        def __init__(self, columns: tuple[str, ...], C: float, seed: int = 42):
            from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
            from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
            self.columns, self.C = columns, C
            self.scaler = StandardScaler()
            self.model = LogisticRegression(C=C, penalty="l2", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=seed)
    
        def fit(self, train: pd.DataFrame, weights: np.ndarray | None = None) -> "PooledLogistic":
            import warnings
            from sklearn.exceptions import ConvergenceWarning
            x = train[list(self.columns)].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            self.scaler.fit(x, sample_weight=weights)
            with warnings.catch_warnings():
                warnings.simplefilter("error", ConvergenceWarning)
                self.model.fit(self.scaler.transform(x), train.y.to_numpy(dtype=float), sample_weight=weights)
            return self
    
        def predict_proba(self, rows: pd.DataFrame, lead: int | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
            return self.model.predict_proba(self.scaler.transform(rows[list(self.columns)].to_numpy(dtype=float)))[:, 1]

    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import pytest
    
    from airalerts.features import GROUP_A, GROUP_B, observed_features, own_features
    from airalerts.panel import build_panel
    from airalerts.pooled import PooledLogistic, fold_data, recency_weights
    from airalerts.splits import FoldParams
    
    
    def sample():
        rows = pd.DataFrame([
            ("A", "raion", "2026-01-01 03:10", "2026-01-02 08:00"),
            ("A", "oblast", "2026-01-02 08:00", "2026-01-03 07:20"),
            ("A", "hromada", "2026-01-01", "2026-01-05"),
            ("B", "raion", "2026-01-02 01:00", "2026-01-02 03:00"),
            ("B", "raion", "2026-01-03 14:00", "2026-01-04 14:00"),
        ], columns=["oblast", "level", "started_at", "finished_at"])
        for col in ["started_at", "finished_at"]:
            rows[col] = pd.to_datetime(rows[col], utc=True, format="mixed")
        panel = build_panel(rows, "2026-01-01", "2026-01-05", leads=(0, 1, 24),
                            day_windows=(), week_windows=(), alphas=(.1,), oblasts=["A", "B"])
        return rows, panel
    
    
    def test_exact_feature_schema_and_vectorized_future_invariance():
        assert GROUP_A == ("active_now", "hours_since_end", "elapsed_in_alert", "share_1h", "share_6h", "share_24h", "share_168h", "starts_24h")
        assert GROUP_B == ("base_rate", "neighbor_share_now", "neighbor_share_6h", "national_active_count")
        events, panel = sample()
        adjacency = {"A": ("B",), "B": ("A",)}
        fast = observed_features(events, panel, adjacency)
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        for t in rng.choice(panel["T"].unique(), 10, replace=False):
            before = fast.loc[fast["T"].eq(t)].reset_index(drop=True)
            changed = events.loc[events.started_at.le(t)].copy()
            changed.loc[changed.finished_at.gt(t), "finished_at"] = pd.NaT
            perturbed = panel.copy()
            future = perturbed["T"].gt(t)
            perturbed.loc[future, "state"] = rng.integers(0, 2, future.sum()).astype(bool)
            perturbed.loc[future, "share_6h"] = rng.random(future.sum())
            after = observed_features(changed, perturbed, adjacency)
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(before, after.loc[after["T"].eq(t)].reset_index(drop=True))
            for oblast in ("A", "B"):
                expected = own_features(events, oblast, t)
                assert set(expected) == set(GROUP_A)
                for name in GROUP_A:
                    assert before.set_index("oblast").loc[oblast, name] == pytest.approx(expected[name])
    
    
    def test_fold_rates_and_embargo():
        events, panel = sample()
        observed = observed_features(events, panel, {"A": ("B",), "B": ("A",)})
        params = FoldParams("2026-01-01", ("2026-01-03", "2026-01-05"))
        for k in (0, 1, 24):
            fold = next(fold_data(panel, observed, params, k, GROUP_A + GROUP_B))
            assert fold.train["T"].max() < pd.Timestamp("2026-01-03", tz="UTC") - pd.Timedelta(hours=25)
            assert (fold.train["T"] + pd.Timedelta(hours=k+1)).max() <= fold.valid["T"].min()
            expected = fold.train.groupby("oblast").y_0.mean()
            assert np.allclose(fold.valid.base_rate, fold.valid.oblast.map(expected))
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Only specified"):
            next(fold_data(panel, observed, params, 0, ("oblast",)))
    
    
    def test_recency_weights():
        frame = pd.DataFrame({"T": pd.to_datetime(["2026-01-01", "2026-01-15"], utc=True)})
        end = pd.Timestamp("2026-01-29", tz="UTC")
        assert recency_weights(frame, end, 14).tolist() == [.25, .5]
        assert recency_weights(frame, end, np.inf).tolist() == [1, 1]
    
    
    def test_logistic_fits_scaler_on_train_only():
        pytest.importorskip("sklearn", reason="Offline Python 3.14 lacks sklearn; model test runs on Python 3.12")
        frame = pd.DataFrame({"active_now": [0., 0., 1., 1.], "hours_since_end": [8., 4., 0., 0.], "y": [0, 1, 0, 1]})
        columns = ("active_now", "hours_since_end")
        model = PooledLogistic(columns, .1).fit(frame)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(model.scaler.mean_, frame[list(columns)].mean())
        test = frame.copy()
        test["hours_since_end"] = 1000.
        original = model.scaler.mean_.copy()
        p = model.predict_proba(test, 1)
        assert np.all((p >= 0) & (p <= 1))
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(original, model.scaler.mean_)
