            'Dnipropetrovska oblast': ('UA-12', 'Дніпропетровська область'),
            'Donetska oblast': ('UA-14', 'Донецька область'),
            'Ivano-Frankivska oblast': ('UA-26', 'Івано-Франківська область'),
            'Kharkivska oblast': ('UA-63', 'Харківська область'),
            'Khersonska oblast': ('UA-65', 'Херсонська область'),
            'Khmelnytska oblast': ('UA-68', 'Хмельницька область'),
            'Kirovohradska oblast': ('UA-35', 'Кіровоградська область'),
            'Kyiv City': ('UA-30', 'Київ'),
            'Kyivska oblast': ('UA-32', 'Київська область'),
            'Lvivska oblast': ('UA-46', 'Львівська область'),
            'Mykolaivska oblast': ('UA-48', 'Миколаївська область'),
            'Odeska oblast': ('UA-51', 'Одеська область'),
            'Poltavska oblast': ('UA-53', 'Полтавська область'),
            'Rivnenska oblast': ('UA-56', 'Рівненська область'),
            'Sumska oblast': ('UA-59', 'Сумська область'),
            'Ternopilska oblast': ('UA-61', 'Тернопільська область'),
            'Vinnytska oblast': ('UA-05', 'Вінницька область'),
            'Volynska oblast': ('UA-07', 'Волинська область'),
            'Zakarpatska oblast': ('UA-21', 'Закарпатська область'),
            'Zaporizka oblast': ('UA-23', 'Запорізька область'),
            'Zhytomyrska oblast': ('UA-18', 'Житомирська область'),
        }
        UNMODELLED = {'UA-09':'Луганська область', 'UA-43':'Крим', 'UA-40':'Севастополь'}
        
        
        def pack_bits(values: np.ndarray) -> str:
            if not np.isin(values, [0,1]).all():
                raise ValueError('Binary data required')
            return base64.b64encode(np.packbits(values.astype(np.uint8),bitorder='little').tobytes()).decode('ascii')
        
        
        def unpack_bits(encoded: str, count: int) -> np.ndarray:
            raw=np.frombuffer(base64.b64decode(encoded),dtype=np.uint8)
            if len(raw)!=(count+7)//8:raise ValueError('Bit-packed length differs')
            return np.unpackbits(raw,bitorder='little')[:count]
        
        
        def encode_frames(frame: pd.DataFrame, names: list[str]) -> dict:
            if frame.duplicated(['lead','T','oblast']).any():raise ValueError('Duplicate display cells')
            if not np.isfinite(frame.p).all() or not frame.p.between(0,1).all():raise ValueError('Invalid probabilities')
            if not frame.y.isin([0,1]).all():raise ValueError('Invalid outcomes')
            ordered=[]; leads=[]; offset=0
            for lead,rows in frame.groupby('lead',sort=True):
                times=pd.DatetimeIndex(sorted(rows['T'].unique()))
                if any(times!=times.floor('h')) or any(times[1:]-times[:-1]!=pd.Timedelta(hours=1)):
                    raise ValueError('Display times must be consecutive whole UTC hours')
                index=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([times,names],names=['T','oblast'])
                rows=rows.set_index(['T','oblast'])
                if len(rows)!=len(index) or set(rows.index)!=set(index):raise ValueError('Missing display cells; no filling allowed')
                aligned=rows.reindex(index)
                ordered.append(aligned)
                leads.append({'lead':int(lead),'start':int(times[0].timestamp()*1000),'count':len(times),'offset':offset,
                              'last':int(times[-1].timestamp()*1000)})
                offset+=len(aligned)
            combined=pd.concat(ordered,ignore_index=True)
            values=np.rint(combined.p.to_numpy()*1000).astype('<u2')
            probabilities=base64.b64encode(values.tobytes()).decode('ascii')
            decoded=np.frombuffer(base64.b64decode(probabilities),dtype='<u2').astype(float)/1000
            if np.max(np.abs(decoded-combined.p.to_numpy()))>.0005+1e-12:
                raise ValueError('Probability round trip exceeds per-mille tolerance')
            outcomes=pack_bits(combined.y.to_numpy())
            if not np.array_equal(unpack_bits(outcomes,len(combined)),combined.y.to_numpy()):
                raise ValueError('Outcome round trip failed')
            # Preserve the requested error threshold exactly despite probability rounding.
            errors=pack_bits((np.abs(combined.p.to_numpy()-combined.y.to_numpy())>=.5).astype(np.uint8))
            state_column=next((c for c in ['state_at_T','active_now','state'] if c in combined),None)
            return {'regions':[{'name':name,'label':NAME_MAP[name][1]} for name in names], 'leads':leads,
                    'probabilities':probabilities,'outcomes':outcomes,'errors':errors,
                    'states':pack_bits(combined[state_column].to_numpy()) if state_column else None,
                    'cells':len(combined),'encoding':'little-endian uint16 per-mille; little-bit-order outcomes/errors'}
        
        
        def match_geometry(names: list[str], features: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:
            if len(names)!=len(set(names)) or set(names)-set(NAME_MAP):raise ValueError('Unknown/duplicate panel name')
            found={}
            for name in names:
                code=NAME_MAP[name][0]
                candidates=[f for f in features if f['properties'].get('iso_3166_2')==code]
                if len(candidates)!=1:raise ValueError(f'{name}: need exactly one polygon for {code}, found {len(candidates)}')
                if code in found:raise ValueError('A polygon is matched twice')
                found[code]=candidates[0]
            return found
        
        
        def rings(geometry: dict) -> list[list[list[float]]]:
            if geometry['type']=='Polygon':return geometry['coordinates']
            if geometry['type']=='MultiPolygon':return [ring for polygon in geometry['coordinates'] for ring in polygon]
            raise ValueError('Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry required')
        
        
        def rdp(points: list[tuple[float,float]], tolerance: float) -> list[tuple[float,float]]:
            """Iterative Ramer–Douglas–Peucker; retains endpoints deterministically."""
            keep={0,len(points)-1}; stack=[(0,len(points)-1)]
            while stack:
                first,last=stack.pop()
                ax,ay=points[first];bx,by=points[last];dx,dy=bx-ax,by-ay;length=dx*dx+dy*dy
                maximum=0.; chosen=None
                for i in range(first+1,last):
                    x,y=points[i];ratio=max(0.,min(1.,((x-ax)*dx+(y-ay)*dy)/length)) if length else 0.
                    distance=(x-ax-ratio*dx)**2+(y-ay-ratio*dy)**2
                    if distance>maximum:maximum=distance;chosen=i
                if chosen is not None and maximum>tolerance*tolerance:
                    keep.add(chosen);stack.extend([(first,chosen),(chosen,last)])
            return [points[i] for i in sorted(keep)]
        
        
        def simplify_ring(points: list[tuple[float,float]], tolerance: float) -> list[tuple[float,float]]:
            if points[0]==points[-1]:points=points[:-1]
            if len(points)<3:raise ValueError('Degenerate source ring')
            pivot=max(range(1,len(points)),key=lambda i:(points[i][0]-points[0][0])**2+(points[i][1]-points[0][1])**2)
            result=rdp(points[:pivot+1],tolerance)[:-1]+rdp(points[pivot:]+[points[0]],tolerance)
            return result if len(set(result))>=3 else points+[points[0]]
        
        
        def svg_geometry(names: list[str], features: list[dict], tolerance: float=.8) -> tuple[str,str,int]:
            matched=match_geometry(names,features)
            for code in UNMODELLED:
                candidates=[f for f in features if f['properties'].get('iso_3166_2')==code]
                if len(candidates)!=1:raise ValueError(f'Missing/duplicate unmodelled polygon {code}')
                matched[code]=candidates[0]
            cosine=math.cos(math.radians(49))
            coordinates=[(point[0]*cosine,-point[1]) for f in matched.values() for ring in rings(f['geometry']) for point in ring]
            minx,maxx=min(p[0] for p in coordinates),max(p[0] for p in coordinates)
            miny,maxy=min(p[1] for p in coordinates),max(p[1] for p in coordinates)
            scale=940/(maxx-minx);height=(maxy-miny)*scale+60
            def project(point):return ((point[0]*cosine-minx)*scale+30,(-point[1]-miny)*scale+30)
            paths=[];path_bytes=0;centers={}
            for code,f in matched.items():
                paths_data=[];points_all=[]
                for ring in rings(f['geometry']):
                    points=[project(point) for point in ring];points_all.extend(points)
                    simple=simplify_ring(points,tolerance)
                    paths_data.append('M'+'L'.join(f'{x:.1f},{y:.1f}' for x,y in simple[:-1])+'Z')
                d=''.join(paths_data);path_bytes+=len(d.encode())
                centers[code]=((min(x for x,y in points_all)+max(x for x,y in points_all))/2,(min(y for x,y in points_all)+max(y for x,y in points_all))/2)
                if code in UNMODELLED:
                    label=UNMODELLED[code]
                    paths.append(f'<path class="neutral" d="{d}" fill="url(#unmodelled)" fill-rule="evenodd" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="{escape(label)}: не моделюється" data-neutral="{escape(label)}"/>')
                else:
                    name=next(n for n in names if NAME_MAP[n][0]==code);index=names.index(name)
                    paths.append(f'<path id="region-{index}" class="region" data-region="{index}" d="{d}" fill-rule="evenodd" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="{escape(NAME_MAP[name][1])}"/>')
            for code in ['UA-09','UA-43']:
                x,y=centers[code]
                paths.append(f'<text class="neutral-label" x="{x:.1f}" y="{y:.1f}" text-anchor="middle">{UNMODELLED[code]}<tspan x="{x:.1f}" dy="21">не моделюється</tspan></text>')
            x,y=centers['UA-30'];index=names.index('Kyiv City');cx,cy=x+20,y-30
            paths.extend([f'<line class="city-leader" x1="{x:.1f}" y1="{y:.1f}" x2="{cx:.1f}" y2="{cy:.1f}"/>',
                f'<circle id="kyiv-marker" class="region city-marker" data-region="{index}" cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{cy:.1f}" r="14" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Київ"/>',
                f'<text class="city-label" x="{cx+20:.1f}" y="{cy+6:.1f}">Київ</text>'])
            if path_bytes>150000:raise ValueError(f'SVG path data {path_bytes} exceeds 150 KB')
            return '\n'.join(paths),f'0 0 1000 {height:.1f}',path_bytes
        
        
        def assemble_html(template: str, payload: dict, svg: str, viewbox: str) -> str:
            data=json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).replace('<','\\u003c')
            html=template.replace('@@SVG@@',svg).replace('@@VIEWBOX@@',viewbox).replace('@@DATA@@',data)
            if re.search(r'@@[A-Z]+@@',html):raise ValueError('Unfilled template marker')
            if len(html.encode('utf-8'))>2000000:raise ValueError(f'HTML {len(html.encode())} exceeds 2 MB; do not shrink silently')
            return html
        
        
        def load_payload(predictions: Path,metrics_path: Path,bootstrap_path: Path,config_path: Path,state_path: Path) -> tuple[dict,list[str]]:
            frame=pd.read_csv(predictions,parse_dates=['T'],low_memory=False)
            required={'oblast','T','p','y','lead','model','run_id','git_commit'}
            if not required<=set(frame) or len(frame)!=181152:raise ValueError('STOP: prediction schema/row count differs')
            if set(frame.lead)!={0,1,2,3,4,5,6,12,24} or set(frame.oblast)!=set(NAME_MAP):raise ValueError('Unexpected TEST leads/oblasts')
            config=json.loads(config_path.read_text());state=json.loads(state_path.read_text())
            start,end=_window(state['test_start'],state['test_end'])
            if start!=pd.Timestamp(config['test_start'],tz='UTC') or not frame.git_commit.eq(state['commit']).all():raise ValueError('TEST/commit provenance differs')
            if not frame.run_id.eq(state['run_id']).all() or state['status']!='complete':raise ValueError('FINAL run mismatch/incomplete')
            if frame['T'].lt(start).any() or (frame['T']+pd.to_timedelta(frame.lead+1,unit='h')).gt(end).any():raise ValueError('Only TEST target windows may be displayed')
            names=sorted(frame.oblast.unique());payload=encode_frames(frame,names)
            metrics=pd.read_csv(metrics_path);intervals=pd.read_csv(bootstrap_path)
            for item in payload['leads']:
                k=item['lead'];model=config['models'][str(k)]['model']
                if not frame.loc[frame.lead.eq(k),'model'].eq(model).all():raise ValueError('Saved/frozen model differs')
                row=metrics.loc[metrics.lead.eq(k)&metrics.scope.eq('ALL')&metrics.fold_id.eq('test')]
                if len(row)!=1 or row.iloc[0].run_id!=state['run_id']:raise ValueError('TEST summary mismatch')
                row=row.iloc[0]
                ci={}
                for reference in ['clim','ses']:
                    values=intervals.loc[intervals.lead.eq(k)&intervals.scope.eq('ALL')&intervals.reference.eq(reference)]
                    if len(values)!=1:raise ValueError('Missing/duplicate pooled CI')
                    ci[reference]=[float(values.iloc[0].low),float(values.iloc[0].high)]
                item.update(model=model,brier=float(row.brier),bss_clim=float(row.bss_vs_clim),bss_ses=float(row.bss_vs_ses),ci=ci)
            payload.update(test_start=int(start.timestamp()*1000),test_end=int(end.timestamp()*1000),commit=state['commit'])
            return payload,names

        """Build a self-contained retrospective TEST viewer; never fits or predicts."""
        
        import argparse
        import hashlib
        import json
        from pathlib import Path
        from urllib.request import urlopen
        
        from airalerts.appdata import GEOMETRY_URL,GEOMETRY_LICENCE,NAME_MAP,load_payload,svg_geometry,assemble_html
        
        
        def main() -> None:
            parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
            parser.add_argument('--predictions',type=Path,default=Path('data/processed/predictions/final_test.csv.gz'))
            parser.add_argument('--metrics',type=Path,default=Path('reports/model/final_test_metrics.csv'))
            parser.add_argument('--bootstrap',type=Path,default=Path('reports/model/final_test_bootstrap.csv'))
            parser.add_argument('--config',type=Path,default=Path('config/final_config.json'))
            parser.add_argument('--state',type=Path,default=Path('data/processed/predictions/final_checkpoint/state.json'))
            parser.add_argument('--geometry',type=Path,default=Path('data/geo/ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces.geojson'))
            parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=Path('docs/index.html'))
            args=parser.parse_args()
            payload,names=load_payload(args.predictions,args.metrics,args.bootstrap,args.config,args.state)
            if not args.geometry.exists():
                args.geometry.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                try:
                    with urlopen(GEOMETRY_URL,timeout=45) as response:content=response.read()
                except Exception as exc:
                    raise SystemExit(f'STOP: boundary download unavailable ({type(exc).__name__}). Place Natural Earth ADM1 GeoJSON at {args.geometry}, source {GEOMETRY_URL}') from None
                args.geometry.write_bytes(content)
            raw=args.geometry.read_bytes();geometry=json.loads(raw)
            svg,viewbox,path_bytes=svg_geometry(names,geometry['features'])
            payload['geometry']={'source':GEOMETRY_URL,'licence':GEOMETRY_LICENCE,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                                 'projection':'Equirectangular, standard parallel 49° N','simplification':'RDP, 0.8 SVG units; coordinates rounded to 0.1'}
            html=assemble_html(Path('app/template.html').read_text(),payload,svg,viewbox)
            args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);args.output.write_bytes(html.encode('utf-8'))
            print(f'HTML={len(html.encode()):,} bytes; data JSON={len(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":")).encode()):,} bytes; SVG paths={path_bytes:,} bytes; raw geometry={len(raw):,} bytes')
            print('Geometry SHA256:',payload['geometry']['sha256'])
            for name in names:print(name,'|',NAME_MAP[name][0],'|',NAME_MAP[name][1])
            for lead in payload['leads']:print('lead',lead['lead'],'start_ms',lead['start'],'last_ms',lead['last'],'frames',lead['count'])
        
        
        if __name__=='__main__':main()
        PY

        @media(max-width:760px){main{padding:20px 14px}.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.controls{padding:14px}.top-controls{gap:10px}.lead-control{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.toggle{width:100%}.toggle button{flex:1;font-size:12px}.time-row{align-items:start;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.time-main{font-size:18px}.target{text-align:left;font-size:13px}.map-card{padding:14px}.scale{gap:4px}.scale span{font-size:9px}.timeline{gap:6px}.timeline button{padding:7px 9px;min-height:40px}.region-list{max-height:300px}.provenance{margin-bottom:16px}.map-heading{align-items:start}.truth-legend{font-size:10px}.scores{padding:12px 14px}.keyboard-note{font-size:10px}}
        </style>
        </head>
        <body><main>
        <header><div class="eyebrow">Збережені прогнози · тестовий період</div><h1>Година наперед</h1>
        <p class="note" id="retrospective"></p><p class="provenance" id="commit"></p></header>
        <section class="controls card" aria-label="Час і режим перегляду">
        <div class="top-controls"><div class="toggle" role="group" aria-label="Режим перегляду"><button id="forecast" aria-pressed="true">Прогноз</button><button id="actual" aria-pressed="false">Що було насправді</button></div>
        <div class="lead-control"><label for="lead">Горизонт</label><select id="lead"><optgroup label="Прогноз"><option value="1" selected>+1 год</option><option value="2">+2 год</option><option value="3">+3 год</option><option value="4">+4 год</option><option value="5">+5 год</option><option value="6">+6 год</option></optgroup><optgroup label="Довші горизонти"><option value="12">+12 год</option><option value="24">+24 год</option></optgroup><optgroup label="Окремо · поточна година"><option value="0">0 (поточна година, не прогноз)</option></optgroup></select></div></div>
        <div class="time-row"><div><span class="label">Час прогнозу T · Київ</span><div class="time-main" id="time"></div><span class="utc" id="utc"></span></div><div class="target" id="target"></div></div>
        <p class="nowcast" id="nowcast" hidden>Поточна година (lead 0): це nowcast, а не прогноз наперед. Його оцінки показано окремо.</p>
        <div class="timeline"><button id="previous" aria-label="Попередня година">←</button><input id="slider" type="range" min="0" step="1" value="0" aria-label="Час прогнозу"><button id="next" aria-label="Наступна година">→</button><button id="play" aria-pressed="false">Відтворити</button></div>
        <p class="keyboard-note">Стрілки — 1 година · PageUp / PageDown — 24 години. Межі часу залежать від горизонту.</p>
        </section>
        <div class="layout"><section class="map-card card" aria-label="Карта прогнозів"><div class="map-heading"><h2>Україна</h2><span class="mode-label" id="map-mode">Ймовірність тривоги</span></div>
        <div class="legend"><div class="legend-title">Фіксована шкала ймовірності прогнозу, %</div><div class="scale" id="scale"></div>
        <div class="truth-legend"><span><i class="swatch" style="background:#cf3c47"></i>Була тривога (у режимі фактів)</span><span><i class="swatch" style="background:var(--quiet)"></i>Не було тривоги</span><span><i class="swatch error-swatch"></i>модель помилилась суттєво (|p − факт| ≥ 0,5)</span></div></div>
        <svg id="map" viewBox="@@VIEWBOX@@" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-label="Області України та місто Київ"><defs><pattern id="unmodelled" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(35)"><rect width="8" height="8" fill="var(--hatch-bg)"/><path d="M0 0V8" stroke="var(--hatch-line)" stroke-width="2"/></pattern></defs>@@SVG@@</svg>
        <p class="unmodelled-note">Штрихування: Луганська область, Крим і Севастополь — не моделюється. Маркер Києва розміщено поруч із його полігоном.</p>
        <div class="detail" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"><strong id="detail-name">Оберіть область</strong><p id="detail-value">Наведіть курсор, торкніться карти або оберіть регіон у списку.</p></div>
        </section><aside class="regions-card card"><div class="regions-head"><h2>Області та Київ</h2><p id="list-heading">Сортування за ймовірністю</p></div><ol class="region-list" id="region-list" aria-label="Усі модельовані регіони"></ol></aside></div>
        <footer><div class="scores card" id="scores"></div><div class="footer"><p>Ймовірності збереженої моделі округлено до 0,1 відсоткового пункту. Факт означає: тривога торкнулася цільової години; це не обов’язково початок нової тривоги.</p><p id="attribution"></p></div></footer>
        <noscript>Для перегляду вбудованих збережених даних увімкніть JavaScript. З’єднання з мережею не потрібне.</noscript>
        </main><script id="display-data" type="application/json">@@DATA@@</script>
        <script>
        'use strict';
        const D=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('display-data').textContent);
        const COLORS=['#eff3ff','#c6dbef','#9ecae1','#6baed6','#4292c6','#2171b5','#084594'];
        const LIMITS=[50,100,200,400,600,800,1001],LABELS=['0–5','5–10','10–20','20–40','40–60','60–80','80–100'];
        function decode64(text){const raw=atob(text);return Uint8Array.from(raw,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));}
        const rawP=decode64(D.probabilities),P=new Uint16Array(D.cells);
        for(let i=0;i<P.length;i++)P[i]=rawP[i*2]|(rawP[i*2+1]<<8);
        const Y=decode64(D.outcomes),E=decode64(D.errors),S=D.states?decode64(D.states):null;
        function bit(bytes,i){return (bytes[i>>3]>>(i&7))&1;}
        function binColor(value){return COLORS[LIMITS.findIndex(limit=>value<limit)];}
        const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),hour=3600000,n=D.regions.length;
        const leads=new Map(D.leads.map(item=>[item.lead,item]));
        const dateTime=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('uk-UA',{timeZone:'Europe/Kyiv',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'});
        const dayFormat=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('uk-UA',{timeZone:'Europe/Kyiv',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'});
        const timeFormat=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('uk-UA',{timeZone:'Europe/Kyiv',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'});
        const number=new Intl.NumberFormat('uk-UA',{minimumFractionDigits:5,maximumFractionDigits:5});
        const percent=new Intl.NumberFormat('uk-UA',{minimumFractionDigits:1,maximumFractionDigits:1});
        const collator=new Intl.Collator('uk');
        let lead=1,position=0,isActual=false,selected=null,timer=null;
        const elements=D.regions.map((_,i)=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(`[data-region="${i}"]`)));
        const rows=D.regions.map((region,i)=>{const li=document.createElement('li'),button=document.createElement('button'),dot=document.createElement('span'),name=document.createElement('span'),value=document.createElement('span');button.className='region-row';button.dataset.region=i;button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');dot.className='row-dot';dot.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');name.className='row-name';name.textContent=region.label;value.className='row-value';button.append(dot,name,value);li.append(button);button.addEventListener('click',()=>choose(i));button.addEventListener('focus',()=>choose(i));return {li,button,dot,value};});
        for(let i=0;i<COLORS.length;i++){const span=document.createElement('span'),chip=document.createElement('i');chip.style.backgroundColor=COLORS[i];span.append(chip,document.createTextNode(LABELS[i]));$('scale').append(span);}
        $('retrospective').textContent=`Ретроспективний перегляд збережених прогнозів замороженої моделі на тестовому періоді [${new Date(D.test_start).toISOString().slice(0,16).replace('T',' ')}, ${new Date(D.test_end).toISOString().slice(0,16).replace('T',' ')}) UTC. Не є системою попередження; керуйтеся офіційними сповіщеннями.`;
        $('commit').textContent=`Заморожений конфіг · commit ${D.commit}`;
        $('attribution').textContent=`Межі: ${D.geometry.licence}. Джерело: ${D.geometry.source} · SHA-256 ${D.geometry.sha256}. Проєкція: рівнопроміжна, стандартна паралель 49° пн. ш.; межі спрощено лише для відображення.`;
        function offset(i){return leads.get(lead).offset+position*n+i;}
        function describe(i){const index=offset(i);let text=`Прогноз: ${percent.format(P[index]/10)} %`;if(isActual)text+=bit(Y,index)?'. Факт: тривога торкнулася цільової години.':'. Факт: тривоги в цільовій годині не було.';if(S)text+=bit(S,index)?' На час T тривога триває.':' На час T тривога не триває.';if(isActual&&bit(E,index))text+=' Модель помилилась суттєво.';return text;}
        function choose(i){selected=i;for(let j=0;j<n;j++){rows[j].button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===j));elements[j].forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('selected',i===j));}$('detail-name').textContent=D.regions[i].label;$('detail-value').textContent=describe(i);}
        function pause(){if(timer!==null){clearInterval(timer);timer=null;}$('play').textContent='Відтворити';$('play').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');}
        function render(){const item=leads.get(lead),t=item.start+position*hour,target=t+lead*hour;
        $('slider').max=String(item.count-1);$('slider').value=String(position);$('time').textContent=dateTime.format(t);$('utc').textContent=new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0,16).replace('T',' ')+' UTC';
        $('target').textContent=`Ціль: ${dayFormat.format(target)}, ${timeFormat.format(target)}–${timeFormat.format(target+hour)} (Київ)`;
        $('nowcast').hidden=lead!==0;$('map-mode').textContent=isActual?'Факт у цільовій годині':'Ймовірність тривоги';$('forecast').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!isActual));$('actual').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(isActual));$('previous').disabled=position===0;$('next').disabled=position===item.count-1;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const index=offset(i),actual=bit(Y,index),wrong=isActual&&bit(E,index),color=isActual?(actual?'#cf3c47':'var(--quiet)'):binColor(P[index]);
        for(const el of elements[i]){el.setAttribute('fill',color);el.classList.toggle('wrong',Boolean(wrong));el.setAttribute('aria-label',`${D.regions[i].label}. ${describe(i)}`);}
        rows[i].dot.style.backgroundColor=color;rows[i].button.classList.toggle('wrong',Boolean(wrong));rows[i].value.textContent=isActual?(actual?'Тривога':'Не було'):percent.format(P[index]/10)+' %';rows[i].button.setAttribute('aria-label',`${D.regions[i].label}. ${describe(i)}`);}
        const ordered=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>i).sort((a,b)=>{if(isActual){const diff=bit(Y,offset(b))-bit(Y,offset(a));if(diff)return diff;}return P[offset(b)]-P[offset(a)]||collator.compare(D.regions[a].label,D.regions[b].label);});
        $('region-list').append(...ordered.map(i=>rows[i].li));$('list-heading').textContent=isActual?'Факт: спочатку регіони з тривогою':'Сортування за ймовірністю';
        const scores=$('scores');scores.replaceChildren();const name=document.createElement('strong');name.className='model';name.textContent=(lead===0?'Поточна година · ':'')+item.model;scores.append(name,document.createElement('br'),document.createTextNode(`TEST · Brier ${number.format(item.brier)} · BSS vs climatology ${number.format(item.bss_clim)} [${number.format(item.ci.clim[0])}; ${number.format(item.ci.clim[1])}] · BSS vs SES ${number.format(item.bss_ses)} [${number.format(item.ci.ses[0])}; ${number.format(item.ci.ses[1])}] · 95 % CI, блоки 7 днів.`));
        if(item.ci.ses[0]<=0&&item.ci.ses[1]>=0){const note=document.createElement('span');note.className='uncertain';note.textContent='немає доказів переваги над SES';scores.append(note);}
        if(selected!==null)choose(selected);
        }
        function step(delta){const item=leads.get(lead);position=Math.max(0,Math.min(item.count-1,position+delta));render();}
        $('slider').addEventListener('input',event=>{position=Number(event.target.value);render();});
        $('previous').addEventListener('click',()=>step(-1));$('next').addEventListener('click',()=>step(1));
        $('lead').addEventListener('change',event=>{const t=leads.get(lead).start+position*hour;lead=Number(event.target.value);const item=leads.get(lead);position=Math.max(0,Math.min(item.count-1,Math.round((t-item.start)/hour)));pause();render();});
        $('forecast').addEventListener('click',()=>{isActual=false;render();});$('actual').addEventListener('click',()=>{isActual=true;render();});
        $('play').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(timer!==null){pause();return;}if(position===leads.get(lead).count-1)position=0;$('play').textContent='Пауза';$('play').setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');timer=setInterval(()=>{if(position>=leads.get(lead).count-1){pause();return;}step(1);},400);render();});
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++)for(const el of elements[i]){el.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>choose(i));el.addEventListener('click',()=>choose(i));el.addEventListener('focus',()=>choose(i));el.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();choose(i);}});}
        for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('[data-neutral]')){const show=()=>{selected=null;$('detail-name').textContent=el.dataset.neutral;$('detail-value').textContent='Не моделюється. Збереженого прогнозу або факту тут немає.';};el.addEventListener('pointerenter',show);el.addEventListener('click',show);el.addEventListener('focus',show);}
        window.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.target.tagName==='SELECT')return;const keys={ArrowLeft:-1,ArrowDown:-1,ArrowRight:1,ArrowUp:1,PageDown:-24,PageUp:24};if(event.key in keys){event.preventDefault();step(keys[event.key]);}});
        globalThis.viewer={binColor,render,probabilities:P,outcomes:Y,metadata:D};
        render();
        </script></body></html>

## User

i am downloading geojson myself, do not do it. there are ADM0, ADM1, ADM2, ADM3, which file do u need?

## Assistant

Use **ADM1**: oblast-level boundaries, including **Kyiv City** as a separate polygon.

Download **Ukraine ADM1 GeoJSON**, preferably geoBoundaries, and save it as:

`data/geo/UKR_ADM1.geojson`

Keep the source URL and licence information. ADM0 is the country outline; ADM2/ADM3 are smaller subdivisions.

I’ll stop downloading. The earlier Natural Earth download already completed; I won’t fetch anything else.

## User

will it include raion? or we do not need it to?

## Assistant

ADM1 contains **oblast boundaries**, not raions. That’s what this viewer needs.

Our forecasts are per oblast: variant B combines oblast- and raion-level alert intervals into one oblast state. We aren’t displaying separate raion forecasts, so **ADM2 raion polygons are unnecessary**.

Check that the ADM1 file includes **Kyiv City separately**, plus Luhanska, Crimea and Sevastopol for the neutral, unmodelled areas.

## User

i added it to the root. let me know whether the file is ok

## Assistant

I’ll inspect the root GeoJSON for valid polygons, oblast coverage and a separate Kyiv City feature, then check it against the 24 forecast-region names. I won’t move or modify it.

        import base64
        import copy
        import json
        from pathlib import Path
        import re
        import shutil
        import subprocess
        
        import numpy as np
        import pandas as pd
        import pytest
        
        from airalerts.appdata import NAME_MAP,UNMODELLED,pack_bits,unpack_bits,encode_frames,match_geometry,svg_geometry,assemble_html
        
        
        def synthetic_frame(names=None):
            names=names or sorted(NAME_MAP)
            rows=[]
            for lead,count in [(1,3),(24,1)]:
                for t in pd.date_range('2026-08-01',periods=count,freq='h',tz='UTC'):
                    for i,name in enumerate(names):
                        p=[0.,.0005,.0497,.4996,.5,.9995,1.][i%7]
                        rows.append({'oblast':name,'T':t,'lead':lead,'p':p,'y':i%2})
            return pd.DataFrame(rows)
        
        
        def synthetic_geometry():
            features=[]
            for i,code in enumerate([v[0] for v in NAME_MAP.values()]+list(UNMODELLED)):
                x=22+i*.4;y=45+(i%4)*.5
                features.append({'properties':{'shapeISO':code},'geometry':{'type':'Polygon','coordinates':[[[x,y],[x+.3,y],[x+.3,y+.3],[x,y+.3],[x,y]]]}})
            return features
        
        
        def fixture_html():
            names=sorted(NAME_MAP);frame=synthetic_frame(names);data=encode_frames(frame,names)
            for lead in data['leads']:
                lead.update(model='synthetic',brier=.1,bss_clim=.01,bss_ses=.02,ci={'clim':[-.01,.03],'ses':[-.01,.04]})
            data.update(test_start=data['leads'][0]['start'],test_end=data['leads'][1]['last']+25*3600000,commit='synthetic',
                        geometry={'licence':'synthetic offline fixture','source':'https://example.invalid/attribution-text-only','sha256':'synthetic'})
            svg,viewbox,_=svg_geometry(names,synthetic_geometry())
            return assemble_html(Path('app/template.html').read_text(),data,svg,viewbox),data
        
        
        def test_round_trip_fewer_lead_rows_and_exact_error_threshold():
            frame=synthetic_frame();data=encode_frames(frame,sorted(NAME_MAP))
            ordered=frame.sort_values(['lead','T','oblast'])
            decoded=np.frombuffer(base64.b64decode(data['probabilities']),dtype='<u2')/1000
            np.testing.assert_allclose(decoded,ordered.p,atol=.0005+1e-12,rtol=0)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(unpack_bits(data['outcomes'],len(frame)),ordered.y)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(unpack_bits(data['errors'],len(frame)),np.abs(ordered.p-ordered.y)>=.5)
            assert data['leads'][0]['count']==3 and data['leads'][1]['count']==1
            assert data['leads'][1]['last']==int(frame.loc[frame.lead.eq(24),'T'].max().timestamp()*1000)
            assert data['leads'][1]['start']+(data['leads'][1]['count']-1)*3600000==data['leads'][1]['last']
            assert data['states'] is None
            with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='Missing display cells'):encode_frames(frame.iloc[1:],sorted(NAME_MAP))
        
        
        @pytest.mark.parametrize('count',[0,1,7,8,9,17])
        def test_bit_packing_edges(count):
            bits=np.arange(count)%2
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(unpack_bits(pack_bits(bits),count),bits)
        
        
        def test_name_mapping_and_failures():
            expected={'Cherkaska','Chernihivska','Chernivetska','Dnipropetrovska','Donetska','Ivano-Frankivska','Kharkivska','Khersonska','Khmelnytska','Kirovohradska','Kyivska','Lvivska','Mykolaivska','Odeska','Poltavska','Rivnenska','Sumska','Ternopilska','Vinnytska','Volynska','Zakarpatska','Zaporizka','Zhytomyrska'}

    # Project: per-oblast air-raid alert forecasting (Ukraine)
    
    Goal: for each oblast, forecast P(alert touches hour h) at forecast time T, evaluated on the latest period. No data leakage.
    
    ## Forecast setup
    - PRIMARY: each lead 1..6 h ahead as a separate target. Lead 0 is reported separately, never pooled.
    - SECONDARY (contrast): leads 12 and 24 h.
    - EXTRA metric, only if time allows: event window "any alert in [T, T+W)".
    - Do not choose a horizon by test score. Do NOT implement train/val/test splits yet; only prepare data.
    
    ## Data decisions (changes go to docs/DECISIONS.md)
    - `official` (Telegram air_alert_ua, structured, levels oblast/raion/hromada) is PRIMARY. `volunteer` (eTryvoga, keyword-parsed, oblast level) is a robustness check. Never average or merge them.
    - official_data_en.csv has an exact duplicated block: `drop_duplicates()` right after reading (expected 299,275 -> 185,430 rows).
    - All timestamps are UTC (= Telegram publication time, not siren time). Convert to Europe/Kyiv only for daily reporting.
    - Target: alert(oblast, hour) = 1 iff ANY interval of ANY level in the oblast touches [h, h+1h).
    - Exclude Luhanska oblast and Crimea.
    - Intervals are written only when closed, so each file is right-censored: trim the last 48 h of every source.
    - volunteer `naive` = imputed end (+30 min). official: duration == 3600 s is a heuristic imputation flag (~0.1% of rows).
    - Hourly "touch" inflates up to ~3.3x observed; ~1x for saturated oblasts. Compare SOURCES by exact minutes; use the hourly grid only for modelling.
    - Do not model alert counts or durations (parser artifacts).
    
    ## Leakage rules
    - A feature for forecast time T may use only events with started_at <= T. finished_at counts as known only if <= T; otherwise the alert is "ongoing".

    def test_deterministic_html_and_no_external_resources():
        html,_=fixture_html();again,_=fixture_html()
        assert html==again
        assert 'fetch(' not in html and 'XMLHttpRequest' not in html and 'localStorage' not in html
        assert not re.search(r'(?:src|href)\s*=\s*["\']https?://|url\(\s*["\']?https?://|import\s+.*https?://',html,re.I)
        assert len(html.encode())<2000000
        assert len(re.findall(r'<path[^>]+data-region=',html))==24
        assert 'id="kyiv-marker"' in html
    
    
    def test_node_decode_render_synthetic(tmp_path):
        node=shutil.which('node')
        if not node:pytest.skip('Node unavailable; JS smoke not run')
        html,data=fixture_html()
        script=re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',html,re.S)[0]
        # Minimal offline DOM for the exact page script, not a reimplementation.
        harness=r'''
    const fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm');
    const payload=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],'utf8'));
    class Element {constructor(){this.attrs={};this.children=[];this.style={};this.dataset={};this.value='1';this.textContent='';this.classList={toggle(){}};}setAttribute(k,v){this.attrs[k]=v;}append(...a){this.children.push(...a);}replaceChildren(...a){this.children=a;}addEventListener(k,f){this[k]=f;}}
    const ids=new Map(),paths=Array.from({length:24},()=>new Element());
    global.document={getElementById(id){if(!ids.has(id))ids.set(id,new Element());return ids.get(id);},createElement(){return new Element();},createTextNode(text){return text;},querySelectorAll(q){const m=q.match(/data-region="(\d+)"/);return m?[paths[+m[1]]]:[];}};
    global.window={addEventListener(){}};
    document.getElementById('display-data').textContent=JSON.stringify(payload);
    vm.runInThisContext(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3],'utf8'));
    if(paths[0].attrs.fill!=='#eff3ff')throw Error('Synthetic frame has unexpected region fill');
    if(document.getElementById('slider').max!=='2')throw Error('Incorrect lead-1 slider range');
    document.getElementById('lead').change({target:{value:'24'}});
    if(document.getElementById('slider').max!=='0')throw Error('Withheld lead-24 tail extrapolated');
    console.log('JS decode + render passed; known fill and lead-dependent slider bounds verified');
    '''
        paths=[tmp_path/'data.json',tmp_path/'page.js',tmp_path/'smoke.cjs']
        paths[0].write_text(json.dumps(data));paths[1].write_text(script);paths[2].write_text(harness)
        result=subprocess.run([node,str(paths[2]),str(paths[0]),str(paths[1])],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
        assert 'passed' in result.stdout

    # Project: per-oblast air-raid alert forecasting (Ukraine)
    
    Goal: for each oblast, forecast P(alert touches hour h) at forecast time T, evaluated on the latest period. No data leakage.
    
    ## Forecast setup
    - PRIMARY: each lead 1..6 h ahead as a separate target. Lead 0 is reported separately, never pooled.
    - SECONDARY (contrast): leads 12 and 24 h.
    - EXTRA metric, only if time allows: event window "any alert in [T, T+W)".
    - Do not choose a horizon by test score. Do NOT implement train/val/test splits yet; only prepare data.
    
    ## Data decisions (changes go to docs/DECISIONS.md)
    - `official` (Telegram air_alert_ua, structured, levels oblast/raion/hromada) is PRIMARY. `volunteer` (eTryvoga, keyword-parsed, oblast level) is a robustness check. Never average or merge them.
    - official_data_en.csv has an exact duplicated block: `drop_duplicates()` right after reading (expected 299,275 -> 185,430 rows).
    - All timestamps are UTC (= Telegram publication time, not siren time). Convert to Europe/Kyiv only for daily reporting.
    - Target: alert(oblast, hour) = 1 iff ANY interval of ANY level in the oblast touches [h, h+1h).
    - Exclude Luhanska oblast and Crimea.
    - Intervals are written only when closed, so each file is right-censored: trim the last 48 h of every source.
    - volunteer `naive` = imputed end (+30 min). official: duration == 3600 s is a heuristic imputation flag (~0.1% of rows).
    - Hourly "touch" inflates up to ~3.3x observed; ~1x for saturated oblasts. Compare SOURCES by exact minutes; use the hourly grid only for modelling.
    - Do not model alert counts or durations (parser artifacts).
    
    ## Leakage rules
    - A feature for forecast time T may use only events with started_at <= T. finished_at counts as known only if <= T; otherwise the alert is "ongoing".
    - Time-based splits only. Fit anything (scalers, encoders) on the training window only.
    
    ## Code rules
    - Task 1 needs no network or secrets. Later collect tasks may use the network, but never read, print or write tokens; credentials come from env vars only.
    - Never modify data/raw. Inspect files before assuming column names.
    - Type hints, small pure functions, pytest tests, no absolute paths.
    - Keep the repo minimal: create a file only when the current task needs it.
    - Final report after each task: files changed, commands run, test output, what you assumed or could not verify. Do not claim results you did not run.

    # Air-raid alert analysis
    
    ## Setup
    
    Use Python 3.14 on macOS:
    
    ```sh
    python3.14 -m venv .venv
    source .venv/bin/activate
    python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    ```
    
    Obtain the raw CSVs from the MIT-licensed
    [Vadimkin/ukrainian-air-raid-sirens-dataset](https://github.com/Vadimkin/ukrainian-air-raid-sirens-dataset).
    Clone it outside this repository and copy the two files into `data/raw/`:
    
    ```sh
    git clone https://github.com/Vadimkin/ukrainian-air-raid-sirens-dataset.git ../ukrainian-air-raid-sirens-dataset
    mkdir -p data/raw
    cp ../ukrainian-air-raid-sirens-dataset/datasets/official_data_en.csv data/raw/
    cp ../ukrainian-air-raid-sirens-dataset/datasets/volunteer_data_en.csv data/raw/
    ```
    
    Upstream files can change. The checksums below identify this project's current
    input snapshots; a later clone may not reproduce these exact bytes.
    
    ## Regenerate reports
    
    With the local input snapshots available, run:
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_comparison.py
    ```
    
    This writes CSV tables, PNG figures and `source_comparison.md` to
    `reports/compare/`. To regenerate only figures from existing tables:
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_comparison.py --plots-only
    ```
    
    The API input is `alerts_in_ua/alerts_month.csv`; if it is unavailable, API
    comparisons are skipped. Raw data and API snapshots are gitignored and must be
    preserved separately. See [docs/DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md) for provenance
    and definitions.
    
    ## Reference validation
    
    Reference validation only (four walk-forward folds; no TEST evaluation):
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_reference_models.py --train-start 2025-12-01
    ```
    
    Parameters and diagnostics are written to `reports/model/`. The shared panel
    and predictions are stored under ignored `data/processed/`, using parquet when
    pyarrow is available or `.csv.gz` otherwise. See the script's `--help` for fold
    boundaries and other parameters.
    
    ## Snapshot provenance and SHA-256
    
    TRAIN-only descriptive EDA (STL/ACF; no model features):
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_eda.py
    ```
    
    The executed notebook is `notebooks/00_eda.ipynb`; tables and figures are in
    `reports/eda/`. Computation and plotting can be separated with `--compute-only`
    and `--plots-only`. The notebook recomputes tables; the CLI also renders figures.
    
    Per project provenance, the official Telegram channel `air_alert_ua` has been
    silent since 2026-09-07. The alerts.in.ua snapshot was fetched on 2026-10-11.
    Its rolling history means that this historical snapshot cannot be re-downloaded
    later; preserve the original file. These are provenance notes, not analysis
    results or a new live-channel check.
    
    | File | SHA-256 |
    |---|---|
    | `data/raw/official_data_en.csv` | `b396f87696243069eec0219880e87dcd642b20beb0a7bae0d0e1f61e1ed20ec4` |
    | `data/raw/volunteer_data_en.csv` | `e441ecaa9813c9088e41aa6f137f9917679c9721701c817a97aae3bed470e1d5` |
    | `alerts_in_ua/alerts_month.csv` | `e21532d64265454995096b09cd451940f64f8b7b34fa84c609aada416f6073a7` |
    
    Pooled logistic validation through recency weighting (run stages in order after
    reference generation; no HGB or FINAL mode):
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_model_ladder.py --stage prepare
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_model_ladder.py --stage A
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_model_ladder.py --stage AB
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_model_ladder.py --stage recency
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/report_model_ladder.py --stage A
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/report_model_ladder.py --stage AB
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/report_model_ladder.py --stage recency
    ```
    
    Regenerate downstream stages after rerunning an upstream stage. CLI options
    configure the training start, fold boundaries, leads, C grid, half-lives and seed.
    Model logs append; summaries and notebooks describe the current stage run. The
    combined `notebooks/00_eda.ipynb` preserves historical EDA first, followed by
    TRAIN-only STL; do not rerun historical exploration as validation evidence.
    
    Fixed long-memory, full HGB grid, validation ensemble comparison and freeze:
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_advanced_models.py --stage long
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_advanced_models.py --stage hgb
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_advanced_models.py --stage freeze
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/report_advanced_models.py --stage hgb
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/report_advanced_models.py --stage comparison
    ```
    
    Run in this order after the earlier model ladder. Reporting supports separate
    `--notebooks-only` and `--plots-only` modes. Frozen settings are in
    `config/final_config.json`; these commands contain no FINAL/TEST mode. Remaining
    calendar, rolling-refit and robustness experiments stay deferred.
    
    Explicit FINAL evaluation (only after authorisation; completed runs refuse a
    second prediction run):
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_final.py
    ```
    
    If prediction checkpoints exist but reporting failed, recover evaluation only:
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_final.py --evaluate-saved
    ```
    
    The recovery path does not fit models or generate predictions. Final scores and
    validation comparisons are in `reports/model/final_test.md`; predictions are
    stored in ignored `data/processed/predictions/final_test.csv.gz`.
    
    ## Retrospective TEST viewer
    
    Rebuild from the repo root:
    
    ```sh
    PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/build_app.py
    ```
    
    Double-click `docs/index.html` to open it locally, or serve the `docs/` directory
    with GitHub Pages. The built HTML is self-contained: no server, internet,
    libraries or fonts are needed. It displays only saved TEST forecasts/outcomes.
    
    Rebuilding requires the ignored `data/processed/predictions/final_test.csv.gz`
    and FINAL checkpoint, the saved TEST metrics/bootstrap CSVs and frozen config.
    It also reads the user-supplied `geoBoundaries-UKR-ADM1.geojson` and
    `metadata-geoboundaries-ukr-adm1-geojson.json` in the root; these are ignored and
    remain untouched. Geometry/metadata locations can be changed with `--geometry`
    and `--metadata` (for example under ignored `data/geo/`). No download is attempted.
    The boundary licence/attribution can be specified with `--licence`.

    # Project: per-oblast air-raid alert forecasting (Ukraine)
    
    Goal: for each oblast, forecast P(alert touches hour h) at forecast time T, evaluated on the latest period. No data leakage.
    
    ## Forecast setup
    - PRIMARY: each lead 1..6 h ahead as a separate target. Lead 0 is reported separately, never pooled.
    - SECONDARY (contrast): leads 12 and 24 h.
    - EXTRA metric, only if time allows: event window "any alert in [T, T+W)".
    - Do not choose a horizon by test score. Do NOT implement train/val/test splits yet; only prepare data.
    
    ## Data decisions (changes go to docs/DECISIONS.md)
    - `official` (Telegram air_alert_ua, structured, levels oblast/raion/hromada) is PRIMARY. `volunteer` (eTryvoga, keyword-parsed, oblast level) is a robustness check. Never average or merge them.
    - official_data_en.csv has an exact duplicated block: `drop_duplicates()` right after reading (expected 299,275 -> 185,430 rows).
    - All timestamps are UTC (= Telegram publication time, not siren time). Convert to Europe/Kyiv only for daily reporting.
    - Target: alert(oblast, hour) = 1 iff ANY interval of ANY level in the oblast touches [h, h+1h).
    - Exclude Luhanska oblast and Crimea.
    - Intervals are written only when closed, so each file is right-censored: trim the last 48 h of every source.
    - volunteer `naive` = imputed end (+30 min). official: duration == 3600 s is a heuristic imputation flag (~0.1% of rows).
    - Hourly "touch" inflates up to ~3.3x observed; ~1x for saturated oblasts. Compare SOURCES by exact minutes; use the hourly grid only for modelling.
    - Do not model alert counts or durations (parser artifacts).
    
    ## Leakage rules
    - A feature for forecast time T may use only events with started_at <= T. finished_at counts as known only if <= T; otherwise the alert is "ongoing".
    - Time-based splits only. Fit anything (scalers, encoders) on the training window only.
    
    ## Code rules
    - Task 1 needs no network or secrets. Later collect tasks may use the network, but never read, print or write tokens; credentials come from env vars only.
    - Never modify data/raw. Inspect files before assuming column names.
    - Type hints, small pure functions, pytest tests, no absolute paths.
    - Keep the repo minimal: create a file only when the current task needs it.
    - Final report after each task: files changed, commands run, test output, what you assumed or could not verify. Do not claim results you did not run.
